Final Exam
overview: Three new graduates from the H.I.V.E. Academy, Gizmo, Jinx, and Mammoth, are hired by Slade to ambush the Titans. The Titans try to stop them, but Robin is lost during the fight and Titans Tower is taken over by the H.I.V.E. students.

title: Sisters
overview: When a mysterious alien probe comes to haul Starfire away, sweet-natured Star has no idea why it came. And when Starfire's sister Blackfire stops by to visit, Starfire just wishes she would leave. Blackfire's wild, cool, and hip-- everything Starfire's not. The other Titans seem to like Blackfire so much, Starfire thinks they won't need her around anymore.

title: Divide and Conquer
overview: Cinderblock breaks into prison--and the Teen Titans arrive in time to stop a jailbreak. But when Robin and Cyborg's big “sonic boom” maneuver goes awry, the bad guy gets away--and the boys blame each other.

title: Forces of Nature
overview: Dark ominous clouds blow in from the east, bringing Thunder and Lightning with them--two forces of nature made flesh in the form of costumed superteens. The stormy brothers aren't evil; they're just looking for a good time.

title: The Sum of His Parts
overview: While playing in the park Cyborg suddenly shuts down. After rebooting he tells the other Titans that his batteries are dying. During a battle with Mumbo, Cyborg's emergency batteries die and he is lost. The Titans believe Mumbo to have kidnapped him, but he has instead been found by a strange man called Fixit.

title: Nevermore
overview: Raven's creepy tantrum of crackling black energy leaves Dr. Light begging for mercy, and the Titans see a new side of Raven, her temper. But, when Cyborg and Beast Boy find a Mysterious Mirror in Raven's room, they're suddenly transported to a strange nightmare world that's somehow connected to Raven.

title: Switched
overview: Starfire and Raven don't really "get each other." Star doesn't understand Raven's repression, and Raven can't deal with Starfire's emotional outbursts. But when The Puppet King imprisons Robin, Cyborg, and Beast Boy inside wooden puppets and takes control of the boys' bodies. The girls are going to have to understand each other -- if they want to survive.

title: Deep Six
overview: A mysterious new villain called Trident appears and starts stealing nuclear waste from ships. The Titans go to investigate and meet a new hero, Aqualad. This new hero causes Beast Boy to become very competitive.

title: Masks
overview: A thief called Red X, who knows the Titans’ every weakness, shows up. Every time the Titans try to catch him, they are badly defeated. Meanwhile, Robin - who has been obsessed with capturing Slade - isolates himself more and more from the team.

title: Mad Mod
overview: The Titans awake to find themselves captured as prisoners of Mad Mod, a madcap bad guy in a psychedelic suit. Mad Mod has decided to teach the teens a lesson, creating a massive mind-bending school full of optical illusions and brain-washing hypno-screens. Will the Titans be "re-educated" and lose their minds in the process?

title: Apprentice (1)
overview: Slade threatens to use a chronoton detonator, a device which can destroy the entire city if triggered. While Robin goes after Slade, the other Titans try to disarm the detonator. But then it turns out that Slade has other aims in mind than the destruction of the city.

title: Apprentice (2)
overview: The Titans can’t find a trace of Robin and start getting worried - that is, until they catch him red handed robbing a facility as Slade’s apprentice. After being defeated by Robin, the Titans are sure he has become a criminal. In truth, the life of a villain comes at an even more bitter price for Robin himself.

title: Car Trouble
overview: Cyborg has finally finished his 'baby', the T-Car. But after a battle with Overload his car disappears. It successively ends up in the hands of two bad guys called Cash and Sammy, then Gizmo, and finally Overload, the last of which forces Cyborg to make a painful decision.

title: How Long Is Forever?
overview: Starfire is trying to commemorate the Tamaranean holiday Blorthog, the festival of friendship, when Warp, a villain from the future, comes back in time to steal an antique. When Starfire charges at him, she finds herself stranded in the future and finds that much has changed for her friends ... and only for the worse.

title: Every Dog Has His Day
overview: Being ignored by his busy teammates, Beast Boy feels left out, so he wanders the town eventually turning into a green dog. To his surprise he crashes into another green dog that is being pursued by a flying saucer. The saucer picks Beast Boy up by mistake, and its owner gives Beast Boy more attention than he would like.

title: Terra
overview: The Titans spot a young girl being chased by a giant scorpion-like creature and prepare to rescue her, only to see that the girl possesses tremendous powers and was merely luring the scorpion into a trap. She reveals her name to be Terra, and she has the power to control the earth and all of its forms. However, she has a terrible secret, and Slade shows interest in her.

title: Only Human
overview: When Cyborg beats a robot named Atlas in an online video game, he challenges Cyborg to a real, physical fight; a fight Cyborg loses due to Atlas having lesser limits on his strength. Atlas then kidnaps Robin, Starfire, Raven, and Beast Boy as his prize and challenges Cyborg to a rematch where his friends’ lives are at stake.

title: Fear Itself
overview: The Titans pick up a horror movie called Wicked Scary. After watching it, they are scared out of their wits, although Raven refuses to admit this to the others. During the night, strange things start to happen in the Tower.

title: Date with Destiny
overview: When Killer Moth threatens the city with his army of moths, Robin has no choice but to agree to his demand; He is forced to take his bratty and spoiled daughter Kitten to her junior prom much to Robin's dismay and Starfire's jealousy.

title: Transformation
overview: Starfire wakes up one day to discover a huge lump on her forehead. But this is only the start of a bizarre string of transformations affecting her - changes that interest a highly hostile creature very much.

title: Titan Rising
overview: Terra is ready to join the team after getting the chance to practice her powers, However, other members of the team wonder if they have made a huge mistake. Raven doesn't want Terra back. Can Terra prove to the team that she can be trusted with her powers?

title: Winner Take All
overview: This episode shows Robin wanting to be a big shot winner. When he, Cyborg, and Beast Boy are transported to another land, along with Gizmo, Wildebeest, Hot Spot, Aqualad, and Speedy, Robin finally has his chance. As the players battle, The Master of Games takes the losers powers. It will take Robin to figure out Winning isn't everything to save the day

title: Betrayal
overview: Terra and Beast Boy are finally kicking up a notch when they go out on a date. But while they were out, someone let Slade's army into Titans Tower. But when Beast Boy and Terra just about kiss, Slade ruins the romance. Slade lets out the news that Terra is his apprentice, making for a very unhappy Beast Boy. Finally, he turns his back on Terra, letting her go with Slade.

title: Fractured
overview: When Robin accidentally wrecks his R-Cycle while pursuing a nasty thug named Johnny Rancid, he winds up with his arm in a cast and doubt in himself. The good news is he gets a visit from his number one fan, a short little weirdo named Larry the Titan. The bad news is Larry's reality-bending powers are more than they can fix. Can Robin get his nerve back and take down Johnny Rancid before Larry's "help" breaks the fabric of time and space and destroy reality as we know it?

title: Aftershock (1)
overview: Terra returns with a vengeance, Meanwhile, Slade gives orders to Cinderblock, Overload, and Plasmus to launch a series of sinister strikes all over the city. Can our heroes stop the three villianous monsters, Slade, and Terra? Or will the Teen Titans be destroyed?

title: Aftershock (2)
overview: Terra finds out that the Titans are not easily destroyed, when they come back and nearly defeat her.  Slade sends Ternion (a combination of Overload, Plasmus, and Cinderblock) while he beats Terra up for running away.  When the Titans see how sorry Terra is and the torture Slade is doing to her, will they forgive her?  Or will they follow out with their plans and destroy her?

title: Deception
overview: When H.I.V.E. shows up causing havoc, the Titans get straight to the job. Unfortunately they escape, but Robin was able to plant a locator device onto Jinx just in time. The Titans send Cyborg - disguised as a strong man known as ""Stone"" - to infilitrate the H.I.V.E. academy and find out what they're up to.

title: X
overview: There's a new thief in town - Robin's former evil alter ego, Red X. Robin feels that this is all his fault, and must stop X from getting a dangerous powerful chemical known as synovium that will power him up. Robin stops at nothing to catch his former evil alter ego - but it turns out that there may be a even bigger villianious plot in the mists.

title: Betrothed
overview: The Grand Ruler of Tamaran has arranged for Starfire to be married during the Teen Titans' visit to Tamaran. Robin has a hard time believing that Starfire is to marry someone she hasn't met or known.

title: Crash
overview: When Beast Boy mistakes Cyborg's system recharger for a video game, he accidentally infects it with a nasty computer virus. The virus quickly spreads to Cyborg himself causing the half-teen/half-machine to go haywire, and the only way to stop the virus is to shrink down to microscopic size and go on a fantastic voyage inside Cyborg. Does Amoeba Beast Boy have the brains to fix Cyborg's brains before a crazed Cyborg destroys the city?

title: Haunted
overview: Ever since the Titans' final confrontation with Slade, Robin has been haunted by one question: Is Slade really gone? And after Cinderblock escapes from jail, Robin finally gets his answer when he sees Slade. Robin pursues Slade, fiercely determined to stop his nemesis once and for all.

title: Spellbound
overview: Raven has always been lonely at the Tower, despite the other Titans. But that all changes when Raven discovers a young magician trapped inside one of her books.

title: Revolution
overview: The Titans' Fourth of July festivities are interrupted when Mad Mod comes to the party uninvited, declaring the American Revolution a hoax and reclaiming the city for jolly old England. To make matters worse, old Mad Mod steals Robin's youth. Can the remaining Teen Titans devise a plan to take back their city and save their leader?

title: Wavelength
overview: Brother Blood is back, and this time, it's personal. Cyborg learns that Blood stole his blueprints--and the villain is using Cyborg's technology to create a doomsday device. Can Cyborg take charge of the team and lead a mission to stop his archenemy?

title: The Beast Within
overview: When Beast Boy begins turning into an angry, aggressive Man Beast against his will, the Titans must try to save themselves from their savage friend.

title: Can I Keep Him?
overview: Starfire adopts a weird mutant silkworm named Silkie as a pet, but when she feeds him some alien food from Tamaran, Silkie has an unexpected--and monstrous--growth spurt. Can Starfire still keep her beloved worm?

title: Bunny Raven or How to Make a Titananimal Disappear
overview: The Amazing Mumbo is up to his old tricks. When the Teen Titans try to stop the madcap magician in mid-performance, Mumbo pulls a fast one. With a wave of his wand, he sucks the Titans into his hat where our heroes discover a strange magical world of weirdness.

title: Titans East (1)
overview: Cyborg has a final showdown with Brother Blood, and a new branch of the Titans team is created. Titans East is a different tower in a new city with five new members: Aqualad, Bumblebee, Speedy and a pair of high-speed twins known as Mas Y Menos. Part one of a two-part episode.

title: Titans East (2)
overview: The final battle continues between Cyborg and Brother Blood as well as the creation of a new branch of Titans.

title: Don't Touch That Dial
overview: Control Freak has escaped from prison and brought the Titans into his TV world. The Titans must track him down through the diffrent channels of television while he gets more powerful with all the TV show related powers he gets.

title: The Quest
overview: When Robin is defeated by the malicious martial artist Kitarou, our hero decides that if he wants to be the best -- he needs more training. So he embarks on a difficult quest to seek a mysterious, legendary teacher known only as... The True Master.

title: Birthmark
overview: It's Raven's birthday, but she is far from wanting to celebrate. But before Robin can learn why, the Titans receive a distress call and go to check it out. When they get there, they are greeted by none other than Slade, back from the dead. But Slade seems to have new powers along with a strange red mark on his head and he has a message for Raven that he is going to deliver, no matter what.

title: Cyborg the Barbarian
overview: Cyborg is mysteriously thrown into the distant past and lands in the middle of a barbarian village that needs his help. But with the nearest charging station 5,000 years in the future, Cy has no way to recharge, and his power supply is dwindling.

title: Employee of the Month
overview: Beast Boy has only one real dream in life -- to someday, somehow own a Moped. And when Robin won't buy him one and Cyborg won't build him one, Beast Boy has only one way to make his dream come true he has to get a job. However, when he goes to work at a new restaurant called ""Mega Meaty Meat"" for a strange man named Bob, he soon realizes all is not what it seems.

title: Troq
overview: A brave hero from outer space called Val-Yor comes to Earth, and asks for the Titans help in defeating an otherworldly menace known as The Locrix. But according to Val-Yor, Starfire may be the real problem...

title: The Prophecy
overview: Ever since Slade's return, the Titans have been searching high and low for answers, including looking for theories as to the 'S' mark on his forehead. However, Raven knows why he's back, and the Titans are about to discover the truth themselves after Slade launches another attack.

title: Stranded
overview: An exciting battle on a distant space station ends with a tremendous explosion that blows the T-Ship apart -- and sends the Titans flying off in five different directions to crashland on a strange alien world.

title: Overdrive
overview: Wishing to get the most he can out of his time, Cyborg installs a special Max-7 chip into his head which throws him into overdrive, allowing him to do a lot of things, very fast. But when the self-copying Billy Numerous starts stealing everything in town, even the Max-7 may not be enough to stop him.

title: Mother Mae-Eye
overview: The strange Mother Mae-Eye has taken the Titans on as her children and turned the tower into a massive gingerbread house. But even below her initial weirdness, she just keeps getting weirder.

title: The End (1)
overview: The day has finally come. Raven is destined to end the world on this day. Trigon will come by sunset. But not if the Titans have anything to say about it. They place Raven in a safe room while they take on an army of flame creatures and Slade who is determind to take Raven to the Trigon. But Raven knows the horrible truth. No matter what the Titans do, there is no escaping her destiny.

title: The End (2)
overview: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, and Beast Boy awake to a nightmare. Trigon has risen and he has ended the world. Every building is destroyed, and all life has been turned to stone. Due to one last gift of Raven's, the Titans have survived. Now, they must find a way to get Raven back, maybe she knows of a way to stop Trigon. But to do this, the Titans will have to accept help from their old enemy - Slade.

title: The End (3)
overview: The stars are aligned. The sun is in eclipse. All of Slade's labors are about to reach fruition -- and the Titans are about to face their greatest challenge ever. But is there really any hope of preventing the end of the world?

title: Homecoming (1)
overview: When Beast Boy's former team, The Doom Patrol, is in trouble, the Titans must embark on a daring mission to save them. Beast Boy explains that this can only mean one thing: the Doom Patrol's greatest foes are back. The Brotherhood of Evil has returned.

title: Homecoming (2)
overview: The Doom Patrol has been saved, but the sinister Brotherhood of Evil is still on the loose. It's just like old times for Beast Boy when he finds himself back on the team for one last mission - to stop the Brotherhood once and for all... no matter what the cost.

title: Trust
overview: The Brotherhood of Evil has begun its master plan to eliminate all of the young superheroes around the globe, starting with honorary Titans Wildebeest and Hotspot. This new threat brings Robin to Morocco. But with an unknown enemy, how can anyone know who to trust?

title: For Real
overview: Control Freak returns to Titan Tower with "The Ultimate Titans Challenge," a series of events designed specifically to challenge the Teen Titans. But what happens to Control Freak's big plan when he finds himself facing not the "real" Titans -- but the Titans East?

title: Snowblind
overview: While battling a mysterious creature in the wilds of Siberia, Starfire is lost in a blinding snowstorm. A reclusive young soldier named Red Star comes to her aid and the two become fast friends. When Robin and the rest of the Titans arrive, they discover Red Star hides not only a tragic past, but a destructive secret.

title: Kole
overview: While in the Arctic Circle, the Teen Titans once again take on Dr. Light. And when an accident sends the Titans through the ice, they discover a new exotic Underworld --and two new superheroes, Kole and her caveman sidekick Gnarrk.

title: Hide and Seek
overview: With the other Teen Titans off fighting exciting battles with the Brotherhood of Evil, Raven is left with the worst task of all -- transporting three rambunctious future superheroes to safety. But this simple task turns into an adventure in babysitting as Raven and her young charges are chased through the Alps by the Brotherhood of Evil's Msr. Mallah.

title: Lightspeed
overview: With Titans dispatched across the globe, members of the HIVE FIVE figure they have it made. Unfortunately their city-wide crime spree is cut short when a new hero in town spoils the fun. Handing him over to the BROTHERHOOD OF EVIL may score the Hive Five points, but actually catching this lightning-fast do-gooder is much harder than it seems.

title: Revved Up
overview: Robin's most prized possession is stolen by the hip hot-rodder, Ding Dong Daddy, and to get it back they're going to have to beat him in a cross-country road race. But with Ding Dong Daddy making the rules and a few unexpected rivals joining in the competition, it's anyone's guess who will cross the finish line first.

title: Go!
overview: How did Robin meet Starfire? What was Beast Boy's first joke? Why did Cyborg build his Sonic Cannon? When did Raven first call the Titans her friends? Return to the very beginning and see how it all started - from the word ""GO!""

title: Calling All Titans
overview: The final game has begun. While the Titans are spread out throughout the globe on one last mission, Brotherhood mastermind, the Brain, makes his move. Robin has a strategy of his own, but as all the villains begin taking down all the superheroes all at once, will it be enough to save his friends?

title: Titans Together
overview: All seems lost for young heroes across the globe: they have been spread far and wide, their lines of communication have been severed, and one by one, the Brotherhood of Evil takes them down. But as The Brain claims his victory is assured, one brave hero manages to slip thorough the Brotherhood of Evil's grasp: Beast Boy.

title: Things Change
overview: After months of fighting the Brotherhood of Evil around the globe, the Teen Titans are finally back home. But a walk through the city reveals that things are no longer as they remembered. And while Beast Boy wants everything to be just like it was in the past, he has to face the fact that in life things change.

title: King Billy
overview: It is the morning of Billy Fox's seventieth birthday and, like undisputed king of his South London manor, he is out and about chatting with old friends and keeping up with the local news.

title: Arched Fingers for Bach, Flat Fingers for Love
overview: Joey tries to settle the problem with Liz. Meanwhile, his brother Kenny is preparing for the most important fight of his career

title: Pubilism Not Vandalism
overview: Andy is nearly knocked down by a van while Kenny fights Charlie Locke for the Southern Area Championship title

title: It's All Them Pschia-Whatever-You-Call-It Books He Reads
overview: Kenny's triumph in the ring has turned sour because his opponent Charlie Locke has not regained conciousness.

title: Shim-Me-Sha-Wabble
overview: Out of his mind with grief, Kenny has left London. Drunk and bewildered, he meets with the helpful Rita. His brothers try and track him down.

title: Stick or Twist
overview: Having stolen all his possessions, Lee and Rita discover Kenny's identity and realise they can demand a ransom for his safe return.

title: The Perfect Scapegoat Syndrome
overview: Phil becomes involved in university politics with unhappy consequences, which lead to a confrontation with his father.

title: If It's Good Enough For New Orleans It's Good Enough For Clapham
overview: London turns out to say goodbye to King Billy. His funeral is exactly as he would want it, New Orleans jazz band and all.

title: Fox Big F------- Family
overview: The Fox family is drifting apart without Billy's guidance and support; the brothers are facing big problems.

title: Just an Iron Monkey
overview: Vin is still trying to sort out his finances so he can buy the pub in the country. Ray is also offered a good business proposition.

title: Just Another Villain in a Cheap Suit
overview: Ray is asked to repay a debt from way back in teh past he would rather forget.

title: Oh Dear, Oh Dear, Oh Dear!
overview: As Ray heads up North he does not know that the police are lying in wait for him.

title: The Family...and the Future
overview: After all the traumas, the Fox family are finding new directions and new relationships.

title: Mask
overview: On his sickbed, an elderly Dickens recalls his life. He remembers his father John as someone who is a bit larger than life. A great storyteller, he enjoys performing monologues in ale houses and even has the young Charles sing or recite from time to time. John works as a clerk but with a growing family, he has fallen behind in his payments to the local shopkeepers. He borrows a bit of money from a cousin but he has to make plans to relocate to a less prosperous part of London. Before he can do so however, he is visited by a solicitor seeking payment on behalf of his clients.

title: The Deed
overview: Young Charles returns to his family in London at the end of term and is unlikely to return. He finds it hard to accept that London is a great classroom for learning about life. He learns about the poverty around him. While he knows his father is employed in civil service, he's also aware that prosecutors are after him.

title: Blacking
overview: During his tour, Dickens meets Commissioner Wentworth and takes exception to New York city's jail. He recalls when, as a boy of 12, his own father was jailed for nine months without any evidence. Charles had obtained employment with Cousin James, working in horrible circumstances making boot polish. At home, Mr. Kerr continues to press for repayment and the elder Dickens finds himself in the sponging-house, a temporary jail for debtors.

title: Love
overview: In New York City, Dickens meets an ardent admirer, a Miss Baldwin, who reminds him of someone from his youth. As a young man, Charles was involved in amateur theatricals and was writing, drawing on his own experiences for the latter. Charles has also taken an interest in Maria Beadnell, one of several daughters to a well-known banker. In fact, he's fallen madly in love with her and has taken to writing her poetry.

title: Success
overview: In 1835, Dickens is working as a journalist and publishing stories wherever and whenever he can. He's still in love with Maria but she seems to think less of him. Dickens drowns his sorrows at the ale house and falls into the arms of local prostitute Desdemona. Although under a pseudonym, Dickens begins to gather a following. His first book nets £150, much to his spendthrift father's joy. The money doesn't last long, however, as the elder Dickens is once again arrested.

title: Fame
overview: Dickens proposes to Catherine, which she happily accepts. Kate, however, is frightened by the prospect of marriage and also with her new husband's determination. Dickens has his first great success with his serialisation of 'The Pickwick Papers'. Sales are not as expected and he has issues with the illustrator. With an advance on the first two stories, Dickens sets out to furnish his new home.

title: Money
overview: Dickens is doing quite well with a new illustrator for 'The Pickwick Papers', which is proving a great success. Meanwhile, Kate is pregnant, expecting their first child. A dream about an orphan boy leads Dickens to write 'Oliver Twist'. He researches the subject thoroughly, visiting prisons and following a jailer's suggestion that such boys are often pickpockets. In many ways, it reminds him of his own youth.

title: Possession
overview: Dickens grows ncreasingly concerned at Catherine's deteriorating mental condition. Meanwhile, he continues his flirtation with sister-in-law Mary, spending hours together. With his ever-growing success, Dickens rents a new 12-room London townhouse with a large garden. Unbeknownst to everyone, Mary is seriously ill.

title: Dreams
overview: In New York, Dickens is invited to a sportsman's dinner, one of many such invitations that he regularly receives. He recalls a time when, as still a young man, he sorely grieved the loss of sister-in-law Mary, whom he loved very dearly. He continues to produce novels, including 'Oliver Twist' but begins to fear for his health and seeks the world-weary Dr. Elliotson to take out an insurance policy.

title: Magic
overview: Charles is acting very strangely and his friends are worried, as he claims to be in love with Queen Victoria, upset that she is marrying a German; he even threatens to leave England. He wants to buy back his his copyright to 'Oliver Twist', seemingly prepared to pay a hefty sum to do so. The serialisation of 'The Old Curiosity Shop' is a huge success, with the death of the protagonist, Little Nell, capturing the imagination of the nation, leaving many a grown man in tears.

title: Nightmare
overview: Dickens recalls his first visit to the United States in 1842, where he met Edgar Allan Poe. Kate, psychologically fragile as she is, accompanied him though she isn't having much fun. Dickens and Poe find much to discuss and share stories over wine.

title: Angel
overview: Dickens recalls an 1842 trip to Montreal, where he and Kate performed onstage. Their return is a joyous one and they are happily reunited with their many children. As well, Kate is again pregnant, and Dickens takes an interest in Kate's sister Georgina, who Kate hires to help her about the house. Dickens' happiness is short-lived however, when he learns that one of his books has been pirated and widely published abroad with zero compensation.

title: Memories
overview: In New York, Dickens reads 'A Christmas Carol' to a sold-out audience. He reminisces about his childhood, particularly those involving his larger than life father and some of the financial difficulties they faced one particular holiday season. Similarly, he reads from his other works, and recalls how his father and events of his own life are reflected in his stories.

title: Mike and Matt (Brad Pitt)
overview: Mike and Matt, 20-year-old twin brothers from Arizona, want to look like Brad Pitt and become famous actors one day. They believe the only thing holding them back from big careers in Hollywood are their ""unattractive"" faces and that if they look more like Brad, they will finally make it big. Mike and Matt are both getting rhinoplasty, chin implants, and porcelain veneers and Mike is also having cheek implants. Will their facial overhauls be enough to make them superstars with the women they lust after?

title: Mia (Britney Spears)
overview: Mia, a 27-year-old Britney Spears impersonator from Orlando, Florida, already believes she naturally looks like Britney, but just needs new breasts to complete her look. Mia had already consulted with three different surgeons before the MTV cameras began shooting. Mia hopes that with her breast implants she will be able to quit her day job and score big bucks as a celebrity impersonator.

title: Jenette (Kate Winslet)
overview: Jennette, a 21-year-old college student and plus-size model from Tallahassee, Florida, wants the body of Kate Winslet. A year after undergoing gastric by-pass surgery, Jennette wants to have a body lift. Although she feels that she naturally looks like Kate Winslet, having a similarly voluptuous body could provide her with more modeling gigs than she can score now.

title: Sha (Pamela Anderson)
overview: Sha, a 19-year-old from Texas, longs to look more like Pamela Anderson and hopes to fill Pam's shoes as a Playmate and actress. She decides to get breast implants, lip implants and liposuction under her chin. With her new breasts, lips and chin Sha takes on her first test shoot for Playboy. Will she make the grade or will Playboy be disappointed with her new look?

title: Jessica (Jennifer Lopez)
overview: Jessica, a 23-year-old ""party girl"" from Chicago, wants to look like Jennifer Lopez and hopes to become a runway model. Growing up, Jessica had always felt like she was a man trapped in a female's body. After undergoing hormone therapy and starting the change to becoming a female, she has now legally changed her name and is ready to have cosmetic surgery to look even more like a woman. Jessica is having breast implants, cheek implants, her eyebrow bone shaved, an eyebrow lift and her hairline lowered. Will she finally embody the J-Lo look she's longed for and will she become a model with her new feminized appearance?

title: Jesse (Elvis Presley)
overview: Jesse, an Elvis impersonator from Las Vegas, has been in the impersonator game for eight years but feels like the competition is becoming increasingly tough to beat. Jesse feels he can stay on top by looking even more like Elvis, so he decides to get a chin implant, lip injections, and a chemical face peel to do the trick. Will his new look make him a bigger star and land him on the cover of Playgirl magazine?

title: MTV News Now: They Wanted a Famous Face
overview: What ever happened to Jenette, Jessica, Matt and Mike from Season 1? Tune in March 8 at 10:30 PM to see them and others from Season 1 in the MTV News Special: They Wanted a Famous Face.

title: Brandi (Carmen Electra)
overview: Brandi is a 21-year-old go-go dancer who hopes to pursue a career like her idol's, Carmen Electra. Brandi knows that plastic surgery is the ""cutting edge"" she needs to perfect her Carmen look and is getting breast implants, lip injections and a nose job to make her look like her favorite star. She hopes having Carmen's body and breasts will ""electrify"" her modeling career and help her chances of posing for Maxim Magazine just like Carmen. In addition, Brandi hopes plastic surgery will finally convince her ""guy friend"" to give her the commitment she's been longing for, since he is a ""boob man"" and a huge fan of Carmen's.

title: Jenee (Tiffani Thiessen)
overview: Jenee is a hair stylist from Long Island who dreams of looking like actress Tiffani-Amber Thiessen. Jenee believes posing for Playboy will give her career the jump start it needs. She is always mistaken for and considers herself Tiffani's biggest fan. Jenee does everything from studying Tiffani's make-up technique to watching every career move she makes. Jenee hopes getting breast implants and liposuction on her stomach, back, butt and thighs will perfect her body. She thinks surgery will give her the confidence to expose her body at a photo shoot and to send her pics into Playboy.

title: Jay (Arnold Schwarzenegger)
overview: Jay is a 23-year-old Long Island student who, while not ""obsessed"" with Arnold Schwarzenegger, has always admired his perfect physique and chest. Jay has modeled his diet, body building and lifestyle after Arnold's--yet his Gynecomastia holds him back from achieving that perfect Arnold chest. He considers plastic surgery his only hope of terminating his ""man-boobs"" and winning him the girl of his dreams.

title: Kelly (Jennifer Aniston)
overview: Kelly is an extremely outgoing 26-year-old who is absolutely infatuated with Jennifer Aniston, whom everyone says she resembles. She buys clothes to match Jennifer's and owns all her movies. Kelly just divorced her husband and really wants to find a new man and start fresh with a new, ""hot"" body. She hopes that having rhinoplasty, breast lift and augmentation and extensive liposuction will help her finally be comfortable in her own skin. She dates frequently, goes country dancing with her girlfriends and yearns for the confidence to wear string bikinis so she can find her own Brad Pitt.

title: Crystal U (Britney Spears)
overview: Crystal is a shy, single 24-year-old Britney Spears look-alike who lives a normal life. She has a comfy office job but secretly desires a different life. Crystal thinks bigger breasts and a nose job will give her the confidence she needs to become a stripper. Not only that, playing up her similarities to Britney will allow her to impersonate the superstar when she finally hits the pole. Even if she doesn't go through with the stripping, she feels a makeover will help her land a job with the Anaheim Angels Strike Force, a sexy dance team that entertains the crowd between innings.

title: Martin (Ricky Martin)
overview:
Martin is an outgoing 18-year-old college freshman who wants to look like Ricky Martin. He's hoping plastic surgery can get his longtime dream woman Marita to add some ""benefits"" to their platonic friendship.

He thinks Ricky Martin's strong features are just what he needs to overcome Marita's lack of romantic interest and convince her to live ""la vida loca"" with him.

title: Nikicia (Janet Jackson)
overview: Nikicia is an aspiring singer/actress who hopes a Janet Jackson makeover will improve her look and marketability. She had liposuction nine months ago, but it only succeeded in taking off five pounds and angering her husband, who considered the procedure a waste of money. Although she is starting a Web site promoting independent singers/actors, Nikicia still doesn't feel comfortable enough to post her own pictures. She's hoping that surgery to give her a body like Janet Jackson's will give her the confidence she needs to make it big.

title: Crystal Z
overview: Crystal is a 23-year-old Hawaiian Tropics Model who'd love to look like her idol, Brooke Burke. Although she's competed in many modeling and beauty pageants, Crystal is very self-conscious about her body and has always needed to stuff her bra to feel confident. Crystal works nights as a ""beer tub"" girl and has been told she resembles Brooke Burke, who, like Crystal, is a mix of different ethnicities. Crystal hopes having surgery to further this resemblance will help her be as successful as Brooke.

title: Jamie
overview: Jamie is a 19-year-old punk rocker who dreams of resembling her childhood idol, Posh Spice. Jamie goes to college part-time, where she majors in Human Sexuality. She's hated her nose for a long time and now it's time for a change. While most girls her age save for a car or school, Jamie has been putting money away for plastic surgery. Her mom is afraid she'll become obsessed, but Jamie feels she's very realistic about her expectations. All she wants is a nose like Posh Spice, who she's loved since her days as a young Spice Girls fan.

title: Audrey
overview: 22-year-old Audrey hopes plastic surgery will help give her bodacious, Jessica Simpson curves. Audrey currently does a little modeling, but feels her body has prevented her from getting the more glamorous modeling jobs. She's also very jealous of her sister, a Hooters girl with breast implants. A huge fan of Newlyweds, she thinks plastic surgery can help give her Jessica Simpson's body and flawless skin and salvage her modeling career in the ""Nick"" of time. Also, a new look would help her steal some attention from her sister and move on from her annoying Hell's Angel boyfriend.

title: Vived
overview: Carmen Electra is also idolized by Vived, a 23-year-old dancer who designs clothing for Barbie dolls and for her own clothing line. Carmen is her idol because of her success as a model, dancer and entrepreneur. Vived also wants her body to measure up to Carmen's, and thinks that breast implants and liposuction will do the trick. Vived hopes that plastic surgery will allow her to model in ""Playboy,"" just like Carmen. She also wants to feel sexy enough to model her own lingerie.

title: Gia
overview: Pamela Andersen's look is the one that Gia--a 26-year-old transexual porn star turned director/producer of her own adult films--is going for. Inspired by her friend Cindy, the ""Human Barbie,"" she's had over a dozen procedures and is going under the knife again to get a new set of breast implants, lipo on her abdomen and chin, another nose job, micrografts to her hairline and fat transferred to her smile lines. She loves Pamela Anderson and hopes plastic surgery will perfect her Pam look so she can leave the ""adult industry"" behind to break into mainstream acting--just like Pamela did with Baywatch.
