Wanted: The Superfriends
overview: Lex Luthor uses a dream machine to control the unconscious minds of the Superfriends and make them commit crimes. Not knowing of Lex's influence, the heroes surrender themselves to the authorities. Bizarro and Cheetah have taken the place of the police and paralyze them and send them toward the Sun. Given free rein, the Legion takes over the Hall of Justice and use the Justice League satellite to transform all of Earth's inhabitants into duplicates of Bizarro and Cheetah to steal for them. The SuperFriends escape the trap when Superman spots a meteor and Wonder Woman telepathically controls her lasso to direct the cell's paralysis projector into the meteor's path. While the SuperFriends try to thwart the worldwide crime spree, Batman and Robin try to figure out how to reverse the transformation but are sent off a cliff by Bizarro-Alfred. They manage to escape at the last minute and finish their computations and reverse the polarity of the satellite and untransform everyone. They ambush

title: Invasion of The Fearians
overview: Captain Cold strikes a deal with the Fearinans that involve tricking the Super Friends into converting Earth's climate to something closer to Venus'. In return the Fearians take on the Super Friends. They suceed in trapping the Super Friends but Green Lantern tricks them into dropping the field by making himself and his comrades invisible.

title: The World's Deadliest Game
overview: The Legion lure Wonder Woman, Black Vulcan, and Hawkman away from Earth by cloaking it and get them to the Toyman's artificial planet within a black hole. While they try and avoid the Toyman's deadly games, the Legion has the Riddler lure the Super Friends to a deathtrap in the Grand Canyon, then to a planet in Orion's belt where a tribe of women try to petrify them. The Riddler's last clue leads them to the black hole planet which is about ready to close for good. Green Lantern and Superman combine their powers to escape and return to Earth where the Legion is collecting a ransom on the missing Super Friends, but the Legion escapes thanks to the cloaking device.

title: The Time Trap
overview: The Legion use Grodd's new time-travel device to loot the past and trap the Super Friends in 70 million BC (Black Manta and Giganta vs. Aquaman and Apache Chief), Arthurian England in 500 A.D. (Sinestro and Captain Cold vs. Green Lantern and Samurai), and Ancient Rome (Solomon Grundy and Gorilla Grodd vs. Batman and Robin). Aquaman buries his communicator in the past on the site of the Great Hall of Justice to activate it in the present and contact the Super Friends, and Superman breaks the time barrier to rescue them and then travels through time with a geiger counter to locate the other missing heroes. Then the Super Friends confront the Legion at Sutter's Mill in 1848 where they are planning a gold heist. The heroes easily defeat the villains who make a hasty escape with the pre-programmed time travel device.

title: Trial of the Superfriends
overview: Brainiac, Cheetah, and Scarecrow launch an attack on Batman, Robin, Wonder Woman, and Green Lantern as they guard a Liquid Light manufacturing plant to steal their power devices. The heroes are captured and the Legion place them on trial, while sending four android duplicates out with their devices to fight them. Bizarro and Black Manta then steal the Liquid Light and use it on a defenseless city, and Superman, Black Vulcan, and Flash battle them and try to stop the Liquid Light, which dissolves anything in its path. The Flash uses his speed to redirect the Liquid Light. Meanwhile, the captive Super Friends manage to outsmart their android duplicates, recover their devices, and join back up with the others to beat the Legion, which manages to make a quick escape.

title: Monolith of Evil
overview: The Legion find out about the Monolith of Evil from Solomon Grundy, who reveals it brought him to life. The Legion trick Superman, Black Vulcan, and Hawkman to go to the center of the Earth and recover the Monolith. The rest of the Super Friends battle the Legion equipped with the Monolith. However, it is neither good nro evil, but influenced by whoever holds it. Wonder Woman telepathically controls it long enough for the Super Friends to gain the advantage.

title: The Giants of Doom
overview: Bizarro comes up with a scheme to use three elements that will let them become giants. Sinestro already has the first element, then he and Sinestro split the moon open to get the second. Superman, Batman, and Robin capture them. The Toyman and Captain Cold launch an attack on the Parthenon to get the third element and Green Lantern stops them (while Aquaman cheerleads). Their capture is all part of the plan: Bizarro needs the SuperFriend computer to assemble the elements and create the giant-creating formula. The four giant-sized villains easily defeat the SuperFriends and Captain Cold freezes them in an ice block and sends them into Saturn's core. Batman's automatic utility belt defroster thaws them out and they escape gas monsters to return to Earth. Returning to Earth, Superman, Batman, Flash, and Green Lantern become giants themselves and thwart the giant-sized Legion villains. Of course, Luthor bails them out at the end and they all escape with the aid of a decoy Legion HQ.

title: Secret Orgins of the Superfriends
overview: Lex Luthor learns the origins of Superman, Wonder Woman, and Green Lantern and takes the Legion ship back in time to alter their origins. Cheetah sabtoages Wonder Woman's attempts in 1941 to become Wonder Woman at Aphrodite's request, while Lex Luthor takes the place of Hal Jordan and receives the power ring of dying Green Lantern Abin Sur. Those two missions compelted, the entire Legion deflect Kal-El's rocket to a planet with a red sun where he will grow up powerless. The remaining Super Friends are easy prey. While Aquaman, Apache Chief, Samurai, and Hawkman fight each other under the influence of Lex's hypno-ray, Batman, Robin, Flash, and Black Vulcan manage to escape and travel back in time to correct the past. The Flash sabotages Cheetah's winning the championship, Black Vulcan sends Hal Jordan on his way, and Batman and Robin deflect the beam meant for Kal-El's rocket with their Batplane. With their three most powerful members restored, the Legion is easily defeated by they esca

title: Revenge on Gorilla City
overview: After a failed takeover of Gorilla City, Grodd goes to the Legion for help. With the help of Brainiac's brainwave amplifier, Grodd takes over Gorilla City and his old nemesis King Solovar. Solovar flees and recruits Batman, Robin, Flash, and Apache Chief to help him. Black Manta captures them all and Lex Luthor strips them of their powers and Sinestro and Giaganta hunt them down with the mind-controlled gorillas. Superman, Wonder Woman, and Black Vulcan battle Black Manta, Toyman, and an army of mind-controlled gorillas who are invading the rest of Africa and manage to get themselves captured. Solovar and the Flash manage to nullify Brainiac's mind control device and the gorilla help the Superfriends to emerge triumphant although the Legion escapes again.

title: Swamp of the Living Dead
overview: On their day off the Legion terrorize an old woman wandering through their swamp. She summons an evil swamp demon to give them the power to create zombies if they deliver the SuperFriends to it. They do so by luring the heroes one by one to the swamp, starting with tricking in Batman and Robin with the Scarecrow disguised as Hawkman. When the real Hawkman shows up he and Green Lantern go to investigate and get captured as well. One by one the rest of the SuperFriends get captured. The Legion gets the zombie power and send their minions to rob a plutonium plant. But when they demand even more power and capture the swamp demon, they miscalculate and he turns the unstoppable zombies loose on the Legion and they are forced to aid the Super Friends to gain their help. The witch tells the Super Friends how to triumph - by tying them to dead trees with dead vines. The Friends capture the Legion but the witch helps out the other side to balance things out and the Legion escape once more.

title: Conquerors of the Future
overview: The Legion of Doom becomes the Legion of Good! But it's a distraction while they conquer the Earth of 3984. However, the Super Friends put together the Riddler's cryptic clues and Superman, Flash, and Green Lantern travel to the future to defeat them there.

title: The Final Challenge
overview: Wonder Woman and Aquaman are under attack by five of the Legion of Doom (Scarecrow, Riddler, Cheetah, Black Manata, Bizarro) in Black Manta's Manta-ship. Batman, Apache Chief, and Superman come to their aid, but they all disappear as the rest of the Justice League and Legion arrive. The missing members are teleported to a planet by a being called Vartu who places them in contests to end their battle once and for all. Batman and Riddler vie in a maze, with Batman winning. Black Manta and Aquaman must cross the Lake of Terror and Manta wins when Aquaman has to rescue him. Cheetah and Wonder Woman must climb a volcano and Wonder Woman wins. Apache Chief and Scarecrow must best a two-headed serpent and Scarecrow wins by being better with a lasso. Superman and Bizarro must stop a giant space robot with kryptonite beams and Superman wins. Vartu dumps the five Legion members into a pool of acid but the Justice Leaguers rescue them. While the missing members struggle against each other, the re

title: Fairy Tale of Doom
overview: The Toyman devises a way to transmit people into books. The Legion uses Brainiac, Cheetah, and Giganta to lure Superman, Hawkman, and Wonder Woman respectively into the storybook tales of Gulliver, Jack and the Beanstalk, and Alice in Wonderland, respectively. In each case the villains lure the heroes into some danger and then disappear. The other Super Friends figure things out and manage to open the portal just before the books would be sealed for good and defeat the Legion.

title: Doomsday
overview: The Legion of Doom launch an attack on an aircraft earlier. Green Lantern, Aquaman, and Apache Chief battle their Legion counterparts Sinestro, Black Manta, and Giganta and capture them when the other Legion of Doomers leave their comrades to their fate. Sinestro manages to escape from the Hall of Justice with the others and substitute anti-matter robots. When Superman touches them he is briefly transferred to the anti-matter universe of Qward and fights an anti-universe Krypton knight. Meanwhile, the three renegades steal a matter-transmutation device from the Flash and Black Vulcan. They use the device to gain revenge on their Legion of Doom comrades by transmitting them into bowling pins and billard balls before deciding things are even. With the aid of the device they manage to defeat most of the Super Friends but Superman manages to get to the transmutation device and stop it, leaving the Legion to be captured once more.

title: Superfriends, Rest in Peace
overview: The episode opens with...Batman's funeral! We soon find out that the Legion of Doom have a substance, Noxiam, that allows them to kill any Superfriend. In flashback we see Lex trick Superman into opening the krypton-steel box. Then the Riddler lures Batman into an ambush in Gotham City and kills him, leading to the funeral at the beginning. The Legion then takes the Daily Planet, Perry White, and Lois Lane hostage and kill Superman, and Paradise Island hostage to force Wonder Woman to confront them and be killed as well. The other Superfriends flee Earth but come back and are killed. Luthor then tosses the Noxiam into the sewer, its use at an end. A protectively garbed figure recovers it and shoots the crystal into space--it's Apache Chief. It's all a ploy to lure the Legion out. The dead Superfriends were actually robots.

title: The History of Doom
overview: Three aliens come to a ruined Earth. Travelling to the Great Hall of Justice, they find a series of memory tapes chronicling the Superfriends and the Legion of Doom. Although they find some origin tapes, they find nothing on the calamity that destroyed the Earth. They find the Legion of Doom HQ and discover that Luthor unleashed a solar flare that interacted with the Superfriends' planet-protecting shield, devastating all life on Earth. The aliens go back in time and alter the timeline with an eclipse so that the flare never makes it to Earth.

title: And Then I Wrote Happy Birthday to You
overview: Hector and Mac have their first day in the past and the caveman think they are evil spirits. They make good with a caveman's son and save his life. He wants to be an adult and the custom is to spend a day in the jungle alone. Hector and Mac suggest that instead of having this ritual they throw him a birthday party instead.

title: The Copper Caper
overview: Mac and Hector need to find copper to repair the space ship. Unfortunately, the only copper they can find is around Boss's neck, in his necklace.

title: The Initiation
overview: Mac and Hec decide to move into a cave but they must become tribe members first. The must perform a few customary rituals before they become tribe members.

title: Tailor Made Hero
overview: Mac and Hector are heroes to Breer after they rescue him from a blocked cave. Mac and Hector try to think of ways to get Gronk to look like a hero to Breer.

title: The Rainmakers
overview: There is a drought in the village, Boss decides to offer Mac and Hec as a sacrifice to the great Water Spirit.

title: The Courtship of Miles Gronk
overview: The astronaut visitors are troubled that Cavemen drag their women around by the hair as their form of courtship. And so, they do their best to institute modern, civilized courting techniques.

title: The Champ
overview: Not wanting to fight, Mac persuades Boss to choose a champion to represent the tribe against its neighbor.

title: Mark Your Ballets
overview: Hector takes a snapshot of Boss, who suspects the astronauts will use it to harm him and condemns them to death. The astronauts try to save their skin by convincing the natives to hold an election and remove Boss from power.

title: Have I Got A Girl for You
overview: Shad tries to find the perfect mates for the astronauts.

title: Cave Movies
overview: Before blasting off, Hector and Mac make movies of the cave dwellers using camouflaged equipment; Boss and Clon quietly watch in awe as the astronauts review their footage.

title: Androcles and Clon
overview: Hector and Mac make a model plane for Breer, but Boss denounces the plane as evil and orders Clon to bring the astronauts to him for judgement.

title: Love Me, Love My Gnook
overview: When a puppy trots out of the spacecraft, Hector decides to give it to Breer as a farewell present; the cave dwellers become petrified at the sight of the puppy, blaming it for all of the calamities befalling the village.

title: The Broken Idol
overview: While searching for aluminum ore with which to repair their spacecraft, Mac and Hector accidentally desecrate an idol to the fire god.

title: The Sacrifice
overview: Mac and Hector are dismayed to learn that Mlor is going to be sacrificed to the dinosaurs to guarantee the villagers' safety, and they beg Boss to abolish the barbarous custom.

title: King Hec
overview: When Hector warns the cave dwellers of an imminent storm, they shower him with adoration and give him the royal treatment.

title: The Mother-in-law
overview: Gronk's mother-in-law pays a visit and takes a heavy-handed interest in her granddaughter's personal affairs.

title: Which Doctor's Witch?
overview: Gronk becomes gravely ill on the eve of the tribe's big dinosaur hunt, and Boss performs a dance to cure him but to no avail.

title: To Catch a Thief
overview: Hector and Mac resolve to catch the real thief after being accused of stealing various items from the cave dwellers.

title: The Stowaway
overview: While blasting off, Mac and Hector discover cave-girl Mlor hiding behind an instrument panel in the spacecraft.

title: 20th Century Here We Come
overview: Hector and crew leave the stoneage and enter the 20th.

title: Shad Rack and Other Tortures
overview: Hector and Mac try to convince a General to come and meet the cave people. Meanwhile Shad, Gronk, and their family visit a beauty parlor and a clothing store to try to help themselves blend in better with other people.

title: The Cave Family Swingers
overview: A talent agent overhears the cave family singing in Hector and Mac's apartment and advises the family members to continue to rehearse their unique sound.

title: To Sign or Not to Sign
overview: Mac teaches Gronk and Shadd to write their names. With this new talent they sign up for things.

title: School Days, School Days
overview: Breer heads off to school for the first time and things seem to be going well. Then Gronk and Shad decide to check on their son, which leads to multiple misunderstandings and expulsion for Breer.

title: Our Brothers' Keepers
overview: Hector and Mac bring the cave family to the airbase to meet Gen. Morley as proof they traveled back in time to the Stone Age.

title: The Stone Age Diplomats
overview: Mac and Hector's landlord wants to kick out Gronk and family from their apartment. But the boys set-up a ruse that they are diplomats from a foreign country who simply dress differently and convince their actor friend to pretend to be the ambassador of the fake nation.

title: Owner Occupiers
overview:
Shelley, now in work, looks for somewhere to live with wife-to-be Fran and their impending child.

A visit to the local Bank leads them nowhere to getting a mortgage as they don't have a bank account.

title: Expletive Deleted
overview:
Shelley has to come up with a sales campaign for a new range of Instant Paella.

The stuff proves hard to market as it is virtually tasteless.

title: Tea and Sympathy
overview:
Shelley is working on an ad campaign for striped pyjamas when a crisis interrupts his train of thought.

A fellow lodger, Miss Landis, is so lonely and depressed in the big city she takes an overdose of sleeping pills.

title: Hearth and Home
overview:
Shelley and Fran are in their bed-sit as usual.

She is engrossed in a dog-eared copy of George Orwell's 'Keep The Aspidistra Flying' while he tries to strike up a conversation with her.

title: Fully Furnished
overview:
Shelley wants to buy an old book in a junk shop but the dealer tries to make him think it is worth far more than it really is.

After a protracted debate, the dealer agrees to let him have it for nothing.

title: Dearly Beloved
overview:
Mrs.H and Shelley's mother spend the night at Fran's Dad's palatial house in Shropshire.

Isobel's liberal attitude to life and free use of language clearly embarrass the host.

title: Of Mice and Men
overview:
Shelley and Fran are spending the night in their new house, which is undergoing renovation. Fran hears something scuttling inside in a bin liner and Shelley admits he forgot to throw the bag out.

Their debate on whether to dispose of the rodent mutates into a heated discussion on his job.

title: Signing On
overview:
Shelley is dragged back to reality as he endures a painful visit to the labour exchange to sign back on.

He's prepared himself well though for the rocky road that lies ahead but will his attempts to talk his way out of an honest day's work fall on deaf ears?

title: Nor Iron Bars a Cage
overview:
Shelley's efforts at DIY at the new house are starting to take shape, he's managed to put up a shelf in the kitchen at least.

All this hard graft though gets interrupted when his friend Paul comes to call and as usual is in a spot of bother.

title: Foreign Affairs
overview:
Shelley is still gainfully unemployed and his honest approach at interviews isn't exactly improving his job prospects.

When an opportunity arises for a plum job at the foreign office, Fran and Mrs H feel a slightly different approach might see him going places.

title: Universal Trust
overview:
With Fran busy at her ante-natal class, Shelley seeks solace in a cafe.

His peace is short-lived though, when he seems to attract the attentions of the local nutter.

title: Dry Rot
overview:
Shelley is busy rewiring the kitchen and installing spotlights though he seems to be getting into a bit of a tangle. Worse still, there appears to be a serious case of dry rot under the stairs.

Will some expert help enlighten him or leave him left with his wires all crossed?

title: You Have to Laugh
overview:
The day has finally arrived, and Fran is about to give birth. Things move fast and Shelley needs to rush to the hospital to be at her side.

Fran not only has to deal with childbirth but also with Shelley's incessant banter.

title: Unkindest Cuts
overview:
After a long period of inactivity, Shelley is psyching himself up for signing off at long last at the job centre with his new job at the foreign office waiting.

But, with government cutbacks announced, what could possibly go wrong?

title: A Drop of the Pink Stuff
overview:
Baby Emma won't stop crying, and Shelley and Fran are at their wits' ends. Mrs H soon comes calling, and suggests they seek medical help.

But, at this time of night, it may not be quite the professional help they'd hoped for!

title: No News is Good
overview:
Mrs H comes over to babysit Emma, allowing Shelley and Fran a rare night out together at the cinema. The film doesn't quite live up to their expectations, so they retire to the pub.

The only problem is, their funds are in short supply, and the topic of conversation soon turns to armageddon!

title: Credit Where Credit's Due
overview:
The utility billls are piling up in the Shelley household but, with his ongoing unemployed status still unresolved, the money isn't actually there to pay them.

Desperate measures are called for, Shelley gets himself down to the DHSS office to see if they can bail him out.

title: Mortal Coils
overview:
Shelley has a bit of a rude awakening in the morning - he's somehow pulled his back during the night.

After a visit to the library, and finally the doctor, he's still none the wiser as to the cause of his ailment.

title: Slaughterhouse Sling
overview:
Shelley & Fran are still struggling to pay the bills and their misery is compounded further when Shelley's former Uni friend Den comes to visit.

Not only does Den have a good job and a flash car, but rather expensive culinary tastes.

title: On the Road to Damascus
overview:
After Fran finally snaps and turns Shelley out on his ear, he turns to his best man Paul for help. Fortunately, Paul is going away for a year, and offers Shelley his empty apartment as a temporary home until he sorts himself out.

How will Shelley adapt to his new environment and new-found single status?

title: Brave New World
overview:
With the prospect of meaningful employment looking even more unlikely than ever, Shelley is left with no option other than to take up office temping work.

He goes along on his first day with an open mind and soon finds kindred spirits who seem to share his philosophy for a brave new world.

title: Shelley Versus Shelley
overview:
Shelley is dismayed when Fran starts divorce proceedings against him meaning they both have to hire lawyers.

But can his insatiable inability to get out of bed in the mornings really be grounds for a degree absolute?

title: Noises Off
overview:
Shelley is all alone in his eighth-floor flat on a Sunday afternoon feeling bored and going a bit stir crazy.

He thinks he can hear a strange noise in his living room which gives him a good excuse to get Desmond up to investigate.

title: Tubes Help You Breed Less Easily
overview:
Shelley's tube train gets stuck in a tunnel, and doesn't appear to be moving anytime soon.

With terminal boredom ensuing, he decides the best course of action is to break the ice with his fellow-travellers and give them the benefit of his ready wit and repartee.

title: When the Chip Hits the Fan
overview:
Shelley is still reluctantly looking for work so returns to the Easy Job Agency.

He's in luck, there's a vacancy for a deep-fat chip fryer at the Dust Bowl burger bar, and it seems he's the man for the job.

title: Dry Dreams
overview:
Shelley gets a surprise invite to his mum Isobel's place for lunch and not only that, Fran is invited too.

Will Isobel's attempts to get the estranged couple back together over the meal table bear fruit or will Shelley talk his way back into singledom?

title: It Nearly Always Happens to Somebody Else
overview:
Shelley comes home from a rare hard day's work to find his apartment has been burgled.

Despite the ever-presence of Desmond the security guard no one seems to have seen or heard anything.

title: Of Cabbages and Kings
overview:
Taking refuge in the local library, whom should Shelley run into but his old temping-job mucker Malcolm.

The two intellectual layabouts soon pick up where they left off, and start putting the world to rights with their verbal sparring.

title: The Party
overview:
Shelley's peace is disturbed by noise from a neighboring apartment, it appears there's a party going on.

Desmond comes upstairs to check what's going on but seems to be in more of a party mood than Shelley.

title: Owed to the Electrician
overview:
Shelley's back in 'advertising', although it appears he may have to work his way back up.

But that's the least of his problems, he's been overcharged for his electric bill and finds himself in a highly-charged situation.

title: Brief Encounter
overview:
Desmond's rather attractive young niece Anne-Marie comes to visit and Shelley takes rather a shine to her.

Could love be in the air for the old cynic or will this possibly romantic encounter end up all-too-brief?

title: The Artful Lodger
overview:
Shelley starts a job training in telesales but is still struggling to pay the rent.

Meanwhile, when an old friend drops by after years of living abroad, it seems that he will be even more financially stretched than ever.

title: Shelley Washes Whiter
overview:
Shelley's old friend Phil is now ensconced as his new lodger and is keen to assist in getting him a new job after getting him fired from his last one.

Will a coaching session on interview techniques really help Shelley or will he just use his usual skills to remain unemployed?

title: A Happy Event
overview:
Carol is convinced she's pregnant, and seeks Shelley's wisdom and advice as how to go forward.

Graham also seems to be a changed man but how will the perception of parenthood change things.

title: Born Freeish
overview:
When Shelley hears Carol and Graham's plans for early retirement he starts to realize he may have some serious thinking to do about his own financial future.

After talking things over with Phil, he starts to see things more clearly.

title: Day of the Reptile
overview:
Shelley'a flat is invaded by journalists from the Fleet Street gutter press, digging around for any dirt he has on a former university friend who is now an MP.

Will Shelley sell his story and make a quick buck or does his unbreakable social conscience give him other ideas?

title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
overview:
Shelley has spent a long and tiring day in his new job as a London tour guide, and is absolutely exhausted.

The trouble is, when he gets back to his apartment, it seems that all and sundry are determined to stop him having some well-earned shut-eye.

title: The Gospel According to Shelley
overview:
Shelley's new weekend job working behind the bar of a quiet pub is going as well as can be expected, until he gets a visit from Jeremy a member of the religious cult, the Christian Soldiers.

Will the brainwashed Jeremy have his head turned by Shelley's intellectual outpourings or could Shelley be in for a devil of a time.

title: Wages of Virtue
overview:
Shelley finds a wallet stuffed full of money dropped on the pavement and no indication as to whom the owner might be.

Could fortune be smiling on him or will he find to his cost that honesty is the best policy?

title: It's Only a Game
overview:
