Desperate and angry, Brandy makes a deal with the dictator lizard Gaspar: a way back to civilization in exchange for Mr. Whiskers as his dinner. In the end, she loses her way home, but truly gains a friendship with Lola Boa and Mr. Whiskers.

title: The Babysitter's Flub
overview: Brandy volunteers to watch a crocodile’s eggs for the day, but when Lola Boa and the Toucan Twins invite her to hang out, she leaves Whiskers in charge. It goes as well as expected with Whiskers losing the eggs and mixing them up with those of other animals. Now he and Brandy must retrieve the correct babies to avid Mama Croc swallowing them whole.

title: Cyranosaurus Rex
overview: Spring is in the air as Whisker’s falls in love for the first time: with a giant lizard, Isabel (Jennifer Hale). She wants nothing to do with the smelly rabbit, but Coach Brandy is determined that Whiskers can woo her. Meanwhile, Brandy has her own issues in fighting off a persistent little lemur (Charlie Adler & Jeff Bennett).

title: To the Moon, Whiskers
overview: While out star-gazing, the gang meets the cosmonaut monkey Boris (Greg Baldwin), having crash-landed into the jungle. Though his shuttle comes equipped with a rescue signal button, he refuses to push it and have the humans return him to space. While Brandy schemes to call for her own rescue, Mr. Whiskers is having fun playing spaceman and thwarting her.

title: Lack of Brains vs. Brawns
overview: Mr. Whiskers, being bullied by a cruel neighborhood monkey, must find the confidence to stand up for himself before it drives him away from Brandy. Meanwhile, Brandy is on a mission to increase her public image in the jungle. Instead, she learns the importance of standing by your friends, even the uncool ones.

title: The No Sleep Over
overview: Brandy is hosting a slumber party for girls only, kicking Whiskers out who forms one with Ed. Neither party is going too well until Whiskers begins a prank-war that quickly escalates into real trouble for everyone.

title: The Fashion Fascist
overview: Brandy wants to try to introduce fashion to the jungle. The jungle denizens proclaim Mr. Whiskers is a fashion genius.

title: Happy Birthdays
overview: It's Brandy's birthday though she is unhappy because it's her first birthday away from her family. She believes that it's also Whiskers' birthday as well.

title: Funky Bunny
overview: Brandy is preparing for the Harrington Ball, which is a formal dance that the Harringtons have every year, but with all the hard work she forgot to get herself a date! She has Whiskers, and teaches him some etiquette manners.

title: The Going Bananas Republic
overview: Brandy, disgusted with Gaspar’s dictatorship, riles the jungle dwellers to hold an election for king. She and Whiskers win the job, but quickly abuse the power just as bad as Gaspar, if not worse.

title: Lame Boy
overview: Brandy stumbles across a suitcase that they weren't aware of, she finds a portable video game and she gives it to Mr. Whiskers to get him to stop bothering her. In the end, he finally has to save Brandy from falling off a cliff.

title: Taking Paws
overview: Mr. Whiskers helps a jaguar named Lorenzo (Bobby Slayton), but when his driving Brandy and Mr. Whiskers at the hook they try to find a way to get Lorenzo out of their lives. Lorenzo invites his family, which Brandy puts a stop to. In the end, Whiskers helps another huge creature with the same problem.

title: Skin of Eeeeeeeevill!!!
overview: Brandy and Whiskers see a relationship therapist, Whiskers takes an exercise too far and pretends that he's Brandy, and vice versa. Everybody thinks this, except Brandy. In the end, Whiskers is back to his old self.

title: A Bunny on My Back
overview: An Ocelot named Artaro catches Brandy's fancy, in which they fall in love and plan to go out on a date. Mr. Whiskers feels that Artaro is actually evil, and he tries to convince Brandy to not go out with him but it turns out that Mr. Whiskers is actually right.

title: Lucky Rabbit's Feet
overview: When Mr. Whiskers finds out about luck, he believes his feet will provide him with the luck he needs to remain safe and get anything he wants, much to Brandy’s dismay.

title: Blind Ambition
overview: When Brandy introduces money into the jungle, she discovers its hard to live a life of luxury when you have to earn your finances. In the end, Whiskers pulls out what appears to be a huge emerald. Brandy exclaims that she is rich.

title: Dear Diary
overview: When Brandy tells Mr. Whiskers to read something because he has too much time on his hands, she inadvertently leaves her Diary out in the open, in which Mr. Whiskers reads because of her suggestion. After a while he starts to read everyone else's diaries, too. In the end, Whiskers gets tied upside down as punishment while Brandy befriends the spider who has about to devour him.

title: Less Than Hero
overview: Brandy is holding a food drive for the less fortunate, in which Mr. Whiskers wants to help out. However, when Mr. Whiskers accidentally ruins the food drive, Brandy needs to find a way to make it work out anyway. So Mr. Whiskers becomes a superhero after reading a comic, but when everyone says that he's a menace, he decides to become a supervillain.

title: Private Antics, Major Problems
overview: When Brandy and Mr. Whiskers try to eat the tastiest fruit in the jungle, Brandy finds out that the fruit tastes like dirty socks. As Brandy marches off in frustration, she kicks down an ant hill, leaving it exposed to the ant eaters who attack the hill on a regular basis. The Sargent Ant goes after Brandy to get her and Mr. Whiskers to defend the ant hill until the mound can be fixed, but will Brandy agree to join the ant army, and will she even be capable of defending the hill from the ant eaters, or not?

title: The Curse of the Vampire Bat
The Monkey's Paw
overview: While enjoying themselves at the river, Mr. Whiskers inadvertently crashes into Ed after Ed crashes into a log, which causes Mr. Whiskers to fly into a Mayan temple. Inside, they discover an ancient monkey's paw that grants wishes, in which Brandy decides to use to get back home; though the ancient artifact is much different than they anticipated.

title: A Tree Huggin' Bunny
overview: Brandy and Mr. Whiskers stumble across an old tree, in which Brandy learns that the tree is of a rare kind that is capable of building a vessel capable of getting her back to Florida. Brandy manages to convince the animals who live in the tree to move into her house so she can cut it down, but Mr. Whiskers is refusing to leave the tree because he feels it shouldn't be cut down. Will Brandy be able to get the tree cut down and get back to Florida or will Mr. Whiskers prevent her from even touching it?

title: The Big Game
overview: Brandy prepares for a big coco ball match against Gaspar Le Gecko's team, which is the best in the jungle. However, despite her attempts to train the team, Ed the Otter keeps messing up and causes the team trouble. Brandy knows that Ed will not do a good job during the big coco ball match and she needs Mr. Whiskers to cut him from the team, but will Mr. Whiskers be able to cut one of his best friends from the team or not?

title: On Whiskers, on Lola, on Cheryl and Meryl
overview: Brandy realizes that it's getting very close to Christmas, so in an attempt to try to get back home, she spreads the word of Christmas to the Amazon and they all prepare for his arrival, as Brandy thinks Santa would have no choice but to arrive if people are looking forward to him coming. However, when Santa does arrive, she realizes that he doesn't want to take her home, as she's been too naughty to gain such a reward; Brandy, in anger, tosses a lump of coal he gave her at him, which causes him to crash his sleigh into the ground. Now, Brandy must take on the mantle of Santa Claus and work with her friends to deliver presents to all the world's girls and boys, though will she shirk her responsibilities once she gets home to Florida like she plans?

title: Pedigree, Schmedigree
overview: With Gaspar Le Gecko's oncoming beauty pageant coming up, and the grand prize being a vacation to Palm Beach, Brandy decides to enter the contest so she can get home. But unfortunately for her, she stumbles upon documents that prove she was adopted into her lineage. Will she be capable of overcoming this knowledge despite the fact that she isn't a real Harrington, or will the fact that she's a mixed breed crush her spirits for good?

title: The Howler Bunny
overview: After Mr. Whiskers dirties up the house Brandy just cleaned, she decides that she has had enough of him and she kicks him out. While Mr. Whiskers tries to find a new family to live with, Brandy looks for a new roommate who will share her interests, but will they both be happy with their new lifestyles?

title: Bad Hare Day
overview: Mr. Whiskers accidentally destroys Brandy's favorite scarf when he barrows it in order to entice some boars. With Ed's help, Mr. Whiskers formulates a plan to shed his own hair and make Brandy a new scarf, but will Mr. Whiskers be capable of doing his plan, all the while keeping Brandy from finding out the truth?

title: Paw and Order
overview: When many of the jungle denizens have items go missing, all the evidence points towards Brandy. Brandy is arrested and sent to jail, though Mr. Whiskers vows to help find out who the real criminal is. But will Mr. Whiskers actually be able to prove Brandy's innocence, or is she even innocent at all?

title: One of a Kind
overview: When Brandy becomes friends with another dog, Tiffany Turlington, Mr. Whiskers begins to feel left our and jealous. He attempts to find a relative of his to get back at Brandy while Brandy enjoys her time with Tiffany, but will his attempts work?

title: Believe in the Bunny
overview: When Mr. Whiskers discovers that Easter is near, he becomes ecstatic and begins to celebrate. However, when he keeps Brandy up all night, she tells him that the Easter Bunny isn't real and it breaks his spirit causing Brandy to feel bad about him, but will she be able to find a way to make it up to him?

title: Bad Brandy
overview: Brandy and Mr. Whiskers have a try at the jungle's biggest sport, Leaf Boarding. Brandy feels she will be the best with her past experience in snowboarding, while Whiskers is afraid to even try the sport due to his overwhelming fear of plants that occurred during his youth. However, Brandy does horrible at the sport while Mr. Whiskers may just be the best Leaf Boarder in the Amazon. With the upcoming Leaf Boarding championship coming up, will Brandy manage to improve her skills or will she embarrass herself completely?

title: Two Heads Are Not Better Than One
overview: After Mr. Whiskers attempts to install a skylight into the house, nearly destroying it all in the process, Brandy insults him claiming that he doesn't think things out. When Mr. Whiskers consults Ed for advice, he goes to the Forbidden Swamp, obtaining himself a second head, one that is incredibly smart, polite and charming. While his new head is quite popular with the other jungle denizens, he himself begins to doubt that getting a second head was wise.

title: Trouble in Store
overview: Whiskers has been depressed recently and while they cannot find the cause of his depression, Brandy has an idea to cure his depression, an all out shopping spree! However, Whiskers becomes addicted to shopping and things get even worse then Gaspar gives Mr. Whiskers a Gaspar Card. Brandy, however, knows that credit cards are bad business, but will she be able to stop Mr. Whiskers?

title: Payback
overview: After Brandy and Mr. Whiskers get into a fight over Mr. Whiskers junk cluttering up the house, Brandy shoves Mr. Whiskers old meat in the back of his jump suit. However, when the meat attracts predators and Mr. Whiskers jumps off a cliff to save his life, he finds himself trapped. Brandy, with Lola's advice, goes and rescues him. Mr. Whiskers makes himself Brandy's personal servant until he can pay her back, but will Brandy really enjoy having Mr. Whiskers as her servant or will he end up driving her crazy first?

title: Mini Whiskers
overview: Brandy and Mr. Whiskers find a baby Tapir after their picnic gets ruined. Brandy decides to take care of the baby until they can find its parents and she leaves the baby in Mr. Whiskers' care until she can find out more about the child. However, when the baby begins to look at Mr. Whiskers for a role model, Brandy is upset because Mr. Whiskers doesn't grasp the concept and begins to teach the Tapir some poor behavioral choices.

title: Radio Free Bunny
overview: Mr. Whiskers is upset because he doesn't have many friends and is highly unpopular. However, when Mr. Whiskers inadvertently swallows a piece of a meteorite and turns into a living radio, he discovers that he may have just of found a method to become popular, though will he find popularity to be all it's supposed to be?

title: The Show Must Go Wrong
overview: Brandy and Mr. Whiskers discover a camcorder set while Brandy is trying to send out S.O.S. messages in a bottle. Brandy decides to make a quick movie and send it instead to increase her chances, but Mr. Whiskers gives her the idea to make a blockbuster as a rescue tape. Brandy buys into the idea instantly and Mr. Whiskers gathers a film crew from the jungle denizens, but will the movie production go as planned?

title: Whiskers the Great
overview: Mr. Whiskers has been depressed because he has been unlucky recently so Brandy decides to give him a simple task to boost his self-confidence, in which she requests he go pick a wild onion. Mr. Whiskers does so, but upon picking up the onion he is proclaimed the Great Grooter by a pack of wild rodents which increase Mr. Whiskers' confidence, though is it in the manner that Brandy wished for?

title: Freaky Tuesday
overview: Brandy is attempting to teach Lola Boa how to give a pedicure while Mr. Whiskers is attempting to become a one bunny orchestra. However, their two goals soon collide and they get into an argument. Lola Boa threatens Brandy and Mr. Whiskers into going to see a relations counselor, who suggests that they try role-playing as one another to express their true thoughts. However, when Mr. Whiskers continues to role-play when the two return to their home, things take an unexpected turn as all of Brandy's friends begin to believe that Mr. Whiskers is the real Brandy.

title: The Brain of My Existence
overview: When Mr. Whiskers falls out of the tree for yet another time, Brandy insults him, saying that he never uses his brain. However, Mr. Whiskers' brain agrees with her, so he decides to leave his brain and head off to live his own life. Mr. Whiskers begins to become depressed as he feels lonely without his brain inside of his head, so Brandy decides to head off to find Mr. Whiskers' brain in order to return it to the rightful place where it belongs, though how will she manage to convince his brain to go back to the place he hates?

title: Ida Makes a Movie
overview: When Ida Lucas' movie on garbage wins first prize in a competition, but the judges commend her film on war, she has to decide between accepting the prize, and owning up to the truth.

title: Cookie Goes to the Hospital
overview: When Cookie goes to hospital without her doll, Ida and Noel, having sworn a pledge of loyalty, have to get it out to her somehow, but the hospital is a pretty scary place.

title: Irene Moves In
overview: When Irene comes to live on Degrassi Street, Ida thinks she is just a little too friendly with Cookie. But Irene is not the only newcomer to Degrassi Street. Reports are circulating that Bigfoot has been seen in the neighbourhood.

title: Noel Buys a Suit
overview: When Noel's dad decides to get married again, Noel is not so sure he likes the idea. Gayle is ruining everything, changing the house around, and she does not like the terrific checked suit Noel has bought for the wedding.

title: Lisa Makes the Headlines
overview: What Lisa needs to make her newspaper is a real scoop. But when she does find some real news, she has to decide which is more important - the truth or family loyalty.

title: Sophie Minds the Store
overview: Sophie gets Chuck to help her out at her parents' store, but the cash is out by $20 at the end of the day. Chuck's father is in jail, so it appears that it must be like father, like son.

title: Casey Draws the Line
overview: When a new survey line goes through the pen of the rabbit Casey and Lisa share, too much arguing over rights makes them lose sight of their responsibilities - to look after Rabbit.

title: Pete Takes a Chance
overview: Pete always has his eye out for a money-making proposition, and he knows he has found a winner, but he just needs a little capital. However, his "investment" costs him more than he expected, when he puts his friendships on the line.

title: Chuck Makes a Choice
overview: Chuck has told Tina his dad is a pilot, but Pete insists on inviting their father to the school play. Chuck has to decide if the only way he can he hide the fact that his father is actually finishing up his time behind bars is by un-inviting him.

title: Billy Breaks the Chain
overview: Billy knows it will not be luck that sends him to hockey camp, it will be his own hard work. Then a bad-luck chain letter comes to him, and while he hesitates about passing on the bad luck, disasters begin to occur.

title: Catherine Finds Her Balance
overview: When both divorced parents want to come and watch her at the gymnastics meet, Catherine gets involved in some fancy footwork to prevent them from making a scene in front of the whole school.

title: Benjamin Walks the Dog
overview: Billy and Pete want to do grown up things, without Billy's pesky little brother, Benjamin. They finally get rid of him, but Billy has second thoughts when it looks like they might have gotten rid of him forever.

title: Liz Sits the Schlegels
overview: Liz finds she has her hands full when she takes on a babysitting job with two lively kids, and one who refuses to have anything to do with her.

title: The Canards Move Out
overview: Lisa simply does not want to leave Degrassi Street and move to Vancouver, but it seems no one will listen to her feelings on the subject. In fact, her feelings are so strong she is having trouble listening to anyone else's.

title: Martin Meets the Pirates
overview: Martin cannot believe the Pirates from Boulton Ave. want him as area lieutenant for their expansion to Degrassi Street - they are the toughest gang around. But he is not sure that he is that tough.

title: Connie Goes to Court
overview: When Connie returns five dollars Casey has dropped on the floor, Casey thinks Connie is contributing her share for the present for their teacher, and does not pay attention to Connie's explanations. Connie is not worried - she will be collecting for her paper route on Wednesday, anyway, and she can pay up then. But the paper goes on strike, and Connie finds herself in more trouble than she thought.

title: Griff Makes a Date
overview: No one really likes Griff - after all, he used to be a Pirate - but it does not matter much to him, until he meets Lisa, just back from Vancouver.

title: Samantha Gets a Visitor
overview: Samantha cannot wait for her city slicker cousin, Lisa, to arrive for the weekend. She is so sophisticated now she just knows that Lisa will be impressed.

title: Rachel Runs for Office
overview: Rachel is very keen to be her school's representative to the new City Hall Youth Council. She is interested in the issues and is ready to work hard. But Billy's break dancing and Pete's campaign management have put Billy well in the lead.

title: Jeffrey Finds a Friend
overview: Jeffrey is supposed to be the smartest kid in the class, and he is mortified when Connie, who claims she never studies, beats him on a math test - in fact, she bets that she can beat him on the next one, too.

title: Connie Makes a Catch
overview: Connie has her eye on Candy, the popular captain of the baseball team, but he does not even know she exists. She would do anything to catch his eye, and everyone has advice to offer, but being a "lady" is tough for a tomboy like Connie who would rather be playing baseball.

title: Karen Keeps Her Word
overview: Money is on everyone's mind as the yearbook is in desperate financial straits. But Karen is not remotely interested in the yearbook's problems, or in the class voting itself a nuclear-free zone. She has found a pair of roller skates that are destined for her feet - all she needs now is the money to buy them.

title: Ryan Runs for Help
overview: Ryan is always making up stories, and it is hard to know when he is telling the truth. But his best friend Benjamin is convinced of Ryan's tales of treasure when Ryan produces evidence - he actually has a gold coin he found. Even though he is grounded, Benjamin sneaks out to a construction site to investigate with Ryan, and ends up falling down a hole and cannot get out.

title: Martin Hears the Music
overview: Nobody wants to be different from everyone else, and Martin is horrified to discover that he is going to have to wear a hearing aid. And it certainly does not help that everybody starts acting so weird around him.

title: Lisa Gets the Picture
overview: The Yearbook needs pictures. Lisa sees her chance to spend some time with Griff when Casey comes up with a brilliant plan - Griff can draw caricatures of everyone.

title: Griff Gets a Hand
overview: Robin "Griff" Griffith is having trouble with schoolwork. He would rather be drawing pictures than studying, and when his friend Danny, the crossing guard, asks for a caricature of himself, Griff is determined to make it his best ever. But Danny suddenly dies of a stroke, and Griff just cannot stand that he did not finish the caricature in time.

title: Episode 1
overview: LEE LIK-KEUNG treats his colleagues some greasy food. His colleagues invite him to play mahjong at a clubhouse. As he is going to see his younger sister, LEE SUM-YING, dance, he cannot make it. Apart from him, the principal of Bo Bo Dance Sport Studio, TIK PO-PO, and her daughter, CHING KA-MAN, are also in the audience. PO-PO invites YING to teach at her school. YING, who has signed up for a dance troupe, turns her down. CHING KA-TSUN works at a beverage group. He wants to introduce to his big boss, YEUNG HON-TO, a new drink he has recently come up with but is stopped by his supervisor, CHENG KWOK-KUEN. KA-MAN’s housewife students are not happy with her teaching attitude. KEUNG and TSUN bump into YING at a supermarket. YING is hurt by the goods of the supermarket because of TSUN’s fault. As a result, her performance at the audition for the dance troupe is hugely affected. She is not giving up so easily though.… ...

title: Episode 2
overview: YING gets along very well with her students. They all appreciate her. YING’s motorcycle breaks down. TUSN happens to pass by and gives her a helping hand. Ironically they end up in a dispute. TSUN leaves both YING and her motorcycle. The Product Quality Department of Hei Yeung Yeung Holdings Limited is recruiting people. JUDY hopes KEUNG will employ her uncle. KEUNG replies that he will give a think about it. LAM tells KEUNG that her cousin, SHEUNG-TAT, is interested in the post. TAT goes to Hei Yeung Yeung for an interview. He makes a very good impression on KEUNG and is finally given the job. LAM would like to treat KEUNG to dinner to thank him. Just then, he gets an urgent call from YING and has to turn LAM down. It turns out that YING has arranged a blind date for KEUNG and PING, a good friend of hers. KEUNG calls TSUN for help. TSUN fawns on PING deliberately, making her believe that he is fond of her. PING asks TSUN out.… ...

title: Episode 3
overview: SZE-MAN’s mother holds a party at home to welcome the return of her daughter. Invited by her mother, SZE-MAN dances at the party. Her performance meets with loud applause. SZE-MAN is looking for a job, but her mother tells her to help out at Hei Yeung Yeung instead. She agrees unwillingly. SZE-MAN and YEUNG SING worship at a temple, where they run into SHENG. The three of them walk around the temple together. SZE-MAN is impressed by SHENG’s profound knowledge of Chinese culture. YING decides to take part in a dance competition to raise money for her studies abroad. KEUNG follows LAM. LAM settles her eyes on a crystal necklace. Later, KEUNG buys the necklace secretly and sends it to her company as an anonymous sender. LAM, however, thinks that it is from her old lover. She asks her ex-boyfriend out to thank him, who does not clarify the misunderstanding. TO and his staff go to a holiday camp.… ...

title: Episode 4
overview: TO has a heart attack. He finds it a pain that he has to be very careful with what he eats in future. KUEN demands his staff to all go for a body check-up. KEUNG refuses to so. He is marched to the hospital by TSUN in the end. YING takes a new look on TSUN when she sees him care so much about KEUNG. TSUN therefore tells her how his father had died from heart disease when he was still a child. PO-PO has difficulty in finding a partner for YING for the competition. LUN tells YING that KA-MAN has decided not to participate in the competition. He wishes that he could be her partner. YING accepts his idea. The doctor requests TO to take a leave and rest. TO wants SZE-MAN to take care of his business. LUN is going out with KA-MAN when YING calls. LUN lies to KA-MAN that something urgent has happened and he has to leave at once. KA-MAN follows him. She discovers that he is actually meeting YING to practice for the competition.… ...

title: Episode 5
overview: TAT has come up with a new drink. TSUN thinks very highly of it. On the other hand, however, he advises TAT to leave the company as soon as possible. TAT is confused. He asks LAM to see if she has any clue. LAM misconstrues that TSUN has learnt of the company’s lay-off plan. She goes to KEUNG. He guarantees TAT will not be sacked. SZE-MAN calls a meeting with KEUNG’s department. She requests everyone to each think of an idea. TAT points out that the company is too conservative. SZE-MAN appreciates him. KUEN deletes the file that contains TSUN’s new product and tells TSUN he is a good friend of TO. TSUN is very angry. PO-PO is designing a dance costumes for YING. KA-MAN accuses her of being impartial. YING apologizes to PO-PO for ruining her relationship with KA-MAN. PO-PO claims that YING has in fact do her a favor by rousing KA-MAN. SZE-MAN goes out with SHENG. They meet TAT. TAT tells her he will resign on his own accord.… ...

title: Episode 6
overview: In order to make YING lose and kick her out of the dancing school, KA-MAN makes YING an exhibition of herself at the dance competition. YING and SHENG come third in the end while KA-MAN and LUN forth. KA-MAN is angry. TSUN, YING and the other are celebrating when LUN calls and says that KA-MAN, who is drunk, is creating trouble at a bar. TSUN and PO-PO rush to where KA-MAN is. When they get there, KA-MAN is having an argument with a taxi driver. TSUN gives the driver some money to quiet him down. KEUNG is fired by SZE-MAN. Unwilling to reconcile, he swears to proof his innocence. He demands a colleague of his to put a tap in KUEN’s wallet. KEUNG is discovered by SZE-MAN when he is following KUEN. SZE-MAN finds out that it is in fact KUEN who uses inferior herbs. Without hesitation, she sacks KUEN. SZE-MAN invites KUENG and TSUN to return to the company.… ...

title: Episode 7
overview: LAM’s boyfriend, PO, promises to take her to Maldives for a holiday. Encouraged by this, LAM has been practicing extra hard. So is KEUNG, as he wishes to dance with LAM before she goes on the holiday. YING asks LAM to take her to PO’s gymnasium. She worries for KEUNG when she sees how PO cares for LAM. YING tells KEUNG how good PO is to LAM. KEUNG is disheartened. TSUN’s new product is very popular. SZE-MAN is glad. TAT bumps into SZE-MAN at a bookshop. She tells him her parents never allow her to eat street side snack. TAT takes her to a snacking spree as soon as he hears this. SZE-MAN is overjoyed. TAT’s colleagues celebrate for him. JUDY breaks LAM’s crystal accidentally, but LAM thinks that it is KEUNG who breaks it. PO borrows 200,000 dollars from LAM. YING discovers that PO is dating other women and that he is a womanizer indeed. She calls and asks TSUN to tell LAM all about this in no time.… ...

title: Episode 8
overview: KEUNG is disappointed both at work and relationship. YING gives him some words of consolation. When doing this, she takes the opportunity to ask him about TSUN’s marital status. KEUNG tells him that TSUN has chosen to be single. YING goes to the herbal teashop to see TSUN, only to be given the cold shoulder. JUDY learns about TSUN and TAT’s idea for the packaging of the company’s products. She proposes the ideas to SZE-MAN at a meeting before TSUN and TAT can do so. YING cares so much of TSUN that he does not know how to react. KEUNG sees everything. While TSUN has been busy with product design, KEUNG has been drinking his sorrows away. KEUNG, who was drunk the night before, is late for work. SZE-MAN is displeased. Provoked by JUDY, KEUNG accuses TSUN of taking credit for his achievement. TSUN has a date with YING again.… ...

title: Episode 9
overview: SZE-MAN and SHENG have a good chat over their lives overseas. TAT feels a bit out of the place. Knowing that TAT is in a bad mood, SZE-MAN gives SING’s helicopter model to him as present. SZE-MAN and SHENG apologize to SING. To tease him, SING demands SHENG to pay for his model, which costs a great deal. SHENG agrees. SHENG expresses his love for SZE-MAN, who accepts him readily. Hei Yeung Yeung is looking for a female model for its new commercial. TSUN is a bit surprised to learn that KA-MAN is on the recommendation list. SZE-MAN encourages KA-MAN to have a go at the audition. KA-MAN has outdone a famous artiste and won the cast. KA-MAN insists in using her own make-up artist. As a result, she is late for the shooting. The director flies into a fit of rage. SZE-MAN and TSUN suggest using YING instead. YING agrees unwittingly. KA-MAN does not show up until the shooting has already begun.… ...

title: Episode 10
overview: KEUNG believes that KA-MAN hurt LAM and YING deliberately. He swears to sue her. He also suspects that TSUN was also involved in this. LAM feels uneasy when she hears the sound of glass shattering. Luckily KEUNG is by her side. PO-PO and TSUN visit LAM. They tell her they will take care of all her medical expenses. LAM begs KEUNG to let KA-MAN off. KEUNG agrees not to report to the police. On the other hand, however, he requests KEUNG to do something unreasonable. TSUN gives YING a lift to the hospital for her follow-up. He takes very good care of her; she is very pleased. Some herbal tea products of other brands are accused of containing ingredients that are harmful to people’s health. Affected by the news, the turnover of Hei Yeung Yeung has dropped considerably. Everybody at the company is very enthusiastic in making suggestions to help boost the sales. They come up with the idea of producing a TV program.… ...

title: Episode 11
overview: YING would like to get a dance instructor license. She is supported by both PO-PO and KA-MAN. TSUN and YING have a date. Someone follows and pesters YING. TSUN therefore decides to be her partner so that he can help and protect her. Hei Yeung Yeung is organizing a “Dance Carnival” with a charitable organization. SZE-MAN appoints KEUNG and TSUN to be the persons-in-charge. TSUN gives YING a lift to her place after the exam. They bump into KEUNG on the way. KEUNG requests to go to TSUN’s house. The two men have a negotiation in the kitchen, where they almost have a fight. KEUNG’s colleagues tease him for his relationship with LAM. He makes up his mind that he will propose to her. KEUNG tries hard to look for a best time to propose to LAM. At the group dancing session he finally plunks up enough courage to do it. Everyone at the carnival supports his sudden move. Overwhelmed, LAM says “yes” in tears.

title: Episode 12
overview: SHENG gets an urgent call from Canada. He needs to go back to his family there as soon as possible. An idea occurs to SZE-MAN as she is seeing him off at the airport. She decides to open a branch along the MTR line. SHENG calls and tells SZE-MAN that he will not be able to return to Hong Kong and act as KEUNG’s best man as promised. SZE-MAN is hugely disappointed. Just when SZE-MAN is at her wit’s end as to how to design the new shop SING inspires her. She decides that her new shop will be minimalist. It is KEUNG and LAM’s wedding. As all guests are blessing the bride and the groom, TAT screws up his courage to express his feelings for SZE-MAN. She is turning him down when SHENG suddenly shows up. TAT did not realize until now that they are lovers. YING is awarded the certificate in dance teaching. She is a bit discouraged to see that the general public does not like dancing much.… ...

title: Episode 13
overview: The grand opening of SZE-MAN’s new shop is full of twists and turns. Fortunately, with the arrival of YING the artiste invited to perform the ribbon-cutting ceremony agrees to wait a bit longer. KUEN arrives with the intention to make a mess. His plan fails with TSUN and TAT’s collaborative efforts. SZE-MAN is fatigue with work. TAT accompanies her to the hospital. JUDY sees them. As a matter of fact, JUDY is KUEN’s lover. On his return from his honeymoon with LAM, KEUNG is a bit shocked to know that the launching of the branch shop, which he is responsible for, has already begun. With JUDY’s fanning the flames, KEUNG is even more biased against TSUN. SZE-MAN suggests selling soup at the shops. She asks KEUNG to take charge of the project. TSUN objects to her idea, saying that it will be too risky to do so now that the branch is still yet to open.… ...

title: Episode 14
overview: TO demands TSUN to tell him who is the people in charge of the soup project. TSUN stresses that it is a team project. TO blames KEUNG for not stopping SZE-MAN from developing too fast. KEUNG is fired. Misled by JUDY, KEUNG wrongly believes that TSUN has betrayed him for his own benefit. SHENG has been acting rather oddly recently. It turns out that he is already married with a five-year old daughter who has poor health. KEUNG runs into TSUN and YING on the street. He goes up to teach TSUN a good lesson. When he is home, he even requests his younger sister to leave TSUN. Irritated, YING tells him that she is moving out. WAI-KWAN, SZE-MAN’s mother, discovers that SZE-MAN is going out with SHENG. She hires a private detective to find out what kind of man he is. It hurts SZE-MAN to the core to see the intimacy between SHENG and his wife. SZE-MAN has a date with SHENG, who tells her everything honestly.… ...

title: Episode 15
overview: After learning that HO has tried to send away SHENG with money, SZE-MAN leaves home in anger. She puts up at YING’s for the time being. In the evening, SZE-MAN, who is rather lonely, looks at the moon. TAT gives her some words of consolation. The two also dance together. KWAN finds out that SZE-MAN is staying at YING’s. She visits SZE-MAN. She gives KEUNG a check of 300,000 dollars for the renovation of the apartment to make it a more comfortable place for SZE-MAN. SHENG takes SZE-MAN to see his daughter and his wife, ANITA. The meeting turns out to be a very awkward one. The workers of Hei Yeung Yeung’s factory in the mainland are staging a strike. With much mediation, TSUN finally manages to settle it down peacefully. TO appreciates his good work. He decides to take back his decision to invite KUEN back. On the other hand, KUEN, who is now working for another company, is caught once again for embezzlement. He is sacked.… ...

title: Episode 16
overview: After thinking about it very carefully, SZE-MAN has made up her mind to leave SHENG. At the last moment, nevertheless, she does not dare to tell him her decision. TAI takes SHENG to SZE-MAN and makes him tell them who is woman he loves the most. In the meantime, SHENG receives a call telling him that ANITA has been sent to hospital. SZE-MAN proposes to break up with SHENG. He expresses frankly that he is not willing to. SZE-MAN retorts that he is already heavily indebted to his daughter. After dancing a last dance, SZE-MAN leaves without turning her head. TO visits an old employee of his with TSUN. It so happens that KEUNG is now the security guard of the building in which that employee lives. TSUN and KEUNG have a verbal fight. TSUN and YING are taking part in an amateur dancing competition. TSUN is very nervous. YING tries all she can to calm him down. TSUN keeps making mistake. They fall on to the ground.… ...

title: Episode 17
overview: LAM tells TO that SZE-MAN has fallen ill. She is so careless to reveal to him that SZE-MAN is planning to start her own business. TO takes this very seriously. He asks LAM to steal SZE-MAN’s proposal. LAM is so clumsy that she fails to do so. When practicing, KA-MAN surprises everyone by saying that she is not partnering with LUN anymore. PO-PO follows KA-MAN. She discovers that KA-MAN is learning dancing from AMANDA, the prestigious dancer. PO-PO forgets herself and tells KA-MAN to go home with her. PO-PO used to learn dancing with AMANDA many years ago. AMANDA seduced their teacher, who was already married, and ruined his family. She had to leave Hong Kong in the end when PO-PO exposed what she had done. KA-MAN is moving out when PO-PO and TSUN are home. PO-PO tries but fails to stop her from moving to AMANDA’s place. AMANDA goes to PO-PO’s school with her students to challenge her to a dance fight.… ...

title: Episode 18
overview: TO is glad to see that SZE-MAN has been doing quite well at work. Though he does not say it, he appreciates her effort in his heart. YING’s vision blurs suddenly when everybody is having a good chat but she does not pay too much attention to it. LAM tells her friends that she might be pregnant. Everybody gives her their blessings. It turns out later that LAM has enterogastritis and has put up on weight instead. To lose the few pounds gained she decides to dance hard. SING meets up with SZE-MAN, during which he requests her to go to his place to celebrate his birthday. The birthday dinner ends up in discord as SING argues with his daughter over some trivial matter. The business of the dancing school has dropped considerably since PO-PO was injured. To make things even worse, AMANDA is trying to rent the school from the landlord.… ...

title: Episode 19
overview: KEUNG withdraws at the last minute. SZE-MAN is enraged. In addition to consoling her, TAT expresses that he will keep his promise to follow wherever SZE-MAN is. CHRIS, SZE-MAN’s business partner, decides not to cooperate with her all of a sudden. This comes as a big strike to her. Overstressed for too long, SZE-MAN collapses at last. She cries in TAT’s arms. SING and other colleagues have arranged a date for TO and SZE-MAN. The father and daughter dance together. They both grasp the opportunity to apologize to each other. YING’s eye problem is getting worse and worse. She goes to have a check-up. It turns out that her retina has detached. If she does not have an operation as soon as possible she may go blind. She asks SZE-MAN to keep this a secret so as not to affect her competition. AMANDA is also busy preparing for the competition. She teaches KA-MAN some dirty tricks.

title: Episode 20
overview: SZE-MAN advises YING to withdraw from the competition. TSUN has also learnt of the news. YING lies to him that her eye problem is now under control so that he will not be detracted. During the competition, YING loses her sight temporarily suddenly. Determined to redeem the reputation of the dancing school, she refuses to give up. Neither YING nor KA-MAN’s team wins any place, but YING and TSUN are given a special award for their performance. After the defeat, KA-MAN realizes that AMANDA has been using her to revenge her mother. She and AMANDA have a fight. In the midst of the chaos, KA-MAN pushes AMANDA down the stairs. AMANDA is seriously injured. Feeling helpless, KA-MAN calls her mother. During her recuperation, YING keeps pressing TSUN to marry her. TSUN says that he will propose to her when Hong Kong snows. YING does not know whether to cry or laugh. TAT expresses his love for SZE-MAN once again.… ...

title: The Drug Store
overview: Bud and Lou find jobs in Fields' drugstore and nearly wreck the place. This episode opens with the famous "Jonah and the Whale" routine.

title: The Dentist's Office
overview: When Lou gets a toothache he attempts to get arrested so he can receive free treatment while incarcerated.

title: Jail
overview: Lou damages Mrs. Crumbcake's waterpail and she drags him into court claiming .79 cents in damages. In jail, Lou's crazed cellmate becomes enraged whenever he hears "Niagara Falls."

title: The Vacation
overview: Bud and Lou head off to the Biltmore Hotel near Phoenix for a vacation. "Hertz U-Drive" and the "Pack-Unpack" routines are performed.

title: The Birthday Party
overview: Lou throws a birthday party for himself, but nearly poisons his guests when he puts ant paste on his hors d'oeurves instead of anti pasto. Bud throws him out and Lou consoles himself by ordering a giant decorated cake.

title: Alaska
overview: When news arrives that Lou's uncle has struck gold in Alaska, Bud and Lou plan to help him spend it.

title: The Vacuum Cleaner Salesman
overview: Bud and Lou visit an employment agency run by Mr. Fields' brother, who gives Lou a job selling vacuum cleaners door to door.

title: The Army Story
overview: Bud and Lou join the Army, where they recreate their routines from the feature film 'Buck Privates.' "Drill Routine" and "Dice Game" are performed.

title: Pots and Pans
overview: Working as a door-to-door cookware salesman, Lou prepares a dinner for his friends in hopes of moving some product. However, his honest culinary efforts are met with disaster.

title: The Charity Bazaar
overview: Bud and Lou participate in Hillary's charity bazaar, raising money with the "shell game." Lou blows his money at the kissing booth.

title: The Western Story
overview: Bud and Lou accept Hillary's invitation to visit her uncle's B-Bar-Bop ranch.

title: The Haunted House
overview: Hillary will inherit a castle if she spends one night there. Bud and Lou come along with her for protection and Lou is scared out of his mind by frightful encounters.

title: Peace and Quiet
overview: Lou sleeps all day but can't sleep at night. Bud takes him to see a psychiatrist. Eventually Bud checks him into a sanitarium for a night's rest. "Crazy House" is performed.

title: Hungry
overview: Bud and Lou visit a couple of restaurants. In one they become involved with twin waitresses. In the other, Lou has a battle with an oyster.

title: The Music Lovers
overview: Lou attempts to impress Hillary and her father with his musical abilities. While pretending to perform, Bud falls asleep and ruins the scheme.

title: The Politician
overview: Bud coaches Lou on running for public office, a political campaign that ends with Lou delivering a disastrous speech in a neighborhood park.

title: The Wrestling Story
overview: Lou and Stinky agree to settle their differences with a wrestling match. When Stinky becomes ill, his little brother Ivan the Terrible takes his place.

title: Getting a Job
overview: Bud and Lou are hired to deliver hats to the Susquehanna Hat Company on Floogle Street and encounter several lunatics on the way. Also, Stinky attempts to kill Lou by backing him into traffic. The "Loafing" routine is performed.

title: Bingo the Chimp
overview: Mike the Cop tells Lou that he must have a license for his pet chimp. But Lou accidentally applies for a marriage license.

title: Hillary's Birthday
overview: While shopping for Hillary's birthday present, Lou nearly destroys a grocery store. Later, at her party, Mr. Fields becomes upset about the noise.

title: The Television Show
overview: Lou is a contestant on a TV quiz show where he wins a pack of bubblegum. Their neighbor slips on a piece of gum and takes them to court.

title: Las Vegas
overview: Bud and Lou pay $90 for a car and head for Las Vegas, where Lou takes part in a violent game of billiards. The "mudder/fodder" routine is performed.

title: Little Old Lady
overview: Bud and Lou attempt to help an old lady who has been evicted. They raise $300 and she uses the money to bet on a racehorse.

title: The Actors' Home
overview: Bud is taken away to an old actors' home where he and Lou perform their famous "Who's on first?" routine.

title: Police Rookies
overview: Mike the Cop helps Bud and Lou enroll in the Police Rookie School, where Lou blows up the gymnasium while playing with a hand grenade.

title: Safari
overview: When Bingo gets sick, the whole gang travels to Africa to find his parents.

title: The Paper Hangers
overview: To pay back rent, Bud and Lou attempt to wallpaper an apartment. Later, as waiters in a restaurant, they brawl with hoodlums.

title: Uncle Bozzo's Visit
overview: Lou's eccentric opera singing uncle comes to stay with the boys for a couple of months.

title: In Society
overview: A wealthy society matron pays Bud to attend a formal reception and impersonate the Duke of Gluten. Lou comes along pretending to be his cousin, the Earl of Waldo.

title: Life Insurance
overview: Mr. Fields takes out an insurance policy on Lou. Later, Bud takes Lou on a hunting trip, and Lou suspects Bud and Mr. Fields have plotted to kill him for the insurance money.

title: Pest Exterminators
overview: Bud and Lou are pest exterminators mistaken for psychiatrists when they attend to Mrs. Featherton's "aunts."

title: Killer's Wife
overview: When a heavyweight prize fighter named Killer thinks that Lou is having an affair with his wife, Bud attempts to get Lou trained and fit in a gym.

title: Cheap Skates
overview: Bud and Lou accidentally buy a crate of roller-skates, not knowing that they have stolen diamonds hidden inside.

title: South of Dixie
overview: Lou accidentally lands himself and Bud roles in a Civil War melodrama.

title: From Bed to Worse
overview: Bud and Lou attempt to plant a backyard garden in order to win a cash prize offered by a civic group.

title: $1,000 TV Prize
overview: Lou wins a $1,000 dollar prize pretending to be Mr. Fields. He then has to get Mr. Fields out of the way so he can collect it.

title: Amnesia
overview: Lou is in love with a girl he has never met. As a gag, Bud and his friends convince him that he has already married the girl. The woman who poses as his wife then makes his existence miserable.

title: Efficiency Experts
overview: Bud and Lou land jobs as efficiency experts, and are assigned to restrain their client’s daughters from spending money. The young women, however, get the boys to buy them expensive dresses and take them to a casino, where they end up in a brawl.

title: Car Trouble
overview: When Lou wins a car, Bud sells it to buy a cheaper one, using the profits to try to finance a vacation in Flint, Michigan.

title: Wife Wanted
overview: When Lou finds out he will inherit $10,000 provided that he has a wife, he tries to marry a former girlfriend—who is dating a man named Bonebender Brodsky.

title: Uncle from New Jersey
overview: When Mr. Fields is just about to evict the boys, Bud convinces him that Lou's Uncle Ruppert is a millionaire and Lou is the sole heir. Complications arise, however, when Mike the Cop begins to believe that the visiting uncle (Lou in disguise) has been murdered.

title: Private Eye
overview: After receiving his private eye diploma from the Watchdog Correspondence School, Lou helps a friend locate some valuable bonds in a haunted house.

title: The Tax Return
overview: Lou receives a tax refund check for $1,000,000. He takes the check to a bank and demands cash. He is subsequently followed by home by crooks.

title: Public Enemies
overview: Lou is mistaken for a crook named Dapper Dan and is forced to take part in a robbery.

title: Bank Holdup
overview: Bud and Lou unwittingly take jobs as armed bodyguards for a couple of hoodlums and assist in a bank robbery. They use their share of money to pay their rent, and later try to get it back from Mr. Fields' safe.

title: Well Oiled
overview: Bud and Lou help Mr. Fields, who is being threatened with a lawsuit. Lou poses as a Texas millionaire to help discredit the complainant.

title: The Pigeon
overview: Bud and Lou's beautiful next door neighbor uses Lou as a decoy to help break up with her mobster boyfriend.

title: Honeymoon House
overview: When Bud and Mr. Fields help Lou put together a prefab house in order to impress his fiancée and her parents, a jealous former boyfriend sabotages their work.

title: Fencing Master
overview: A mad scientist's experiment convinces Lou that he is indestructible.

title: Beauty Contest Story
overview: When Bud and Lou judge a beauty contest, pressure is applied to sway their votes.

title: Fall Guy
overview: Bud and Lou want to take two sisters on a date but their father convinces the boys to put an antenna on his roof instead.

title: Barber Lou
overview: Lou tries to give Bud a rubdown following instructions from a radio show, but he's tuned into a program explaining how to paint a car at home.

title: Wind Surfing Lesson
overview: Danni's wind surfing teacher develops a crush on Gidget, and she must find a way to set him straight without hurting his feelings

title: The Project
overview: Gidget tries to make a plain girl look beautiful for a school dance.

title: Crime and Punishment
overview: Gidget must punish Danni after she repeatedly doesn't obey, and lets a friend use Gidget's and Jeff's credit card.

title: On Account of Dani
overview: Dani starts her own business in order to make enough money to buy an expensive stereo.

title: Fighting City Hall
overview: Gidget starts a campaign to save a local park after it is ordered destroyed by the planning board, which Jeff is a part.

title: The List
overview: Danni attempt to finish a household chore list in order to go on vacation to Balboa.

title: Jeff's Anniversary
overview: Jeff perseveres with his monotonous workout in the ball cage with the ""old standard pitching machine"" but wishes he had a real human being to challenge him.  Being that it's Jeff & Gidget's 8th wedding anniversary, Gidget exhaustingly tries to get the most amazing gift of obtaining professional baseball pitcher Jerry McGibbon (Jeff Yagher) to pitch to Jeff.

title: The Concert
overview: Gail's band delights a children's birthday party as their first 'gig'.  During the party, Danny joins the band bringing vocals and sparks an interested talent-scout from a TV show (Rock Hunt), which progresses the band to audition.  A musical metamorphosis starts to take place in the band so that it leads ""some"" of the band members down a selfish, uncompromising path that excludes the only band member who really has the composing talent, Gail.

title: Super Gidget
overview: Gidget and Jeff try to improve themselves.

title: 65 Mustang (a.k.a) Jeff Wins A 65 Mustang
overview: Jeff wins a '65 Mustang in a radio contest, but has it stolen just after getting the car.

title: Stand Up And Cheer (a.k.a) Danni Becomes A Ceerleader
Princess Kushinada
overview:
To the dismay of the TAC, Kaede Kunikida suddenly disappears. Meanwhile, the young school child Momiji Fujiyama is attacked by a strange man, hellbent on killing her. But why is he doing this?

After surviving the attack, Momiji's school is filled with monsters, but the strangest thing of all is that people think she's some sort of princess.

title: It's Cruel! It's Mysterious! It's My Destiny!
overview:
Things get even more confusing for poor Momiji when a man named Mamoru Kusanagi arrives, but when she learns that he is there to protect her from these strange monsters (Aragami), she feels safer. Little does she know Kusanagi hasn't decided to save her or sacrifice her.

Meanwhile, the TAC rush to the scene with an experimental creation that may defeat the terrible Aragami.

title: It's Spring, It's the Capital, I'll Do My Best!
overview:
After being sent to Tokyo, the Aragami-target Momoji discovers that she is now under the care of the TAC. She knows these monsters are terrible, evil things, and really wants to help, but can't find out how to.

The TAC soon discover that their base isn't as safe as they thought when an Aragami breaks in and attacks.

title: More Bad Luck? Why Does This Always Happen to Me?
overview: Rule-altering TAC member Kome Sawaguchi is angry when she is stuck babysitting the newest addition the team, Momiji Fujiyama. Soon the team discovers that Momiji's blue seed can track down Aragami and something terrible may occur soon.

title: Surprise! She's the Mother of Science!
overview: Kusanagi is outraged when Mrs. Matsu-Daira sees Momiji as a live specimen, free to experiment on her. Just as Momiji is about to confront Kusanagi on the threat he made to the lady and her son, a strange jellyfish emerges from Tokyo Bay and things heat up.

title: Complicated and Hard to Understand! Being a Man Puts You in Such a Difficult Position!
overview:
TAC Member Yoshiki Yaegashi feels that the others seem to help out a lot more and that he is not needed, and when kind-hearted Momiji tries to help out, she discovers something about him that she could've lived without knowing.

After trying to help Yaegashi restore his confidence, the two set out to track town an Aragami.

title: I'm Fired Up! I'll Do It! Because I'm the Kushinada!
overview: Angered Momiji sets out to rescue a kidnapped little girl. Unfortunately, the girls father is a man who studied Kaede (Momiji's sister), and the kidnapper is asking for extra material.. Material that can help the Aragami defend themselves from Momiji.

title: What? How Strange! A Rival Appears!
overview: Sakura Yamazaki has just returned from her stay in America, and the priestess considers Momiji Fujiyama an enemy. Sakura thus challenges Momiji to a singing contest -- at a studio with a number of Aragami attacks.

title: Are You Serious? Is This a Dream?! An Exciting Date!
overview: Dire Tokyo is being stalked by mutated dogs, but the TAC and their friend Kusanagi are doing nothing to defeat them. Soon the group discovers that they are being mysteriously killed, and to catch both the dogs and the killer, Kusanagi brings Momiji out on what he told her was a date, little does she know it's a plan to save Tokyo.

title: Innocence! Love! My First Kiss?!
overview:
Another Aragami is again terrorizing Tokyo, and this time it's a fire-breathing frog who has his eyes on the subway system. When Momiji confronts the Aragami, she meets Muramuko, an evil man who almost brings her life to an end.

Kusanagi arrives just in time to give her mouth-to-mouth, or what she considers 'a kiss', and faces off with Muramuko.

title: Irritating! Jealous?! Unbelievable!
overview: Momiji is horrified when Sakura is transferred to her school, and to top it off, she finds that Sakura and *her* love Kusanagi are spending time together. Meanwhile, girls at Momiji's school are being found dead, their blood sucked from them. That sure ices the cake!

title: Can You Feel It? I Can't Ignore It! An Ominous Premonition of Catastrophe!
overview:
Poor Momiji Fujiyama is having a terrible time trying to keep up in school AND work at the TAC, but when her wounded love arrives at her window needing treatment, she happily takes him into her home.

Meanwhile, the TAC investigate a strange centipide that has a habit of wrapping itself around large skyscrapers and leaving it's (icky) skin all over the place.

title: I Love You! This Is Extreme! It's Time to Confess!
overview: The TAC decides to lend love-struck Momiji a hand with dating advice and tips on how to confess her love, but everything goes wrong and she is called to witness the rebirth of the Aragami God Susana-O and the return of Kaede -- her sister.

title: A Chase Down Yamato Highway! Love Under Fire!!!
overview:
While Kaede and Muramuko rush away with Susana-O, trees all over Japan begin to wither and die, causing a national uproar. Meanwhile, at the resort of Nara, a new type of Aragami are terrorizing the land by polluting the air with toxic pollens.

Disheartened Momiji, distracted Yaegashi and the rest of the TAC team set out to destroy the pollen monsters with their newest invention.

title: Lost and Trembling on a Trip to Michinoku!
overview: The team journeys to the countryside to investigate more on the reappearing Kappa sea monster, meanwhile Momiji is concerned over a classmate of Kaede's words. How can a being such as perfect as Kaede be defeated by her? How can *SHE* win!?

title: Japan Is a Paradise! Tears in Wakasa!
overview: Kunikida heads out to investigate the death of his old friend, and is greeted by his young wife who holds a deadly secret. Meanwhile, deformed bodies begin piling up as sightings of the ""Thousand Year Nun"" (a strange woman who would stay young forever by devouring the flesh of a mermaid) are reported.

title: Let It Bloom, Japan! A Blizzard of One-Sided Love!!
overview: Distraught Kunikida becomes obsessed with his work, and the beautiful Takeuchi tries to help him, but fails to completely comfort him. Meanwhile, both Momiji and Kusanagi are worried about the ritual that is soon to take place, the ritual that will increase the power of Susana-O.

title: Geez! Oh, Man! Sakura's Not Good Enough?!
overview: When Susana-O's power disturbs Nozuchi, a powerful Aragami, Sakura's past is dug up, revealing that Nozuchi killed her mother long ago. Momiji Fujiyama, along with the help of the TAC, come to the aid of Sakura, but are helpless to prevent Nozuchi from swallowing Sakura. Inside the stomach of the monster, Sakura makes a horrifying discovery -- her mother is still alive.

title: Heat Haze! Love, Start on a Journey! I Won't Be Far From You!
overview: After the powerful Kaede envelopes an abandoned city in a dome of energy, Kusanagi wonders in and finds himself trapped, causing Momiji to come in after him. But when Kusanagi is overtaken by his daydreams, Momiji is helpless to save him.

title: I'm Home! Izumo! The Prologue of Hope!
overview: As reports of monster sightings and complaints of giant plants appearing everywhere busy the TAC, Kunikida heads off to Izumo, hoping he can uncover this mystery. Meanwhile, Momiji finds her mother, Moe, but begins having thoughts of Kusanagi, who is off fighting Susana-Oh, Kaede, and Muramuko.

title: Good Bye? No Way! A Tearful Farewell?
overview: The battle rages on as Momiji's mother, along with Kunikida, finally confront Kaede and Susana-Oh. Meanwhile, Momiji and Ryoko find Kusanagi fighting, but before they can help him, he is defeated by Muramuko.

title: Sadness! Fate! Momiji Kushinada!
overview:
The prime minister grudgingly decides to sacrifice Momiji in order to save Japan from the growing Arigami infestation. Momiji, still grieving over the loss of Kusanagi, accepts her fate and goes with the government to be sacrificed.

The TAC isn't quite ready to give up on her just yet. Takeuchi and Kome go to rescue Momiji. Momiji refuses to go at first, saying that this is her destiny. But Takeuchi slaps some sense into her (literally) and reminds her of what they are fighting for.

The three TAC manage to escape thanks to some unexpected help from Sakura and her pink sea creatures. As they are leaving, Momiji's mitama begins to glow. She can sense Kusanagi!

title: Meeting Again! Starting the Journey! I Won't Lose!
overview:
Momiji and the TAC take refuge in Sakura's apartment in order to avoid the goverment long enough to find a way to handle the Arigami. Sakura confirms Kunakida's suspicions--the US can't help until they are specifically asked for assistance by the Japanese government, due to the terms of the joint-treaty. The TAC hopes that the apartment is inconspicious enough that they will be able to continue their Arigami research without disturbance. Unfortunately, that isn't the case. Murakumo shows up. Yaegashi is wounded trying to protect Kome, and Momiji is carried off by Murakumo.

Murakumo takes Momiji back to the place where Kaede and Susano-oh are residing. He hopes to use Momiji to get to Kaede, who he now wants to kill. His plans are interrupted by Kusanagi. A battle ensues. Kaede saves Momiji, whose mitama is lost (but retrieved by Kusanagi.) The giant mitama is Susano-oh's resting place begins to shake violently. Thanks to his new mitama, courtesy of Momiji, Kusanagi is able to fly them

title: The Setting Sun! The Coming Day! A Private Time for Each of Us!
overview:
Kusanagi pays the prime minister a visit and delivers a special package--a cell phone from Kunakida. With it, Kunakida tries to convince goverment officials that the TAC can eliminate the Arigami without sacrificing Momiji. He asks that they at least give the TAC a chance to save Momiji's life. The prime minister reveals that that Momiji's pictures were released to the press by an Arigami spy in the government, whom they have been unable to identify.

Meanwhile, Japan is in an uproar. Volcanos are erupting everywhere and plants continue to grow at incredible rates. The people want the Momiji to be placed in custody, and they are angry with the goverment for being unable to do so.

Progress continues on the Kushinada pulse, and the TAC discovers that the secret to the Kushinada's blood is somehow involved in the strange melody that both Momiji and Kaede resonate. Momiji remembers that Kaede spoke of the rite of matsuri, and asks to be taken to the place where the ceremony is held.

Kunakid

title: All or Nothing! Decision! My Fate!
overview:
It's dawn and the TAC is preparing for the final battle. The team prepares the Kushinada pulse amplifying machine while Momiji prepares herself for the Rite of Matsuri.

With less than an hour until the solar eclipse, Kaede begins the ceremony by touching a sword to the field around Susano-oh. Susano-oh begins to mutate into a big, ugly nasty beastie.

Meanwhile, the Prime Minister is being persuaded by his aide to lie to the people of Japan to keep them calm and under control. The Minister goes on television, but instead of lying to the people, he tells the truth.
