Twenty contestants head to Buenos Aires to take on some seriously hard challenges in the hope of getting their hands on 10,000 pounds and the magnificent Total Wipeout trophy.

The Qualifier is comprised of some fiendish hurdles to cross, including the famous Big Red Balls and the Sucker Punch - both poised to send the contestants flying into pools of water and mud. Crash Mountain and Dizzy Dummies cut the line-up down even more before the final challenge awaits.

The show finishes with the Wipeout Zone, where things get really competitive in order to win the money, trophy and a lifetime of admiration.

title: Series 4, Episode 7
overview:
Richard Hammond and Amanda Byram host the biggest, the best and most outrageous gameshow on televison. In this episode the North of the country take on the South in a battle to win the coveted trophy and cash prize, as well as bragging rights for the rest of eternity.

Twenty intrepid Brits travel to Argentina to pit their wits against huge foam-based obstacles including the Big Red Balls and the Sucker Punch. Crash Mountain slims the field down to twelve before the final five take on Dizzy Dummies in order to win a place in the final round. Night falls and the Wipeout Zone gets underway, but who will come out on top - the tough as old boots Northerners, or the Southern fairies?

title: International Special
overview:
Total Wipeout goes truly global for the very first time, as a hand-picked team of British contestants go head-to-head with a hand-picked team of contestants from the rest of the world. As ever, the hand that picked both teams didn't know what it was doing.

Richard Hammond is your giggling, non-partisan host as British brilliance on the world's craziest obstacle course is put to the test by the finest athletes from Germany, France and the USA, amongst others. Amanda Byram is course-side in Buenos Aires with a fistful of foreign phrasebooks to ensure that she can laugh at all the contestants with equal enthusiasm.

title: Series 4, The Final
overview:
Total Wipeout, the biggest, brashest and most exhausting game show on television is back for more bangs, bumps and bruises.

Finalists from throughout the series return to compete for the ultimate title - that of series champion. They pit themselves against some of the hardest obstacles of the series as well as each other, setting Total Wipeout records left right and centre on their journeys to get to the Wipeout Zone.

It is without doubt the most exciting show of the series, with some of the best action the programme has ever seen - and there is a healthy dose of laughter along the way.

Will one of the already crowned champions walk away with the trophy and prize money, or will one of the runners up get their revenge? It's a thrilling ride to find out!

title: Series 4, The Awards
overview:
Some people believe that the Oscars mark the highlight of the awards season, while others would argue the Baftas are the most exciting event of the year. However, most would agree that Total Wipeout - The Awards provides the biggest laughs.

This programme encompasses all of the best action of the series. It celebrates people getting punched in the face by the Sucker Punch, it applauds people falling off the Big Red Balls in style and it revels in people spinning off Dizzy Dummies. All of this as well as recognising that some contestants deserve praise for doing really rather well.

Richard Hammond is once again ready to present the contenders such awards as the Close But No Cigar award, the Finest Face Plant prize and the Outstanding Contribution to Mud. The show culminates in the biggest prize of them all: Best Presenter. Will Richard steal it from co-host Amanda Byram in his quest to win it two years running?

title: Series 4, Celebrity Special
overview:
Richard Hammond presents an extraordinary new game show.

Crashes, smashes and hilarious mud splashes are on the cards as ten celebrities from the world of sport, music and television take on one of television's largest and most extreme obstacle courses. They journey across the globe to the purpose-built Total Wipeout course in Argentina to put their strength, balance and bravery to the test in the hope of winning 10,000 pounds for charity.

Contestants include ex-footballer John Fashanu, Big Brother winner Chantelle Houghton and party boy Calum Best.

title: Celebrity Special 2
overview:
Ten celebrities, including Blue Peter presenter Andy Akinwolere, actress Ali Bastian and rugby legend Martin Offiah, take on the might of Total Wipeout. Richard Hammond hosts in the studio, whilst Amanda Byram is by the side of the course, ready to laugh at Olympic athlete Dean Macey in the mud, or H from Steps getting smacked in the face on the Sucker Punch.

The Qualifier sees someone break the record for the fastest time ever seen on any Total Wipeout. Crash Mountain witnesses even more celebrity smashes and bangs, and Dizzy Dummies whittles the field down to just three. They are the trio to tackle the Wipeout Zone as darkness falls. Who will win the ten thousand pounds for charity, and who will be flying home with egg on their famous face?

title: Episode 1
overview: Contestants include an accountant, a professor of science and an Obi-Wan Kenobi lookalike.

title: Episode 2
overview: Contestants include a vicar, a prison manager and a farmer from Glamorgan.

title: Episode 3
overview: Contestants include a pair of quarrelsome neighbours, a Thai boxer and a police officer.

title: Episode 4
overview: Contestants include an over-excited trainee maths teacher and an ageing rocker from Kent.

title: Last Chance Saloon
overview: Richard Hammond and Amanda Byram guide 20 Brits through the perilous obstacle course.

title: Episode 6
overview:
Stand by for foam-padded action. It's another high-octane, low pain threshold edition of crazed knockabout game show Total Wipeout. Richard Hammond, as your host, will be arching an eyebrow at the ludicrous antics of 20 more over-excited contestants, who have thrown caution to the wind - and will have to be cautious if they don't want to be winded - on Argentina's famous Total Wipeout course.

From the side of the course, co-host Amanda Byram will be stifling laughs as contestants bravely tackle the Sucker Punch with added paint power, the brilliantly bouncy Big Red Balls and the disaster waiting to happen that is Double Cross.

Four rounds of torment and terror, mud and mayhem are worth it for one lucky contestant though, as he or she will be crowned the Total Wipeout champion and pocket a cheque for £10,000.

title: Episode 7
overview:
Richard Hammond and co-host Amanda Byram return to guide 20 foolhardy Brits through the biggest and daftest obstacle course in the universe. From giant hammers that smack them in the face to the Shapeshifter, via the Big Red Balls, each contestant braves the Qualifier to attempt qualification for Double Cross.

From there, the field is halved and those 'lucky' enough to make it through to Terror-Go-Round face it head-on in an effort to get to the Wipeout Zone. Darkness, raging torrents and fire bursts lie between the finalists and the chance of winning ten thousand pounds. Who will get their hands on the coveted Total Wipeout trophy?

title: Episode 8
overview: Hopefuls including a wannabe singer and a tennis coach take on the famous course.

title: Episode 9
overview: Finalists from across the series return to compete for the title of series champion.

title: Episode 10
overview: Special programme honouring the heroes of Total Wipeout's fifth series.

title: Celebrity Special
overview: Ten celebrities take on one of television's largest and most extreme obstacle courses.

title: Celebrity Special
overview: Ten celebrities take on one of television's largest and most extreme obstacle courses.

title: David's Cousin
overview: David's cousin Boojie promises to take him to Dublin, but when Boojie falls in love it seems like the promise will be broken. Special appearance by Steve McQueen.

title: The Singer
overview: When Rosie demonstrates a degree of singing talent, Molly is convinced that she should take voice training and struggles to raise the money for the lessons.

title: For the Money (1)
overview: A suspicious accident puts a young oil rig worker in the hospital. Marina pulls Tom out of jail and places him undercover at the rig to find out what happened. As he and Marina close in on an elaborate oil investment scam, another accident sends their investigation in a new direction.

title: Sunny Side of the Street
overview: Claude assigns Marina to a private corporate espionage case - someone is stealing secrets from a local ski lift firm. Tom and Marina follow a trail of stolen garbage straight to a motel room full of secrets.

title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
Member of the House
overview: Marina sends Tom to infiltrate a politician's organization as a volunteer campaign worker.

title: Royalty
overview: Tom and Marina tumble into a messy case of corruption on a native reserve. To smoke out the criminals, they design the perfect sting - and convince Jack to pose as a dirty judge.

title: The Grand Alliance
overview: Davidson takes a bullet when he and Tom surprise a would-be bank robber.  Tom and Marina decide to investigate this little bank in the foothills - leading them into a snake-pit of money laundering   and international crime.

title: Water
overview: Marina needs Tom's help to get the goods on a crooked real estate developer, but he is too busy settling old scores.

title: Episode 1
overview: MO NGA-LIK, ALEX, product designer of the Research & Development Department of Goaltech Scientific Ltd., is not only talented but also very popular among his colleagues and boss. His four proteges, who are known as A4, even regard him as their good friends. His girlfriend, LING LING-CHING, works for an NGO. MO KIN-YEE, KIN, ALEX’s younger sister, works at an insurance company. An aggressive member of the “post-80s” generation, her dream is to buy a flat of her own. CHI WING-HAN, VIOLET, manager of the Administration Department, is picking the receptionist up the second ALEX walks into the office. He decides to teach VIOLET a lesson. Senior Marketing Officer MAN KA-WA, STEVE, went to the same secondary school as ALEX. He has worked at Goaltech for 10 years. STEVE has a difficult time being teased about when he is meeting a client with his boss……

title: Episode 2
overview: VIOLET calls her secretary, HOI-KEI, telling her to tell STEVE to come to see her. He does not know until he runs into ALEX that VIOLET wants to see both of them. According to her, their promotion proposals have been shelved. ALEX, STEVE and A4 plan to complain to SAM. ELAINE, the departmental secretary, has managed to find out about which hospital SAM’s wife, CHAN OI-LIN, IRENE, is staying. Taking her advice, ALEX and STEVE make a dash for the hospital but they do not see SAM. VIOLET has hired a private nurse for IRENE. It turns out that the nurse, whose name is WONG SHUI-SHUI, is not only her cousin but also her mole. VIOLET is not happy that STEVE’s new car is more expensive than hers. DICKSON requests that KIN ask NING-CHING to work for him after learning that the latter is a friend of socialite MRS. SZEMA’s. If KIN fails to do so, he threatens, she will be given the axe……

title: Episode 3
overview: A MR. DIU, who STEVE suspects is a homosexual, wants to rent a room. STEVE does not think he will make a good tenant, but for money’s sake he has no choice. STEVE is molested by a homosexual at a convenience store. And then a man with a moustache follows him. It turns out that the man is INDERPAL SINGH, STEVE’s Indian school friend who was born in Hong Kong. Some twenty years ago INDERPAL returned to India as per his parents’ request but he has come back to look for a job. STEVE puts him up for the time being. DICKSON makes things difficult for KIN again. YIU YEE-LONG, AARON, a member of A4, helps her out. KIN wants to resign. When NING-CHING learns that DICKSON has been menacing KIN, she agrees to join her insurance company. SAM tells ALEX to call on his flat in the evening to report the progress of a product research. ALEX knows that this will be a good timing to complain against VIOLET. MRS……

title: Episode 4
overview: VIOLET, after being informed by her mole, sneaks into SAM’s study to seduce him. ALEX is taken in instantly. SAM plans to invite GILBERT CHAN, a well-known marketing people, to be the Marketing Director of Goaltech. VIOLET, who is assigned to take care of the invitation, turns to FRANCIS, Manager of the Finance Department, for advice of how to ruin the plan. CHAN CHING-LOY, IRENE’s father who lives in Thailand, has come to see IRENE. He treats SAM very badly and even hits him. No matter how badly he is treated, SAM dares not say a word. His father-in-law’s attitude towards him reminds him of how IRENE used to treat him. The idea of becoming MRS. KO comes to VIOLET’s mind when SHUI-SHUI tells her SAM does not want to see her wife wake up. INDERPAL sees through DICKSON’s crafty scheme and decides to expose his mask. NING-CHING sees DICKSON bribing INDERPAL.

title: Episode 5
overview: KIN and ARRON get along very well. She likes him even more when she learns that he is her favorite blogger “MR. GET AHEAD”. STEVE is thrilled when KIMURA’s assistant calls to fix a time for them to sign the contract on Friday evening. ALEX and his colleagues all think that they should keep the matter a secret. VIOLET demands ALEX to submit a sample product that uses nano anion far infrared synthetic technology but he pays no attention to her. A friend of INDERPAL’s sells second-hand electrical appliances to India for a living. Seeing this, INDERPAL hawks the used electrical appliances he gets from ALEX’s flat. NING-CHING is upset when she learns that he has sold ALEX’s weather forecast instrument as well. SAM runs into ALEX. VIOLET grasps the opportunity to mention the nano anion far infrared synthetic technology. As a result, SAM tells ALEX to explain the technology to him in detail the day after tomorrow……

title: Episode 6
overview: ALEX and STEVE have both received a warning letter. If VIOLET ever picks at him again, ALEX declares, he will quit for sure. STEVE believes VIOLET has planted a mole in the company. STEVE’s flat is stuffed with used electrical appliances which INDERPAL took home. INDERPAL nearly sets the house on fire as he is fixing an oven. DIU has a heart attack because of the false alarm, and he decides to move out as soon as he has been discharged. KIN and her friend CHOW LEI-LEI go to a job fair together. She is hugely dejected that she does not get an offer. VIOLET suggests reducing staff but SAM does not find it a good idea. She wants to express her love for him but the sudden appearance of IRENE’s younger brother, CHAN SHUN-MO, ruins her plan. SAM is going to Germany on a business trip. He decides not to take ALEX along this time. SHUM HEI-MAN takes INDERPAL for STEVE’s driver……

title: Episode 7
overview: LING-CHING cannot believe she is employed. She wants to tell VIOLET that ALEX is her boyfriend but VIOLET must dash for the airport. KIN goes to a real estate agency to look for a flat. She recommends herself to the manager, HO CHING-CHIK, as soon as she learns that they are hiring people. CHING-CHIK tells her to get a certificate of registration for real estate agent first. STEVE’s mobile phone is running out of battery. Inspired by LING-CHING’s casual remarks, he comes up with a special charger that can charge up any battery. KIN asks AARON on the Internet for interview tips. His reply is “compliance”, which works. SAM asks ALEX about the progress of the research and development of far infrared products. ALEX tells his boss he is currently working on a product named “ES”. SAM therefore tells him to go all-out to work on the new project. STEVE would like to invite HEI-MAN to their wedding……

title: Episode 8
overview: HEI-MAN’s appearance at ALEX’s wedding makes STEVE believe he will become her boyfriend. To his disappointment, she is only attending the wedding on behalf of her boyfriend, DR. SHING KA-YAN. SAM announces that a Germany is interested in Goaltech’s products and that its owner will be coming to Hong Kong. LING-CHING decides to postpone their honeymoon so that ALEX will be able to meet the German client. ALEX appreciates her thoughtfulness. VIOLET has returned from overseas. SAM gives her a ride to the office. Everybody in the company jumps to the conclusion that she is SAM’s mistress. STEVE’s car is missing. He suspects that it must have been stolen. It turns out that INDERPAL is using it for his illegal car hire business. VIOLET is unfamiliar with ES products. SAM therefore decides she needs not meet the German client. She, however, decides to turn up at the meeting anyway……

title: Episode 9
overview: ALEX and LING-CHING are surprised to learn upon their return that VIOLET is taking a three-month’s leave and that SAM is taking care of her responsibilities. On the other hand, SAM hopes that LING-CHING can take charge of the Marketing Department for the time being. VIOLET tells SHUI-SHUI to keep a close eye at what happens in SAM’s flat. KIN and CHING-CHIK go to a new residential property to look for business. KIN dashes out to the road to stop an incoming vehicle by force so as to secure a business. CHING-CHIK disapproves of her unorthodox way of making a sale. KIN runs into AARON at lunch. Once again, he leaves a very good impression on her. LEI-LEI borrows AARON’s phone with the excuse of having left her phone at home, her intention in fact is to find out about his number. SAM has forgiven VIOLET. She will resume her post of Administration Department Manager after her recovery……

title: Episode 10
overview: ALEX receives a call from STEVE at 6 o’clock in the morning telling him to go to Shum Shui Po, where he and INDERPAL have recently opened a juice shop. KIN dashes out to the road again to try to get a business but CHING-CHIK stops her. Quoting sources as saying that major developers in town are going to acquire dilapidated premises in To Kwan Wan, CHUN, who is the boss of KIN and CHING-CHIK, requests his agents to try to acquire as many flats in To Kwan Wan as possible. SAM is out of town. ALEX plans to apply for a few days’ leave but LING-CHING hands him an ES project progress form, telling him to speed up the research and develop progress. An old woman is selling her flat at a very low price. CHING-CHIK finds that it is indeed a haunted apartment, but KIN believes it is now or never. AARON is interested in KIN’s investment plan. He borrows money from a finance company so as to take part in the plan……

title: Episode 11
overview: Business of the juice shop has been quiet. STEVE meets INDERPAL’s cousin RAJA when he is distributing fliers. According to RAJA, INDERPAL had promised his mother that he would work at RAJA’s company before he returned to Hong Kong. That’s why he is working for him now. The girl who works at the juice shop is called JUICE. Her boyfriend, BROTHER SMILING, has borrows a knife from the shop. The knife is covered with bloodstains when he returns it to the shop. STEVE and INDERPAL are almost involved in a lawsuit because of this. LING-CHING has discovered the tracking device. She changes her position so as to keep a closed eye at ALEX. Taking LAU TSUN-TUNG’s advice, STEVE treats new recruit SIS FONG very badly. On the other hand, with a view to cutting down operational cost, he takes Goaltech’s stationery for the private use of the juice shop. STEVE’s recent disinclination to work arouses LING-CHING’s suspicion……

title: Episode 12
overview: The babies on the TV catch LING-CHING’s eyeballs. ALEX takes the opportunity to ask whether she would like to have a baby of her own. He is thrilled to bits to see her typing a resignation letter. But when she tells him what will come with the birth of a baby, he decides to give up the idea. LING-CHING tells RYAN to stalk STEVE. It takes STEVE quite an effort to get rid of him. When he finally arrives at the juice shop, he discovers that SIS FONG has stolen many fruits from the shop. KIN learns by chance that GRANNY WONG is CHUN’s auntie and that they have conspired together to coax her into buying the haunted apartment. SHUI-SHUI sees VIOLET, who has just resumed work, typing a resignation letter. VIOLET explains that is because she does not see any prospect in the company. She drops the idea of quitting the next day when KAR PO-PING, one of the shareholders of Goaltech, shows up……

title: Episode 13
overview: Great aunt’s 90th birthday is round the corner. ALEX plans to buy her a gold peach but KIN, who cannot even make ends meet, cannot afford it. He blames her for not telling him that she is going out with AARON. STEVE is very upset to hear that he will not be promoted. LING-CHING cheers him up, telling him the position of marketing manager is not taken yet. RAJA’s company is like a prison to INDERPAL. STEVE tries to help him out but to no avail. KIN is short of money. Her colleague suggests that she borrow money from CHING-CHIK. TSUN-TUNG’s mistress is pregnant. She calls on him suddenly. As a result, LAI leaves in anger taking their son away. STEVE has wound up the juice shop. It comes as a blow to him when upon his arrival at the company, when WILLIAM announces that GILBERT CHAN will take up the position of marketing manager. VIOLET gets hold of the financial situation of Goaltech with the help of KAN SZE-SZE……

title: Episode 14
overview: KIN learns by chance that AARON has cheated her for many times. She suspects it was a pack of lies that he borrowed money with a view to helping his family members. STEVE has bought GILBERT a pot of orchid the first day he reports duties, only to be told that he is toadying the wrong person. LAI discovers that the bills have not been settled, neither have the staff been paid. In a letter TSUN-TUNG has left, he tells her she can do whatever she likes with the restaurant. SHUI-SHUI informs VIOLET that WILLIAM wants IRENE to go for a brain surgery. As such, he would like her to continue taking care of his wife. KIN hopes that AARON can help her out with the decoration of her new house. She leaves in anger when he turns her down with another make-up excuse. ALEX can see that KIN is upset about AARON. Pouring her heart out, she insists that it is not her fault but AARON’s. VIOLET tries to access to the company’s confidential date……

title: Episode 15
overview: LAI is negotiating with MRS. CHIU, her landlord, when TSUN-TUNG appears suddenly and demands to take their son away. INDERPAL stops him with a trick. As a result, he is late for work and given a telling-off by RAJA. This time, he asks LAI to help him out. STEVE learns from the nurses that a couple, both of whom are doctors, have recently broken up. Mistakenly believes that they are talking about KA-YAN and HEI-MAN, he grasps the opportunity to express his love for HEI-MAN. AARON is jealous of ALEX. VIOLET drops him a hint that he can always quit. CHU PAK-TAK of Up Technology invites AARON to take charge of the Research and Development Department of his company with a handsome remuneration. He hopes that AARON will persuade the other three members of A4 to join him too. Goaltech has to pay KIMURA ten million dollars because of an unexpected incident……

title: Episode 16
overview: VIOLET tells PO-PING in her flat that A4 have decided to join Up Technology. As Goaltech is short of flowing capital, SAM needs to take out a $10,000,000 mortgage to pay for IRENE’s medical fee. At a director’s meeting, PO-PING suggests retaining A4 with money, adding that he will inject $50,000,000 to Goaltech at one go. SAM turns down his suggestion though. ALEX has been making things difficult for A4. LING-CHING helps them out by teaching them how to get out of their plight. STEVE and RYAN joke about a client’s peeing difficulty in the washroom. GILBERT happens to be in the washroom and so believes they are teasing him. Everybody but STEVE in the Marketing Department gets a good pay rise. INDERPAL introduces MR. GILL, who used to work at a high-end hotel as chief chef, to LAI. SAM announces at a meeting that their German client is coming to Hong Kong soon……

title: Episode 17
overview: A4 hope that PAK-TAK will agree to make a payment in lieu of notice to Goaltech for them so that they can leave. To their disappointment, he avoids seeing them. ALEX looks for STEVE at a bar to see how he is doing. STEVE feels that he has had enough of Goaltech that he wants to quit desperately. As for ALEX, he is of the impression that whether Goaltech will survive or perish depends entirely on him. AARON visits KIN. ALEX blames her for still seeing AARON. PAUL and the other two members of A4 have been away from their desks for a while for no apparent reason. ALEX finds it strange that when they show up again, they are able to tell why ES has been down. Later, he discovers that LING-CHING has been helping them. He accuses her of not trusting him. AARON calls on KIN again. This time ALEX gives him a punch as well as showing him the door. KIN is so mad about her brother that she decides she might just as well leave……

title: Episode 18
overview: KIN feels that AARON’s quality of life has been affected because of her apartment. As such, she plans to sell it but CHING-CHIK thinks the otherwise. RAJA has booked INDERPAL’s mother a ticket to Hong Kong, leaving INDERPAL with no choice but to continue to work for him. INDERPAL and his friends put their heads together to see how to get rid of RAJA. KIN is afraid of ghosts. CHING-CHIK offers to buy her flat at the price of $800,000 even though she is only asking for $500,000. She thanks him for his generosity. ALEX blames LING-CHING for telling SAM ES’s problems, believing this is the reason why SAM has lost his confidence in him. She feels that the gap between them is getting wider and wider. The business of the restaurant has improved. TSUN-TUNG appears out of nowhere, telling LAI she can have the restaurant to her own if she agrees to go for divorce and give him $500,000. Or else, he says, the restaurant will have to fold……

title: Episode 19
overview: KIN and CHING-CHIK quit together when she discovers at last how CHUN made her into buying the haunted flat. The value of her flat has appreciated a lot after CHING-CHIK has bought it. When KIN is not around, AARON demands him to compensate them the difference. When she learns his unreasonable request, she tells him her agreement with CHING-CHIK, assuring him that CHING-CHIK has not taken any advantage of her. STEVE writes TSUN-TUNG a check for $500,000. LAI tears it as soon as she finds out that STEVE has borrowed money from a finance company. SAM asks A4 about the progress of ES. ALEX jumps to the conclusion that he now thinks very highly of the foursome. AARON has emailed ALEX photos taken of him without his knowledge. ALEX is very upset about the photos. KIN comes to know AARON’s plan to torture ALEX. ALEX, STEVE and INDERPAL have a glass of two together……

title: Episode 20
overview: LING-CHING knows very well that ALEX can end up in prison for selling the information of ES. On the other hand, it is against her principles if she keeps the matter in the dark. VIOLET has learnt about the matter. She demands that STEVE shift the blame onto ALEX. LING-CHING decides to resign and then hide away. ALEX did not realize until then that how much she cares about him and what a difficult position she has been in. Unexpectedly, he sees her in the street. After telling her how difficult days have been without her, he comes up with a solution for ES. CHING-CHIK has found a new job. He employs KIN as his assistant. ALEX’s project is almost complete when he finds to his horror that ES’s programme has been destroyed. He blames AARON for doing it, but the latter points the accusing finger at ELAINE. Finding AARON’s behavior unusual, ALEX decides to follow him. JOHNNY is in VIOLET’s place when PO-PING calls in suddenly……

title: Episode 21
overview: SAM is grilling VIOLET when AARON appears out of the blue. Left with no choice, she hugs AARON, lying to SAM that they are going out with each other. The truth has come out at last. SAM finally realizes that everyone has been conspiring with PO-PING to ruin the ES project and to get Goaltech. PO-PING celebrates his success with VIOLET, SZE-SZE and AARON. He announces that once he makes Chairman he will promote AARON to manager of the Research & Development Department. VIOLET gives IRENE a memory stick, in which stores a video of SAM saying he wished she would never wake up. IRENE is heartbroken. Now that the ES demo has been lost, there is nothing SAM and ALEX can do to talk the German client into doing business with them. PO-PING is taunting SAM when IRENE, who has recovered her memory, shows up to show her support to SAM. ALEX and A3 work day and night to try to work out a solution to ES’s problem……

title: She's Like A School In Summer...No Class
Sometimes It's Hard Work Getting Fired...
The Mysterious Spider Man
overview: Takeshi Hongo, a young scientist boasting of an IQ of 600 and a racing prodigy, is abducted and his body surgically remodeled by Shocker, an evil secret society plotting for global domination.

title: The Terrifying Bat Man
overview: Hongo wins the championship, but the model who brings him his bouquet suddenly bares her fangs and attacks! With growing suspicion, Hongo investigates the woman's home, and finds it has been transformed into a lab.

title: Monster, Scorpion Man
overview: Shocker tests their mysterious Scorpion Man by releasing their slave workers and telling them that they can have their freedom if they can escape within 10 minutes, but one by one they die at the Scorpian Man's hands.

title: Cannibalism, Sarracenian
overview: At an amusement park's botanical gardens, people begin to go missing. The young boy Kenji's older sister Yukie gets snatched away, and he tries to tell someone that his sister was attacked by a giant King Sarracenian!!

title: Monster, Mantis Man
overview: While a series of strange earthquakes are going on, Hongo is contacted by his childhood friend and seismologist, Amemiya Chikako, who tells him, “Something is planning to cause a major earthquake.”

title: Grim Reaper, Chameleon
overview: Former navy lieutenant-commander Sunada is attacked by the Chameleon Man. His aim is a submarine model in Sunada's possession that has secrets relating to a Nazi treasure concealed inside.

title: Duel With Grim Reaper Chameleon! World Fair Impression
overview: Kamen Rider, having fallen into a pit trap, loses his power in the secret room where no wind can reach and reverts back to his form as Hongo.

title: Strangeness! Bee Woman
overview: Hongo begins an investigation into the series of incidents where people who had glasses made at Kagemura's Optometry store have gone missing. But even Ruriko gets some lure glasses, and she disappears as well.

title: The Terrifying Cobra Man
overview: Cobra Man makes an attack on the gold vault, but when the pet dog of security guard Kondo barks at him, he drops his fangs! Seeking his fangs, he attacks Kondo.

title: The Revived Cobra Man
overview: Ritsuko Ayakoji of the Ayakoji Biology Research Institute, Shocker's collaborator, puts up advertisements for “Purchasing Animals” to gather animal blood and capture the people who bring in their pets.

title: Bloodsucking Monster, Gebacondor
overview: Shocker has produced a new monster, Gebacondor, by assembling into one all the strong points of their previous monsters. But Gebacondor needs the lifeblood of young women.

title: Murder, Yamogelas
overview: Doctor Shirakawa has invented a death ray but tries to seal his invention away, while his aid Shibata conspires with Shocker and is remodeled into the monster Geckogeras, making secret plans to take the death ray.

title: Tokageron and the Big Monster Army
overview: To break through the Toyo Atomic Energy Research Laboratory's barrier, Shocker remodels pro soccer athlete Nomoto and produces the monster Tokageron with powerful kicking might.

title: Raid of the Demon Sabotegron
overview:
Hongo saved Tokyo from a horrible fate at the hands of Shocker.But Hongo can not rest while Shocker's plans to conquer the world grows stronger every day. For justice, and for everlasting peace, Kamen Rider will continue his fight until the very end.

Debuting this episode, a new Kamen Rider appears! With three new leading ladies, and more excitement, Thrills, and Action!

title: Counterattack, Sabotegron
overview: At the end of fierce fighting, Kamen Rider drives Sabotegron away. Sabotegron then uses Flowers of Mexico to attack Hayato and the Tachibana Racing Club.

title: Wrestler of the Devil, Pirasaurus
overview: Shocker gets their hands on the Pirazaurus whose poison can kill a giant dinosaur in mere seconds and begin to create a cyborg by combining it with a human.

title: Death Match in the Ring: Defeat! Pirasaurus
overview: Pirazaurus experiments with the powerful deadly gas, “Mist of Death,” at a gogo house. He launches his scheme to obliterate Japanese leaders with the Mist of Death as they spectate a pro wrestling match.

title: Fossil Man: Hitodanger
overview: Shocker creates a missile base in the mountains and appoints the monster Hitodanger to defend it. After saving a boy from a Shocker attack, he fights Hitodanger to save Taki who went searching for the base.

title: Monster Kanibubbler Appears in Hokkaido
overview: For Shocker's plan to cause a tsunami in Hokkaido through submarine earthquakes, they send in the monster Kanibubbler to destroy all seismomitors.

title: Fire-Breathing Caterpillar Monster: Dokugander
overview: Ichimonji, who has started an inquiry into a village thrown into panic by a gigantic catapillar creature, meets with Yoshioka who is looking for a missing professor, and together they begin a search for the professor.

title: Dokugander, Confrontation at Osaka Castle
overview: In order for Shocker to make use of a growth drug developed by Yoshioka, Dokugander's adult form transforms into the deceased professor to trick the assistant professor Yoshioka.

title: Suspicious Merman Amazonia
overview: An olympic swimmer disappears suddenly right before the eyes of his teammates, and a young man swimming in the ocean gets kidnapped by a monster who appears.

title: Sky-Flying Monster Musasabedol
overview: Shocker creates the monster Musasabidol to go after a new liquid fuel developed by Doctor Ookuma. Taki, who is visiting Hokkaido, discovers this plan, and after following Taki, Ichimonji confronts Musasabidol.

title: Deadly Poison Monster Kinokomolg's Sortie!
overview: After a prisoner is immersed in the extract of poisonous mushrooms for one week, the monster Kinokomorgue is born.

title: Defeat Kinokomolg!
overview: Kinokomorgue declares, “Make him taste the fear of death!” and injects the captured Ichimonji with the antidote, returning him to his senses.

title: The Terrifying Antlion
overview: While the monster Hell Thunder enacts his plan to make an artificial antlion pit that tears main roads into pieces, the supreme commander Colonel Zol is dispatched from Shocker's branch in the Middle East.

title: Mukadelas Monster Classroom
overview: Children are abducted by a suspicious man who calls himself a close friend of Kamen Rider. The man is the Shocker beast Mukaderas and he controls children with hypnotic radio waves for their scheme to turn them into members of Junior Shocker.

title: Underground Monster Mogurang
overview: Shocker schemes to turn Tokyo Bay into a sea of flames by pouring in petroleum from industrial areas, equipping the monster Mogurang with an Electro Eye that he uses to capture humans.

title: Electric Monster Kuragedall
overview: Shocker seeks humans capable of withstanding 5000 volts of electricity to make a resource of Electric Humans they can use to assassinate important figures, so Kuragedal who can release high-voltage currents is sent to capture people.

title: Revived Fossil, Bloodsucking Trilobite
overview: Doctor Shimura's research that can revive ancient lifeforms catches the eye of Shocker, who steal the ancient trilobite ressurected from a fossil and infuse it with the blood of a blood-sucking cyborg, creating the monster Zanbronzo.

title: Deathmatch! Anteater Demon Arigabari
overview: Mount Tengu is the test site for the bacteria, “Amazon's Curse,” of Shocker's monster Arigabari, and they attack the young man Izaki who visits the mountain.

title: Cannibalism Flower, Dokudalian
overview: The monster Dokudahlian is made from a man-eating flower that's lived for 200 years in the deep forests of New Guinea and he transforms into a florist who emits hypnosis sound waves.

title: Steel Monster, Armadillong
overview: Dispatched from Brazil, the monster Armadillong is given the order from the Chief, “Defeat my longtime enemy Rider,” before enacting his plan to destroy gas tanks.

title: Japan in Danger! Gamagiller's Invasion
overview: Doctor Origuchi of the Criminal Research Institute looks into Shocker's evil doing, and discovers their plan to split the Japanese islands with a special nuclear weapon.

title: Murderous Ant Queen, Archimedes
overview: Shocker's scientists succeed in producing a queen ant cyborg from an ant's egg. The created monster Archimedes attacks a bank with her powerful formic acid.

title: Resurrected Mummy Monster, Egyptus
overview: Shocker discovers a monster from the time of ancient Egypt in the pyramids, the mummy Egyptus.

title: Poisonous Gas Monster Trickabuto's G-Plan
overview: Shocker's newly developed killer plants are placed in theaters and concert halls as they scheme up the G Strategy to annihilate everyone.

title: Lightning Monster Eiking's World Darkness Plan
overview: Captured two years ago, the marine biologist Doctor Seki created the monster Rayking but flees Shocker and is rescued by Ichimonji and the others.

title: Monster Wolf Man's Huge Murder Party
overview: Colonel Zol executes his Wolf Strategy to make werewolves with the Wolf Virus. In the midst of this, the young girl Kumiko from the Wakakusa Garden orphanage witnesses one of these experimental wolfmen.

title: Deathmatch! Monster Snowman vs. Two Riders
overview: Doctor Reaper of Shocker's Swiss branch takes up a new post in the Japanese division. He makes plans to detonate Kirishima's volcanic belt by digging an underground tunnel between Kirishima and Sakurajima.

title: Magma Monster Ghoster, Decisive Battle at Sakurajima
overview: For the construction of a tunnel that connects Sakurajima and Ebi Heights, Doctor Reaper sends in the monster Ghoster.

title: The Devil's Messenger, Mysterious Fly Man
overview: Doctor Reaper captures a cold-hearted young man, who doesn't even care about committing a hit-and-run to a young boy, and remodels him into the Fly Man.

title: Mysterious Birdman Pranodon's Attack
overview: Emi of the Tachibana Racing Club is taken by Shocker, fitted with a transmitter and controlled by the monster Pranodon's hypnotism radio waves.

title: Graveyard Monster, Kabibinga
overview: The monster Moldbinga schemes to cultivate a killer mold that grows from the nourishment of humans and he attacks people in the graveyard near the hideout so he can conduct tests with his killer mold.

title: Monster Namewhale's Gas Explosion Plan
overview: Doctor Yajima develops an artificial brain that has the power to amplify the abilities of animals exponentially and keeps it to himself.

title: Showdown!! Snow Mountain Monster Bearconger
overview: Shocker plots their “Snow Strategy” to melt all of the snow of Kusatsu Heights and cause a great flood, and makes the physicist Doctor Mikawa manufacture an energy bomb that releases intense heat.

title: The Death-Calling Ice Devil Todogiller
overview: The monster Todogiller, who can fire a Freezing Shot that is 300 degrees below zero, freezes humans and Shocker turns them into cyborgs to execute their “Ice Strategy.”

title: Bloodsucking Marshes of Hiruguerilla
overview: With the blood-sucking leeches he controls the monster Leechguerilla absorbs the lifeblood of humans, and by injecting a green medicine into them he can change the humans he takes blood from into slaves.

title: Cannibalistic Monster, Isoginchack
overview: The old man Nakayama finds a vein of diamonds in the continent of Africa and sends the whereabouts of the vein to his grandchild written on a medal, but Shocker targets the vein as well.

title: Monster Kamestone's Murderous Aurora Program
overview: An aurora suddenly appears in the Tokyo skies. The many people who see this look towards it, and one by one they get brought in to hospitals.

title: Stone Monster Unicornos vs. Double Rider Kick
overview: Shocker infuses a unicorn brought back from a fossil with the blood of a fiendish man, creating the monster Unicornus. Unicornus turns Goro and others into fossils.

title: My Name is Mysterious Birdman Gilgalass
overview: Gilgalass transforms himself into a crow that can speak like a human, and attacks humans with the Dead Man Gas that turns them into homicidal maniacs.

title: Monster Jaguarman's Ready-to-Die Motorbike War
overview: Takeshi Hongo has to contend with both a new Shocker commander, Hell's Ambassador, and a plot to create chaos with a new cyborg who can control wild animals.

title: Sea Serpent Man of the Phantom Village
overview: Shocker sets up a training camp in a village in the mountains. The monster Sea Snake Man who was trained at the camp uses the sight-warping Prism Eye to execute victims.

title: Cockroach Man!! The Terrifying Bacterial Ad-Balloon
overview: Shocker develops a bacteria that ages biological cells. By putting the bacteria into the balls of a bowling alley, they conduct an experiment to rapidly age young people.

title: Amazon's Poison Butterfly Gireera
overview: The Shocker monster Gireera schemes to throw capsules packed with a deadly poison powder into Japan's national reservoirs for their “Poison Water Strategy”.

title: Tsuchigumo Man Poisonmondo
overview: Hongo's friend Sawada completes a liquid gunpowder that can melt any metal. The Shocker monster Poisonmondo targets this gunpowder.

title: Monster Poison Lizard, Duel in Fear Valley!!
overview: Doctor Ootaguro succeeds in developing the “Alpha Liquid,” a life revitalizing drug that can revive a dead organism.

title: The Bottomless Swamp Monster, Earthworm Man!
overview: From the only surviving earthworm of the Bikini Islands atomic bomb experiments Shocker creates Earthworm Man.

title: Mysterious Owl Man's Murderous X-Rays
overview: The Owl Man begins experimenting with the Murder X-Rays equipped in both of his eyes that can turn living things into bone.

title: Monster Catfishgiller's Electric Hell
overview: Doctor Reaper returns to Shocker's Japan branch of Katsugawa Island along with Catfishgiller who he remodeled from an electric catfish.

title: Monster Hedgehoras' Murder Skull Plan
overview: With the poison needles all over his body containing a killer virus that can melt humans, the monster Hedgehoras obliterates humans one after another.

title: Monster Rhinogang's Autorace of Death
overview: While Hongo and the others are training intensely with their sights set on winning the All Japan Motorcycle Championship, Rhinogang is dispatched from Shocker's Africa division.

title: Monster Cicadaminga's Song to Kill Everyone
overview: While catching cicadas, Naoki witnesses a murder by the Shocker monster Cicadaminga. Hongo protects Naoki and Shocker come to attack him, but he chases them back and has a confrontation with Cicadaminga.

title: Monster Dr. Insect and the Shocker School
overview: Deceiving them with the slogan, “Come catch Masked Rider and beetles!” Shocker kidnaps children to Mount Takao where Shocker's insect expert Beetlelong organizes a Shocker school and turns them into his pupils.

title: Shocker Graveyard, Revived Monsters
overview: The cyborg Longhornkid revives the monsters defeated by Rider to begin the “Devil Festival.” Through sacrifices, energy is given to Zanjio, Jaguarman, Poison Lizard Man, Hedgehoras and Rhinogang to achieve their resurrection.

title: The Shocker Leader Appears! Riders in Danger
overview: Hongou discovers an upcoming meeting between important Shocker branch chiefs, but that is not all the Leader has planned.

title: Doctor Shinigami, the True Meaning of Terror?
overview: Appearing in Japan once again, Doctor Reaper has a plan to destroy Japan by controlling a meteorite.

title: Monster Gillercricket's Claws of Impending Death
overview: The monster Gillercricket has the ability to transform humans he stabs with his poisonous red claws into murderous fiends with their own death claws.

title: Monster Electric-Guitarbotal's Fireball Attack
overview: Born from high voltage, the monster Electrifirefly receives orders from Ambassador Hell to steal all of the electricity inside Tokyo.

title: Monster Horseflygomes' Rokkoudai Mountain Pursuit
overview: Hongo and Taki receive communication from the FBI saying, “There are clues to Shocker in Kobe,” and so they secretly fly to Kobe in search of Shocker movement.

title: Vampiric Mosquilas vs. Two Riders
overview: The new monster Mosquilas comes from South America and plots to create a Shocker base in the Kii Peninsula.

title: Double Riders' Defeat! Shiomaneking
overview: Shocker's plans to establish a base on the southern tip of the Kii Peninsula obstructed, they use Crabking to abduct the oceanographer Doctor Sakai who dreams of an undersea farm.

title: Deadly Bloodsucking Fiends!! Good Luck, Rider Boys' Squad
overview: Tobei Tachibana becomes president and Taki acts as commanding officer of the Boys' Kamen Rider Squad that is formed. Around that time, there is an outbreak of multiple attacks at blood banks.

title: Poison Flower Monster Roseranga - The Secret of the House of Terror
overview: Taki arrives at the place where he received word of a Shocker sighting from the Boys' Rider Squad but is captured by the monster Roseranga.

title: Three Head of Generator Monster Seadragons!!
overview: Shocker packages the Seadragon monsters in “Strange Beast Monster Cans” and sends them into the homes of the Boys' Rider Squad members. The fully grown Seadragons begin attacking people with their high-voltage currents

title: Monster Newtgeth, Duel at the Farm of Hell!!
overview: Using his power to liquify his entire body, Shocker monster Newtgeth abducts many adult men to advance the construction of an underground airfield.

title: The Dreadful Urchindogma + The Phantom Monster
overview: The monster Urchindogma takes over the village near Tobei's hometown in order to raise a massive amount of Urchindogma eggs. When Tobei returns to his hometown to visit a grave, he protects a young boy who is attacked by Urchindogma for being a witness.

title: Hell Ambassador!! The True Meaning of Fear?
overview: Someone reports the Shocker monster Garagaranda's strategy to poison the water supply to Masked Rider. The Shocker Chief detects Ambassador Hell is the traitor and decides to execute him.

title: Gel-Shocker Appears! Kamen Rider's Last Day!
overview: With Ambassador Hell's defeat, Shocker's Japan division is abandoned. However the Shocker Chief adds the power of Africa's secret organization Geldam and forms the new organization Gel-Shocker.

title: Kamen Rider Dies Twice!
overview: Gel-Shocker's Scorpiolizard uses the Shocker scientists as the guinea pigs for an oxygen deprivation gas and eliminates them. However one scientist, Takashi, does escape. Scorpiolizard pursues Takashi and attacks his wife's hospital.

title: Monster Jellyfish Wolf, Dreadful Rush Hour
overview: Using Jellyfishwolf who can release 10 million volts of electric current, Gel-Shocker schemes to massacre people by bringing lightning down on Shinjuku station during rush hour.

title: Monster Inokabuton, Defeat the Rider With Crazy Gas
overview: Gel-Shocker remodels a death row inmate into the monster Boarbeetle. Boarbeetle possesses a madness gas and in order to succeed in their strategy to devastate Tokyo with a deadly poison gas.

title: Watch Out, Rider! Isoginjaguar's Hell Trap
overview: Isoginjaguar, reconstructed for the purpose of destroying Rider, abducts the girl Maki who is searching for her father. During the Boys Rider Squad's search for her they find Isoginjaguar's automobile, but it's a Gel-Shocker trap.

title: Sludge Monster, Dreadful Murder Smog
overview: Combining a viscious criminal with a moray eel and sea turtle that grew up in the sludge of Tago Inlet, Gel-Shocker produces Utsubogamesu.

title: Monster Eaglemantis' Human Hunt
overview: The Boys Rider Squad come to hike Mount Oomuro. Meanwhile, Gel-Shocker's Eaglemantis executes the human hunting strategy and attacks a bus headed for Mount Oomuro, abducting the passengers.

title: Gel-Shocker's Delivery Man of Death
overview: Gel-Shocker draws up a list of Japan's important figures to execute. The monster Kumolion delivers letters of advance notice for their deaths to these figures and then assassinates them one by one.

title: Bizarre! The Picture of the Black Cat That Calls for Blood
overview: Hongo consults with the young boy Satoru who is concerned about his older brother since he's become obsessed with painting a black cat, but at that moment, Nekoyamori appears out of the black cat paintings decorating the room.

title: Fear's Pet Strategy, Drop Rider into Hell!
overview: Gel-Shocker's Canarycobra transforms into a tiny canary and approaches people, then kills them with the deadly poison of his Cobra Hand.

title: Fear's Pet Strategy, Rider SOS
overview: After defeating Canarycobra, Nezucondor appears before Kamen Rider. Nezucondor carries the plague inside his body and impliments the pet strategy to spread it throughout Tokyo.

title: Gel-Shocker, Enroll in Terror School
overview: Hongo learns from the Boys Rider Squad members of strange occurances in the Tanzawa district and heads to the scene, but he is attacked there by Boys Gel-Shocker Squad.

title: Atrocity! Fake Kamen Rider!!
overview: Kamen Rider and Mukadetiger simultaneously vanish. At that time, the Gel-Shocker Chief determines the real identity of the Anti-Shocker Alliance that has continuously disrupted Gel-Shocker activity.

title: 8 Kamen Riders
overview: Kamen Rider #1 is driven back by the Shocker Rider and the monster Haetoribachi's coordination and sinks under the sea with Haetoribachi.

title: The True Identity of the Gel-Shocker Leader
overview: Wih the Anti-Shocker Alliance's back up, the double Riders are able to escape danger and take Raydokuga prisoner. Moreover, to defeat Shocker Rider, they begin special training under Tobei's tutelage.

title: Monster Garaox's Sky-Flying Car
overview: Gel-Shocker's Garaox uses his demon fog that can make objects float to attack vehicles. Hongo saves a man who is dropped from midair and questions how despite using a highway he wound up falling from the sky.

title: Takeshi Hongo, Cactus Monster Exposed!?
overview: The cactus research expert Doctor Matsuda is remodeled into Cactusbat. Cactusbat attacks the World Peace Committee's members and using the thorns on his arms he turns the people into cacti.

title: Takeshi Hongo, Transformation Impossible
overview: The Gel-Shocker monster Leechameleon uses the blood absorbed from humans to resurrect Ganikomol who once defeated Rider. Learning of this, Hongo embarks for the enemy's lair, but the revived Ganikomol is there waiting for him.

title: Gel-Shocker Annihilated! The End of the Leader!!
overview: With the arrival of Masked Rider #2 Hongo is rescued and the Double Riders showdown against Leechameleon.

title: Rider No. 3: His Name is V3!
overview: The hard-won peace obtained with the defeat of Gel-Shocker by Kamen Riders #1 and #2, is now shattered by a more powerful secret society known as Destron. Disposing of all those who witness their sinister movements, they target Shiro Kazami, a young motorcross racer. After Scissors Jaguar murders his family, Shiro vows vengeance and becomes Kamen Rider V3.

title: Last Testament of the Double Riders
overview: Destron's Scissors-Jaguar separates V3 from the Double Riders to allow Turtle Bazooka to vaporize Tokyo with the H-Bomb contained inside his body. Scissors Jaguar decoys Shiro and keeps him away from Turtle Bazooka. Can V3 warn Rider One and Two in time? Will V3 and the Double Riders stop the mutants before Tokyo is wiped off of the map?

title: The Execution of V3
overview: TV-Fly takes over a suburban hospital in order to create a new mutant specifically designed to defeat Kamen Rider V3. The new creature, Squid-Fire, manages to disrupt V3's power source and scores a victory for Destron. The mutant seals Kazami Shiro in a coffin, which is placed in a furnace! Can Shiro discover the extent of his powers in time to escape his own execution?

title: V3's 26 Secrets!?
overview: Hypnotizing Tachibana Tobei, TV-Fly orders him to kill Kazami Shiro, while Tama Junko also falls into his trap. Can Shiro stop Destron's evil plan? Will V3 unlock the secret of his 26 hidden techniques, in order to rescue his comrades and defeat Destron's mutants?

title: Snake-Man with a Machine Gun!
overview: An eminent biologist, Dr. Murayama, discovers a new clean energy source, and Destron's Machinegun-Snake is sent to seize the data. Failing to grab the doctor, he kidnaps assistant Nishizaki Michiko. When she refuses to talk, Machinegun-Snake targets Tsutomu, her son. Kazami Shiro is injured by the mutant! Can V3 protect Tsutomu, his friend Mamoru, and rescue his mother?

title: Enter, Hammer-Jellyfish! V3 Unleash Your Killing Technique!!
overview: Mamoru clings to life in a hospital, while his sister blames Kazami Shiro and betrays him to Destron. Hammer-Jellyfish continues the interrogation of Nishizaki and resorts to forcing the information out of her by dangling Tsutomu off of a high-rise. Will Nishizaki give in to Hammer-Jellyfish for her son's life? Can V3 defeat the powerful mutant and save them?

title: The Fury of Rider V3's Special Training
overview: Destron blows up the research facility of Professor Kawai, in order to secure his artificial heart technology in order to strengthen their mutants. Kawai's subject comes back to life, and as Knife-Armadillo, stalks the professor for revenge. The resilient mutant even repels V3 in battle! To improve his strength, will V3 survive the harsh rigors of his own brutal training session?

title: Watch Out, V3! Beware the Terrifying Buzzsaw
overview: While Kazami Shiro recovers in a hospital, the Rider Scouts search for Destron's outpost, while Buzzsaw-Lizard tries to persuade Kawai to resuscitate Knife-Armadillo, under pain of death. Refusing, he now must witness the execution of his family. Captured by Destron, Shiro hangs over a pool of acid! Can he escape their trap and transform into V3?

title: What is the Destron Hell Squad!?
overview: Kazami Shiro's rival, Yoshioka Masaru, and other top racers in the All Japan Motorcross Championship, are captured by Destron's Lens-Ant. He transforms them into the Destron Hell Squad in order to rob a convoy carrying a nuclear-powered satellite. The mutant also captures Junko and Shigeru! Will Shiro save his friends? Can V3 defeat not one, but two mutants, single-handedly?

title: Secret of the Double Typhoon
overview: Destron's Razor-Starfish teams up with Lens-Ant to attack V3, and they send the Hell Squad to steal a shipment of nuclear satellite fuel. Meanwhile, Tachibana Tobei and the Rider Scouts are captured while searching for Junko and Shigeru. Can Kazami Shiro find the antidote for the Hell Squad, rescue his friends from certain death, and take on both mutant cyborgs?

title: The Claws of Evil Reach Out for V3!!
overview: Destron forces Marine biologist Dr. Nakatani to create a powerful aquatic mutant, Pickaxe-Shark. The doctor escapes, but his creation is sent to kill him. Meanwhile, a chinpira exposes Kazami Shiro's secret identity to Junko, but is captured and transformed into Drill-Mole. As V3 battles Pickaxe-Shark in the open sea, Drill-Mole abducts Junko to force her into an unholy union!

title: Junko Becomes a Monster's Bride?!
overview: Destron's Pickaxe-Shark proves a formidable foe to V3, who suffers defeat at the claws of the mutant. Meanwhile, Junko is prepared for an unholy union with Drill-Mole... Can Kazami Shiro recover in time to defeat Pickaxe-Shark and rescue Junko from a fate worse than death � while guarding his secret identity?

title: Terrifying Commandant: Doktor G!
overview: A couple hikes into the mountains to research the secret of the legendary Boar-Man, but only the woman returns. Suspecting Destron, Kazami Shiro goes to the hospital, only to have the missing man reappear � a disguise for Magnet-Boar, who aims to destroy Japan's national railway system. After an intense fight, Shiro discovers that he cannot transform into V3! But, this was simply a ruse to allow the sinister Doktor G safe passage into Japan...

title: Secret Memento of the Double Riders
overview: Toad-Boiler attacks Interpol agent George Kamamoto, who is trying to pass on a coded document from Riders One and Two to Kazami Shiro. V3 saves Kamamoto, and then heads for Chichibu, as directed by the document. Toad-Boiler implores him to transform into V3, and then sprays him with a white fluid � a substance that drains V3's energy! Can V3 survive and obtain the secret left behind by the Double Riders?

title: Rider V3's Deadly Weakness!!
overview: The daughter of Dr. Okajima, an atomic physicist who escaped the clutches of Destron with the help of the Double Riders, saves the badly injured Kazami Shiro from the basin of a waterfall. She is then stalked by Burner-Bat, who is looking for V3. With the help of Dr. Okajima, Shiro is able to find the memento from the Double Riders, which holds the secret to V3's four weaknesses. What are they?

title: Gecko Monster With a Missile On His Back!
overview: Rider Scout Saburo and his father save a hapless fisherman, whom witnessed mutant Missile-Gecko in action. V3 fights off Missile-Gecko, but meanwhile, Destron snatches Saburo and his father. When Saburo discovers Destron's plot to destroy the petroleum complex, will he be able to contact Rider Scout HQ? Can V3 save Japan from plunging into total chaos?

title: The Devil Spray is the Reaper's Weapon
overview: The fearsome Spray-Rat takes on the likeness of a priest and finds a young couple to use as guinea pigs for his Devilspray virus. He offers to marry them, but only allows one witness � Tama Junko. Kazami Shiro arrives in the nick of time, but cannot prevent the groom from being infected. While rescuing the bride, V3 is trapped in a church with a ticking time bomb! Can V3 escape deadly doom?

title: V3, Beware the Fiendish Traitor!
overview: Kusarigama-Beetle captures Kazami Shiro and takes him to Destron's outpost. While Doktor G is torturing Shiro he breaks free and seizes the files for the Devilspray antidote � only to discover that it is a fake! V3 is ambushed by the Destron mutants, and in the heat of battle Spray-Rat attacks Kusarigama-Beetle. The injured mutant decides to betray Destron and help Shiro retrieve the antidote for the Devilspray. But, is V3 being lead into a trap?

title: Blowfish Apache's Operation: Torpedo!!
overview: Kazami Shiro rushes to Tatsunoko Point where Destron has been sinking passing ships, in a bid to seize control of the seas. After encountering Blowfish-Apache's torpedoes, Shiro discovers slaves working in a secret weapons factory. With the help of Tachibana Tobei, Shiro is able to penetrate the Destron outpost, but they are led into a deadly trap, and sunk to the bottom of the sea! Can V3 save Tachibana and stop Destron?

title: Operation: Destron Shikoku Conquest
overview: Destron uses the SS Device flown in from their South American base, in an attempt to conquer the island of Shikoku. Fukazawa, a scientist forced to work for Destron, manages to escape with the schematic. When Kazami Shiro receives word, he heads immediately for Shikoku via ship, but is attacked by Guillotine-Saurus. Can V3 break through and save Shikoku from Destron's grip?

title: The Double Riders Live
overview: V3 is saved by the voices of the Double Riders coming from a special medallion. In Shikoku, Kazami Shiro disguises himself as a Destron sympathizer to repair the SS Device. Meanwhile, Fukazawa, Tachibana Tobei and Tama Junko fall under the control of Syringe-Spider! Can V3 stop Doktor G's conquest plans and find the antidote to save his friends from the clutches of Destron?

title: Camp of Terror! Mystery of the Underground Canal
overview: The Rider Scouts are at training camp on Hatsushima Island, where mutant Speargun-Sea Lion has established an undersea outpost to manufacture poison gas. Destron plans to transport the chemical weapon via an underground canal to Mt. Fuji, where the winds will spread the gas over hundreds of miles. Kazami Shiro orders the scouts to evacuate, but they refuse when they realize one of them is missing. Can V3 stop Destron in time?

title: Terror! The Vampire From the Graveyard
overview: Propeller-Beetle begins kidnapping young people � the males are reconstructed into Destron Soldiers, while the blood of the females satisfies his energy source. When the monster hears the voice of the sister of Kazami Shiro's friend Kuroda Kyosuke, he retreats. When she discovers that her brother is really Propeller-Beetle, Doktor G orders the mutant to drink her blood. Kazami enters the Destron outpost when Junko is captured. Can V3 save them?

title: Mysterious! Cockroach Manor!!
overview: In order to wage germ warfare on Japan, Destron takes over the Osato Biological Institute and tortures the head scientist, to pillage his research. Meanwhile Rider Scout Yoshio notices that young women go into the institute but don't come out. So he snoops around to check things out, but is captured by Cockroach-Spike. Junko goes in to rescue him posing as a housekeeper, but is also caught spying. Can V3 thwart Destron's plot?

title: Mysterious!! The Destron Ranger Corps
overview: Rumors circulate of savage ape-men in the Omi Mountains, but this is a cover for training Destron's Ranger Squad units. In order to keep this secret Mantis-Merang kills anyone who approaches the area. V3 saves Rider Scout Kenji and his older brother from certain death, but the Destron Rangers soon surround them. Meanwhile, the 2nd Unit of the Destron Rangers starts tainting Tokyo's water supply with the deadly Mummification Virus�

title: Monster Heater-Cicada's Operation: Mummy
overview: With the Mummification Virus in Tokyo's water supply, Destron plans to turn 10 million people into mummies, using Heater-Cicada's chirp to drive victims to drink the tainted water. Kazami Shiro discovers that Professor Taguchi is the only person who can create an antidote and saves his daughter while trying to rescue Junko. But is the professor's daughter really who she says she is? Has Shiro fallen into a trap?

title: Zol, Death, Hell and Black Rise From the Grave
overview: Rider Scout Shotaro has discovered Shocker mutants entombed in a lakeside cave. When he arrives, the mutants are gone, but Kazami Shiro is ambushed by Destron's powerful Quoit-Beetle. Destron plots to destroy the whole of Japan by resurrecting former Shocker Commandants Colonel Zol, Doctor Death, Ambassador Hell and General Black, using a newly developed toxic gas called Girard Gamma. Suddenly, V3 is attacked by the revived Shocker mutants, led by Quit-Beetle!

title: The Five Commandant's All-Out Attack!
overview: Trapped by the five commandants Kazami Shiro falls into an unbreakable cell. Tachibana Tobei, in a bid to rescue Shiro, poses as a scientist who has developed an antidote to the nerve gas, and is abducted. Meanwhile, Shiro turns the table on Ambassador Hell and takes him hostage in order to escape. But, he must infiltrate the outpost once more in to rescue Tachibana and Junko. Can V3 save Japan, as well as his friends, from certain death?

title: Doktor G's Final Challenge!
overview: Held responsible for the death of the Shocker Commandants, Doktor G creates Camera-Mosquito, who steals people's faces in a last-ditch effort to take control of Japan. Meanwhile, Destron Hunter Sakuma Ken steals microfilm containing Destron secrets and becomes the target of Camera-Mosquito. Kazami Shiro saves Sakuma and takes the microfilm to Professor Tadokoro for decoding, but Camera-Mosquito has already stolen his face� Can V3 prevail?

title: Doktor G! The True Form of Evil is...?
overview: The Destron Hunters discover that the microfilm gives the location of a manufacturing plant where Destron creates their mutants. While they succeed in sabotaging the plant, Doktor G arrives to exterminate them, except for Sakuma Ken, who is saved by V3. Doktor G implores the Great Leader to allow him to destroy V3 personally, and transforms into Crab-Laser. Will this be the end of Destron� or Kamen Rider V3?

title: Enter, Baron Fang: Commandant of Curses!!
overview: The Great Leader summons Baron Fang, the great Doovoo shaman of the Tusk Tribe from the upper reaches of the Congo River, to become commandant of Destron Japan. His mutant Skull-Warthog uses his tusks to dissolve human flesh from their bones. In order to lure Kazami Shiro to his doom, Skull-Warthog possesses the body of Rider Scout Toshiko's father and kidnaps her mother. Shiro and Sakuma Ken come to her aide, but are soon surrounded by the villagers who fall under the sway of the Devil's Drums�

title: Spectre of Onibi Swamp: Rider Scouts Annihilated!?
overview: Given the task of destroying the Rider Scouts, Fireball-Walrus possesses Tachibana Tobei's old friend Ito, the manager of the mountain villa where the scouts go on retreat. When Junko discovers his true identity, she is also marked for death. When they are attacked, V3 comes to the rescue, but not only must he fight Fireball-Walrus, but he also comes face to face with Baron Fang. Who will triumph?

title: V3 in Danger! Riders One and Two Return!!
overview: Dr. Samukawa and his daughter Yumiko are put under pain of death by Snow-Wolf to assist Destron to pervert his scientific discovery. Baron Fang places a lycanthropic curse on Yumiko, which transforms her into a werewolf if they do not obey his will. She drugs Junko, Shigeru and Tachibana who are taken prisoner, while Snow-Wolf defeats Kazami Shiro. Frozen in an ice chamber Shiro is unable to transform into V3� who will save them?

title: Critical Moment! Baron Fang vs. Three Riders!!
overview: Baron Fang resurrects Smilodon the sorceress and ancient mother of the Tusk Tribe in order to destroy the Kamen Riders. Taking on the name Ayanokoji she delivers a voodoo doll that poisons Hongo Takeshi who is taken to a hospital. When Kazami Shiro rushes to the scene she attacks him as Primordial-Tiger, who manages to subdue V3 and locks him up with Hongo. She then targets Ichimonji Hayato� can Hayato free his comrades and best Smilodon?

title: Baron Fang's Final Transformation
overview: A Destron fugitive calls Rider Scouts HQ to reveal a sinister plot, but the line goes dead. Discovering a locker key at the scene, Kazami Shiro is ambushed by Bloodthirsty-Mammoth, but escapes. Shiro retrieves photographs of three members of parliament whom Baron Fang plans to brainwash in order to conquer Japan. So he disguises himself as one of the men and is taken to Destron's outpost. Can V3 stop Baron Fang's diabolical plot?

title: The Winged Corps: Demons of the Sky
overview: Destron summons Archbishop Wing and his clan from Tibet to take over where Baron Fang failed. Soon afterwards a strange Buddhist monk claims that evil spirits reside in the homes of the president of an industrial factory and the director of an atomic research facility � the evil spirits turn out to be mutant Flame-Condor. When V3 is injured in battle, Tachibana Tobei helps him to train against the airborne menace. Can V3 overcome the odds?

title: Mysterious Temple: Curse of the Musasabi Clan
overview: Archbishop Wing's Dryad-Flying Squirrel is able to turn a red fluid that he secretes from his claws, into a deadly gas that transforms humans into flying squirrel carcasses. His plan is to spread the gas far and wide in a violent eruption of Mt. Daisetsu. The mutant plans to use V3 to set off the explosives by kidnapping Shigeru, his cousin, and his grandfather. Will V3 trip the explosives or will he outwit Destron?

title: Lone V3 and Cub: Deadly Skydiving
overview: Mutant Poison-Mothla kills two power company workers who discover electricity being re-routed. Meanwhile, Destron captures the father of a young boy, Tsuyoshi, who stumbled upon their outpost. Kazami Shiro arrives to investigate the siphoned power, and finds the boy all alone. Trapped in the valley by Destron, V3 fights Poison-Mothla, but cannot defeat him. Can V3 find the creature's weakness and reunite father and son?

title: Terror of the Carnivorous Fauna Plantaingan!!
overview: Archbishop Wing plans to use the poison of the inhuman Plantaingan, combined with 30,000 volts of electricity, to create miniaturized people preserved for use in creating cyborgs. The mutant kidnaps a young boy's sister and Kazami Shiro must fight in order to save her. Plantaingan attacks Rider Scouts HQ to liquidate a captured Destron Soldier and threatens Tachibana Tobei and Company. Can V3 liberate them from the tendrils of death?

title: Sudden Death! V3 Mach Kick!!
overview: Destron mutant Deadman-Bat, employing a virus called the Himalayan Devil, turns the residents of apartment complexes in all the major cities into vampire slaves. When Rider Scout Kiyoshi discovers his older brother is one of the victims, he and Shigeru are attacked by the mutant. V3 challenges Deadman-Bat, but is tossed from the air and Kiyoshi is injured. Can V3 develop a new technique in order to defeat the true form of Archbishop Wing?

title: Oh! People Are Melting! Enter, Marshal Armor
overview: Summoned from Mongolia, Marshal Armor becomes the new commandant of Destron Japan and employs Nazi transplant technology to create the invulnerable Pumadillon. Marshal Armor releases a slave named Yamashita to contact Kazami Shiro to lure him into a trap. Kazami's old friend Takagi Yusuke work together to protect Yamashita and his family, but something is very wrong � Takagi begins to praise working for Destron�

title: The Snail Man's Human Experiments!
overview: Marshal Armor's Snailbura implants its sinister eggs into the residents of an apartment complex. These incubate in the victims' bloodstream developing into larvae to enslave them. Snailbura's first experiment is ordered to kill Kazami Shiro, but dies before she can complete her mission. Her sister Misako accuses Shiro of murder and Snailbura promises to give her the power to avenge her sibling's death�

title: Friend or Foe? The Mysterious Riderman
overview: Ambitious Destron scientist Yuki Joji is condemned to death by Marshal Armor, who sees him as a threat to his position in the organization. Slowly Yuki is lowered into a pool of sulfuric acid, losing his right arm before being rescued by his fellow scientists, who make a daring escape. Hidden away, Katagiri contacts his sister, who is a nurse, to assist in Yuki's cybernetic operation. But Destron is watching and sends Sickleneck-Tortoise to kill them�

title: V3 vs. Riderman

Regardless Riderman doesn't want to listen to V3's words against Destron � he only seeks revenge against Marshal Armor. Meanwhile, Marshal Armor begins his plan to spread the nerve gas and begins killing innocents throughout Tokyo, and while Kazami Shiro investigates with Yuki Joji right on his tail, Sickleneck-Tortoise stalks them both�

title: Destron's Christmas Present
overview: Marshal Armor sends mutant Rhino-Tank, disguised as Santa Claus, to lure children into the House of Good Fortune, in order to train them as future Destron commandants. Yuki Joji finds this disturbing and "Black Santa" offers to release the children if Joji will defeat V3. In order to save the children, he decides to fight V3 with Rhino-Tank. After the Mach Kick and the Hurricane Dash fail to faze the mutant, an industrial bulldozer slowly crushes V3�

title: Riderman, Where Will You Go?
overview: Pinned against a cliff by a bulldozer V3 uses his Reverse Double Typhoon to save himself and infiltrates the Destron outpost. He saves Yuki Joji who was trapped in an execution chamber, but Destron mercilessly pummels V3, who was injured in his battle with Rhino-Tank. Yuki finally sees Destron's cruelty, but will he rescue V3 or the kidnapped children? Which way will Riderman go�?

title: Ambush! The Destron Leader!!
overview: A New Year's card from Marshal Armor arrives for Yuki Joji, so he and Kazami Shiro investigate the return address. When they split up and enter the manor, Coelacanth-Kid attacks V3 and Riderman falls into Marshal Armor's hands. The mutant takes on Joji's form, becoming "Destron Riderman" in order to wipe out Shiro and the Rider Scouts. Shiro is tricked by the fake Joji and is thrown off of a cliff! Then the evil imposter makes his way to Rider Scouts HQ�

title: Look! The Face of the Destron Leader!!
overview: The Great Leader, overlord of Destron, arrives in Japan. When V3 and Riderman go after him, they fall into a trap. V3 and Riderman fight Thorned-Starfish, but when V3 turns to take on the Destron Leader, Riderman suddenly takes a stand to defend him�

But, Marshal Armor and Chameleon are waiting to welcome them�

title: A Little Friendship

When Vampire-Chameleon attacks Kenichi's grammar school, Shiro and Joji find themselves in a dilemma, when they face a horde of vampire children they cannot kill�

overview: Marshal Armor has developed a powerful Pluton Rocket that is more powerful than the H-Bomb and the Great Leader orders that it be aimed at Tokyo. overview: Kotaro discovers the whereabouts of a missing biker, who is raising his son to ride and protect the ultimate bike devised by his father.

title: Mama Raises Monster Babies!
overview: Gorgom kidnaps mothers to nurture its army of mutants, and BLACK finds himself facing an implacable enemy.

title: The Day All Tuna Vanished
overview: Kotaro fights to stop the abduction of tuna by Professor Kuromatsu in order to gain an extract to improve the power of the Golgom mutants.

title: Assault on a Haunted School
overview: Keisuke tries to stop a Golgom scheme of using schools to mold children into model students to assist in their control of Earth.

title: Friend From Across the Sea!
overview: Kotaro attempts to find the source of powerful earthquakes after meeting a mysterious man.

title: Kyoko's Mysterious Dream!
overview: Golgom manipulate the dreams of Nobuhiko's sister Kyoko in order to use her life energy to save an ailing Shadow Moon.

title: Sword Saint Birugenia!!
overview: Golgom's Creation King forces the release of a powerful yet rebellious swordsman, who decides to try and take down Kotaro on his own terms.

title: The Suffocating Trap of Hell

title: Clash! Super Machines

title: The Shadow That Stalks Dad

overview: When a head of a two-headed ammonite Mutant becomes detached by Kamen Rider Black, it ends up with a kid where it becomes his new pet.

overview: A Golgom Mutant takes advantage of a girl's obsession to become strong to give her super-strength but ultimately takes control of her forcing Kotaro to save her.

title: The Fire Breathing Danger Road
overview: Kotaro must avoid the dangers of the Golgom priests and an electricity controlling Mutant in order to restore power for a kid who needs vital surgery.

title: The Scarab Beetle's Invitation to Hell
overview: Bilgenia uses a scarab beetle Mutant to create a craze for its minions, forcing Kotaro into a corner in trying to stem this greedy obsession.

title: The Targeted Death Mask
overview: Kotaro must rescue four Japanese astronauts when they're abducted and replaced with doll-like clones controlled by a Golgom Mutant.

title: Burn! Boy Warriors
overview: The Golgom Boy Warriors reunite with Kotaro to help save children being abducted by Golgom to create a new, stronger generation of child warriors.

title: Father, Son, and the River of Love

title: Fight! The Two Princes
overview: With Kotaro barely escaping from Bilgenia, the Golgom swordsman rampages to force Black into a final showdown, hoping to stop him even as Shadow Moon finally awakens.

overview: As Kotaro and Kyoko cope with Nobuhiko's transformation into Shadow Moon, the new Golgom leader transforms his commanders to declare the start of Golgom's conquest of Earth.

overview: A Mutant attack on a friend's wedding in Hokkaido leads to Katsumi becoming Golgom's tool, forcing Kotaro to pursue them in order to save her from their grasp.

title: Mystery? EP-Party Boy Squad
overview: When Golgom creates a new political party claiming they'll bring about peace, Kotaro investigates and discovers a nefarious plot using this guise.

title: The Idol's Evil Power
overview: Bishium uses the identity of a girl to turn a mutant into an idol hypnotizing her fans into Golgom's mentality while tricking Kotaro into believing she is still innocent.

title: The Karate Master's Secret
overview: In pursuit of a destructive Salamander Mutant, Kotaro encounters a peculiar karate master in the woods training a boy to be a fighter.

title: The Dangerous Time Thief
overview: A boy brooding over his father's murder by Golgom becomes abducted by two samurai thrown out of time by a Mutant's magic time-controlling box.

title: Tokyo Mutant Gathering
overview: Kotaro meets two brothers, Makoto and Yuki who has psychic powers which Yuki gets kidnap by Fly Mutant to bring the Phantom Mutants to life and begins a invasion of Tokyo. Kotaro tries to fight back and only to find the Phantom Monsters tuern themselves incorporeal to avoid his attacks! Will Kotaro find a way of how to end this madness, once and for all?

title: The Mutant Farm Battle
overview: Kotaro investigates the claim of a child that something strange is happening at his apartment, leading to a discovery of its inhabitants being used to create new mutants for Golgom!

title: An Ocean Inside the Closet
overview: A boy accidentally intercepts a signal associated with Baraom's warp device, forcing Kotaro to protect him and stop Golgom's plan to use it to sink Japan.

title: Death of Flower Mutant Bishium
