overview: Touma pleads for Kento to fight with the other swordsmen as they battle Master Logos.

title: Swordsmen, Follow the Path You Believe In
overview: Touma is able to win over Kento, but there is still unfinished business with Ren and Master Logos.

title: The Shining Friendship of Three Swordsmen
overview: Tassel meets with Luna; Master Logos makes the swordsmen fight each other.

title: 2000 Years Of Written Desires
overview: Tassel makes a visit to the Northern Base to fill Touma in on a few things.

title: The Beginning of a Beautiful Ending
overview: Touma waits for Tassel to return with Luna, but an old friend finally catches up with him and he never shows.

title: A Clash Over the Value of Living
overview: Touma learns that Luna has not been captured; Ren battles Desast.

title: Turning the Final Page
overview: Storius unleashes the biggest book to overwrite the world; Touma is reunited with Luna once more.

title: Ten Swordsmen Wagering the World
overview: Ten swordsmen head into a long and restless battle.

title: Farewell, My Hero
overview: Touma comes face-to-face with Storius as the other swordsman participate in the fight of their lives.

title: A Story is Born When the World Ends
overview: Touma falls at the hands of Storius as Luna rushes to find him.

title: When You Turn a New Page
overview: Touma and Kento encounter a reminiscent trio who are being targeted by a monster that is being hunted by a strange man with a demon inside of him.

title: Family! Contract! Demon Whisperer!
overview: A man working at his family's bathhouse discovers that there is a demon living inside of him that only he can see.

title: The Demon is a Bad Guy After All?!
overview: Ikki declares that he does not want to be a Kamen Rider when there is news of a monster at the golf course.

title: Hostage Trouble, What Are the Siblings to Do?!
overview: Daiji wonders how to get Ikki to fight to protect more than just family when their sister and her friend are kidnapped.

title: Love is Scarce! A Dangerous Demon is Born!
overview: Ayaka still hasn't returned home since the kidnapping when she shows up at her sister's concert.

title: A World Mending Rider! Who is the Traitor?!
overview: Someone from Fenix has stolen two ViStamps; a grandfather comes into the bathhouse looking for an internet streamer.

title: Evil's True Identity!  A Shocking Show Time?!
overview: With Kamen Rider Evil now running around the city, a girl comes to Ikki for help with legal matters.

title: Stealing?! Skateboarding?! I'm Kagerou!
overview: Ikki learns of a Deadman that is running around with a group of thieves; Daiji wakes up on the floor with no memory of how he got there.

title: A Family Day Off, Heaven and Hell?!
overview: To celebrate their mother being released from the hospital, the Igarashi family gets out for a family vacation.

title: A Reckless Kagerou! The Igarashi Siblings Are Falling Apart?!
overview: Now that the identity of Kamen Rider Evil is out in the open, Ikki wonders if he'll ever see his brother again.

title: Older and Younger Brother, Trusting Your Heart
overview: While battling Kagerou, Ikki must learn to believe in his brother rather than simply rescuing him.

title: Invincible Sakura, What Are Those Powers For?
overview: The Deadmans are increasing their activity when Sakura receives a package from an unknown sender.

title: Weaknesses Are Your Strengths?! The Unbeatable Jeanne!
overview: When she cannot transform like her brothers, Sakura questions her strength.

title: A Close Call By Fenix!
overview: The Igarashi siblings plan to pick up the slack of the Fenix members on leave while the sky base is grounded, but George revokes Ikki and Hiromi's drivers.

title: The Commanding Officer is a Deadman?!
overview: George believes that the commander is a traitor; two of the Deadmans' followers have unfinished business with Ikki and Sakura.

title: Eradication! Confrontation! Deadmans!
overview: Aguilera is set to join with Gifu when George discovers the location of the Deadmans base.

title: The Feeling of Wanting to Protect... It's the Era of the Igarashi Siblings!
overview: Now that the Deadmans are falling apart, the Igarashi siblings vow to be stronger than ever.

title: Betrayal Deepens, the True Value of a Buddy
overview: Ikki asks George if there is way to revert a stage three Deadmans when an old friend of Julio's asks Sakura for help.

title: A Buddy's Trajectory, the Miracle of Fire and Ice
overview: Ikki is severely injured by his own powers during a battle; Julio asks a favor of Sakura.

title: Demons Warning, Hiromi is Surrounded?!
overview: An old squad member of Hiromi is on an undercover mission, but asks the Igarashi siblings to look after her old friend.

title: Impermanent with No Feelings, the Payback for Transforming
overview: Despite his health, Hiromi promises to save his old friend.

title: I Stake My Life and Leave You With These Feelings
overview: Feelings of distrust for Fenix are running wild; Sakura receives an intriguing proposal.

title: All This Ruckus for an Unremarkable Way to the Top?!
overview: Ikki is asked to go undercover by a talent agency when George sends him a new stamp to help out Vice.

title: Vice Takes Over... I Knew He'd Betray Us?!
overview: Now that Vice and Ikki's situations have swapped, Vice makes a run for it.

title: The Reconstructing of Dr. Karizaki! An Inverse Operation!
overview: With Ikki and Vice having been swapped for a week, George comes up with a plan to fix things.

title: Resurrecting! Vail! The Igarashi Family Memories
overview: The Demons Driver leaves to return to its original owner when George has something that he needs to share with the Igarashi siblings.

title: Showdown! Separation?! The End of Dark and Light
overview: The Igarashi siblings deal with the bombshell dropped about their dad; Kagerou tells Daiji that he will be the one permanently in control.

title: Stop it! The Recklessness of a Tyrant and the Hastiness of Mayhem
overview: Just as Kagerou has been dealt with, Vice goes out of control within Ikki; Weekend reveals their hand to the other siblings.

title: Overcoming Fear at Lightning Speed! Two Hearts Believing in One Self!
overview: Daiji and Sakura are having trouble dealing with an out of control Ikki when George arrives with backup.

title: And Action! Memory of Hiromi!
overview: Giff is ready to revive when the Igarashi siblings discover that Hiromi is still alive, but does not remember anything, and so everyone devises a plan to create a film to help him remember.

title: Voice Actor! Say Me! Dealing with Adolescence
overview: At a reunion with some old soccer buddies, Ikki aggravates one his friends and can't figure out why.

title: Fantasy Guidance, Both Sides to a Dream
overview: Sakura fights the Rafflesia Deadman as Ikki remembers a promise that he made with Jiiko.

title: No Longer Belonging, Pride of a Queen
overview: Genta takes refuge with Weekend; Sakura wants to return a suicidal Aguilera to life as a normal human.

title: A Defiant Lovekov?! Sakura's Determination
overview: With Lovekov not listening, Sakura decides to take Aguilera out for some fun before their battle; Daiji brute forces his way in his search for the doctor.

title: A Demon Calling a Demon
overview: Daiji asks for Ikki's help in saving the doctor from the head of Fenix who has sent a warning message out to the public.

title: Unknown Threat, The Road One Should Take
overview: The director has scheduled his press conference as the Igarashi siblings try to figure out how to stop him.

title: Humanity At a Crossroads, the Decision of Us All
overview: Sakura engages with Vail when he turns his attention to Hana, whom he sees as Sakura's weakness; Tamaki is tested by Weekend.

title: A Fierce Battle is Inevitable! A Mission to Take Back the Self-Destructing Demon!
overview: The director tells the people that Giff means them no harm; Ikki tells Daiji that he thinks that they have a way to stop Giff.

title: Assembling Father and Child!  The Ultimate Revice!
overview: Genta offers his assistance to finish the new Vistamp, but George is reluctant to work with his father.

title: Hope and Despair, the Siblings' Conflict
overview: Fenix begins attacking shelters set up by Weekend for those against Giff.

title: Family or the World? A Spirited Quarrel Among Siblings!
overview: Ikki and Sakura are torn up about fighting Daiji; Hikaru is fed up with his father inflicting his ideals on people.

title: A Father's Motive and a Son's Decision!
overview: Ikki tells his parents about the consequence of his contract with Vice; Genta wants back in the fight.

title: Super Battle! Red Vail and Destream
overview: Two fathers wish to repent for their sons as Genta and Vail prepare for a final showdown.

title: An Eternal End, Face Your Repentance
overview: Daiji struggles to rejoin his family as they prepare to take out Akaishi once and for all.

title: The Direction of Giving it Your All
overview: Vice has been swallowed up by Giff and the others are determined to stop Daiji from joining him.

title: A Never Ending Nightmare, the Protectors and the Protected
overview: Tamaki is annoyed with not being a Kamen Rider; things are not looking up for the Igarashi demons.

title: The Courage to Stand Together... What Should You Really Be Protecting?
overview: Sakura is ignoring Lovekov's desire to fight just when her brothers finally figure out a way to hurt Giff.

title: Karizaki's Rebellion, the Price of Transforming
overview: Now that Giff is defeated, everyone tries to return to a normal life.

title: I'll Show You I'm Ready! I Am... Japan's Number One Busybody!
overview: George tries to goad Ikki into fighting him, but Vice is afraid of Ikki losing any more memories.

title: The Battle's Over... But There's Still a Demon Left
overview: Ikki has no memories of his family at all and makes the decision to move out on his own with Vice.

title: We're a Family to the End, Until We Meet Again
overview: Vice plans to fight Ikki so that he'll no longer be remembered and that the contract they made will be null.

title: Daybreak F: The Cordially Invited Rider
overview: The finals of the Desire Grand Prix are underway when Keiwa Sakurai, a man down on his luck after a failed job interview, is caught in the midst of things.

title: Encounter 1: Treasure Hunt and Theft
overview: Ace has won the Desire Grand Prix and the entrants for the next series assemble as they are tasked to go on a treasure hunt.

title: Encounter 2: Zombie Hunt
overview: Neon is asked by her mother to quit her successful streaming channel when a new zombie round of the Desire Grand Prix begins; Ace and Michinaga have a bet on who will do better in the next round.

title: Encounter 3: Conditions for Winning
overview: With Kanato and Neon infected, and tensions surrounding them high, the remaining contestants prepare for the finale wave of the zombie round.

title: Encounter 4: Matching Duos
overview: Michinaga's job has him renovating Ace's house when they are called in for round three of the Desire Grand Prix: a duos battle that resembles a concentration-like card game.

title: Encounter 5: Turnabout Boost
overview: In the midst of the duos round, the others find out that Morio is a wanted criminal as he proposes to Michinaga a change in partners.

title: Encounter 6: Kick the Can and the Last Boss
overview: Keiwa rediscovers childhood memories of what he wanted to be when he grew up; the final boss of this Desire Grand Prix has appeared, who has left previous games with no winner.

title: Encounter 7: Trump Card Ninja
overview: Keiwa's sister calls with news of a monster attack, but before the Kamen Riders can finish the round, Keiwa learns a shocking truth about his past.

title: Encounter F: Wake Up! Monster
overview: Kicking the can becomes near impossible, bringing forth a new side-quest of hatching eggs.

title: Strategy 1: The Beat of a New World
overview: Ace gets another wish for winning the Desire Grand Prix, now competing with a brand new set of competitors in a new game. A game which includes the staff controlled Punk Jack from last game.

title: Strategy 2: The Jamato Labyrinth
overview: The second round of this game has begun, transporting the players to an alternate dimension where they must each escort a civilian, with Keiwa being among the group of civilians.

title: Strategy 3: Slot Fever
overview: While the players must figure out a Jyamato password to leave, Keiwa rediscovers his desire for a better world.

title: Strategy 4: Recover the Driver!
overview: A mysterious girl appears to all of the remaining contestants, forcing a competition to reclaim their drivers.

title: Strategy 5: An Angry Glare
overview: Win and Ace both still lack drivers in order to continue in the Desire Grand Prix, while the Gamemaster takes things into his own hands.

title: Strategy 6: Kamen Rider Qualifications
overview: It's time for Keiwa, Neon, and Michinaga to compete in the Desire Grand Prix finals, but things feel odd with Ace not here with them.

title: Strategy IR: Kitsune Hunting
overview: Keiwa and Neon are told that the next round is a hunt to take out Ace, but they and Tsumuri struggle with the gamemaster's decision for this illegal game.

title: Deviation 1: Welcome to a New Season!
overview: A new gamemaster is in place and a new Desire Grand Prix is set in motion that sees the contestants living together to find a spy among them.

title: Deviation 2: Bravo! The Jammer Ball Showdown!
overview: The contestants learn that they must vote on who the DisaStar is, and they will be ejected, no matter if they are the spy or not; Jamato arrive to compete in a sports game against the contestants.

title: Deviation 3: A Vote! Who Is the DisaStar!
overview: The contestants continue their ball game as the time ticks away to place votes for the DisaStar.

title: Deviation 4: Parcel From the Jamato
overview: A new game begins that involves the Jamato delivering bombs.

title: Deviation 5: Gazer's Hammer!
overview: Sae must save her family from a bomb while Beroba puts together her own anti-Kamen Rider team.

title: Deviation 6: After Him! Chirami Is It!
overview: The Jyamato haven't been sent out in a while, so a new game begins against the Gamemaster - a game of tag.

title: Deviation T: Now! If It's for My Player
overview: Beroba has taken Chirami's Driver, rendering the current round of the Desire Grand Prix null.

title: Deviation SP: Emergency Broadcast! The Entire Desire Grand Prix!
overview: Ace, Keiwa and Neon talk with their supporters as the Desire Grand Prix is put on hold and replaced with a special episode.

title: Lamentation 1: Jamato Grand Prix♡
overview: Beroba starts up her own Jamato Grand Prix, but the Desire Grand Prix contestants refuse to sit idle as the Jamato run loose on the city.

title: Lamentation 2: Crimson Boost!
overview: A local festival is canceled due to frequent reports of Jamato attacks, even though a young boy was looking forward to it so that he could wish his mother well again.

title: Lamentation 3: A Fun Sengoku Game♡
overview: The second game of the Jamato Grand Prix is underway as Keiwa and Neon are turned into enemy combatants for their Sengoku-style contest; Ace is feeling sleepy after using his new Crimson Boost.

title: Lamentation 4: A Laser Boost of Bonds!
overview: Beroba continues her Sengoku game as Ziin comes to a realization after he and Ace almost die.

title: Lamentation 5: Surprise! A Bullfighting Game♡
overview: It's Neon's birthday and her supporters want to throw her a birthday party, but Beroba has other plans and starts by luring Keiwa into a game.

title: Lamentation 6: The Prince From the Letter
overview: Neon's struggling with the reveal about her past with Beroba targeting her to compete next.

title: Lamentation 7: The Heaven and Hell Game♡
overview: Neon has gone missing while Beroba plots the final round of the Jamato Grand Prix and Buffa's victory.

title: Lamentation F: The Final Verdict
overview: Archimedel turns on Beroba, claiming that he is the biggest Jamato supporter; Ziin returns with words for Ace.

title: Yearning 1: Buffa Unmatched!
overview: Ace and Keiwa have gone missing and Michinaga now has his wish of the power to wipe out all Kamen Rider.

title: Yearning 2: Geats' Target
overview: Desire Royale participants have been chosen; Kekera has a plan to get Keiwa back.

title: Yearning 3: Big Sis Wish, Little Bro Wish
overview: Daichi asks Neon and Sara for a truce when Sara meets her mysterious supporter.

title: Yearning 4: Temporary Alliance
overview: Niramu and Win are back and the staff plans to pick up and go to a different era.

title: Yearning 5: Destruction Pure as White
overview: Win and Tsumuri go through the Desire Grand Prix archives as the contestants participate in a useless battle.

title: Yearning F: The Nine-Tailed Fox!
overview: Sueru plans to replace Mitsume as the Goddess of Creation.

title: New World 1: My Desire Grand Prix
overview: The Desire Grand Prix staff has left, but the competitors still have their memories intact and the Jamato are still on the loose.

title: New World 2: Tycoon's Awakening
overview: Sara goes missing after bumping into Daichi during a Jamato attack.

title: New World 3: The Jet Black Shogun
overview: Keiwa is a wreck over losing Sara while Daichi sends the world into panic over the Jamato.

title: New World 4: Goddess Complete, Blade of Darkness
overview: Keiwa has taken Tsumuri and the staff plan to use her to create a new Goddess.

title: New World 5: The Name is Gyaago!
overview: Keiwa gets his ideal world of every competitor returning granted, but it comes at a price.

title: New World 6: Shine On, Neon
overview: Neon's dad starts treating Neon like his actual daughter; Tsumuri refuses to be the next Goddess.

title: New World 7: A Wish's Outcome
overview: Beroba recruits DaPaan to be a Rider again while Ace prepares to face Keiwa.

title: New World 8: Farewell, Micchii
overview: Ace remakes the world back to before Keiwa's wish.

title: New World 9: A Genuine Kamen Rider
overview: Kekera wipes out all other Kamen Riders to teach Keiwa a lesson.

title: New World 10: Tsumuri's Requiem
overview:
"Let the game that leads to the destruction of this world, begin."

No matter what, a dangerous game that threatens peace must be stopped. Ace and the others transform into Kamen Riders to confront their troublesome "enemies"!

And the situation will come to an end in the most unprecedented way ever...

title: Daybreak 1: Now for the Highlight!
overview:
Tsumuri points her Magnum Shooter 40X at Ace... and a gunshot rings out! Was Ace shot?!

A world where everyone can be happy, just what is Ace's true wish? For that... we witness the end!

title: Gotcha! Hopper 1!
overview:
Houtarou is a high school student in search of his own "Gotcha" (something unique to him). However, he is still in a daze, unable to even decide on a career path. His classmate Rinne looks down on him.

Then, Houtarou meets a grasshopper. "I don't know what it is, but when I'm with you, I feel a stirring in my heart..." Then, Steamliner suddenly appears and takes Houtarou to another space. In the other space, a mysterious man entrusts Houtarou with a Driver, saying it is his hope for the future. Then an enemy attacks!

The target is Houtarou's Driver. Houtarou loads the card into the Driver! He transforms into Kamen Rider Gotchard..!

title: Chase, Alchemy, Skateboards!
overview:
After transforming into Kamen Rider Gotchard, Houtarou wants to learn more about the Chemmies and is advised by his teacher Minato to take the entrance exam for the secret Alchemy Academy. However, Houtarou runs into a problem.

Meanwhile, Ryo Kajiki meets a talking skateboard who loves to play with children, but...

title: Finding Bushido
overview:
Houtarou continues his quest to befriend all the Chemies as he meets a Chemy known as Apparebushido, and is given his card by Minato.

A new Malgam appears and Houtarou attempts to fight it using Apparebushido, but it defies orders and causes Houtarou to be defeated.

"Just how can I get Apparebushido to open up to me?" Houtarou asks himself as he begins to secretly train. Just then, he is approached by alchemist named Spanner Kurogane, who demands the Gotchardriver!

title: Antrooper Labyrinth
overview:
Houtarou can't help but exclaim in admiration at Valvarad's powerful might. However, Spanner says that he didn't acknowledge Houtarou as a Kamen Rider and leaves.

Houtarou and Rinne, who continue their search for Chemies, come face to face with the Three Dark Sisters, Atropos, Clotho and Lachesis. Lachesis then absorbs a Chemy and transforms into Malgam. Houtarou transforms into Gotchard, but immediately after that, they are sent to a huge, different space!

title: Burn! Fight! Wrestler G!
overview:
Seeking the teachings of Renge and Sabimaru who has sealed away a lot of Chemies, Houtarou and Rinne go to a certain professional wrestling Dojo with Renge and the others.

When Houtarou immediately tries to find a Chemie, he's attacked by gang-like men who are after the Dojo's land. However, Alchemy can't be used against ordinary people. In front of a confused Rinne and the others, Houtarou borrowed Renge cards and transformed into Gotchard! However this time, a powerful Malgam suddenly appears!

title: Super A Class☆The Twisted Star
overview:
A mysterious man appears in front of Supana after tracking him. He changes into a Malgam before attacking the former and Houtarou. Supana then transforms into Valvarad and counters, and so does Houtarou into Gotchard, but the Malgam escapes after Valvarad's counterattacks.

However, the man, who is set on overthrowing Supana, kidnaps Rinne in front of Houtarou in order to lure his nemesis out.

Who on earth is this man? And why is he so obsessed with Supana!?

title: Farewell SaboNeedle
overview:
A boy appears in front of Houtarou and others, asking to take over Saboneedle. Since Ordinary people and Chemies cannot coexist, Rinne, who values the rules, tries to accept the boy's request, but Houtarou is not convinced.

Doesn't he really want to be with Saboneedle? Houtarou tries his best to find out the boy's true feelings, but then a new Malgam appears. What is the true identity of Malgam who is targeting the boy for some reason!?

title: Great Bonds
overview:
Saboneedle flew out of the driver during the battle with Dragonfly Malgam. Houtarou senses something as Riku becomes more distraught than ever, asking, "Where has Sabosuke gone?"

Meanwhile, Atropos suddenly appears in front of Rinne...!

title: Dash to Kyoto! School Trip!
overview:
Houtarou and his group from Furasu High School go on a school trip to Kyoto. Houtarou is assigned to a group study with Rinne and Kajiki, and by chance Kajiki meets a girl named Hijiri, and they hit it off. They immediately become attracted to each other.

At the same time, one of the Three Dark Sisters, Clotho, was also sighted in Kyoto in order to obtain something. But Clotho happens to see Houtarou and the others, and in her anger, she creates a new Malgam...!

title: Blazing Kyoto! Scorched Love: The Chemy Thunderous Affair
overview:
Hijiri, whom Kajiki is in love with, has a boyfriend! Although Kajiki is depressed, he learnt that Hijiri boyfriend is most likely the remaining suspect who made his escape after Clotho attacked the police van!

If that's the case, then there's a possibility that the suspect has already became a Malgam. Hijiri who is with Kajiki is in danger! Houtarou and Minato start searching for the suspect together, but...!

title: Catch! It's a Spy?! Can't Be a Rider!
overview:
Clotho captures a Level 10 Chemy for the Three Dark Sisters and subjects it to their creepy experiments, bringing them closer to completion of "something".

Meanwhile, Kugimiya and Harima from the Alchemys Union arrive at the academy and warn the students that there may be a mole within their ranks. However before he begins investigating on who the possible mole is, he heavily criticizes Houtarou's fighting style as a Kamen Rider.

title: Out of Control Liner! Dark Rider!
overview:
The spy for the Three Dark Sisters turned out to be Shiori Harima, an investigator from the Alchemy Union. Houtarou lashes out in anger at Shiori, who attacks the Chemy, but is tormented by her use of forbidden alchemy.

Then the Three Dark Sisters appear. When Atropos and her sisters get their hands on a mysterious driver, they say "now it's your turn" to the mysterious warrior known as Kamen Rider Dread, and begin a new terrifying experiment.

Just who is this dark destroyer, Dread?

title: Return to Normal! Friends x Forever!
overview:
"Sabimaru-Senpai is gone."

Houtarou laments his immaturity and weaknesses in the face of fleeting, yet endless suffering. How can he help Sabimaru? Just then, Houtarou is invited by Kajiki to call out a UFO whose sighting has recently become more frequent.

Houtarou and his friends find a possibility to rescue Sabimaru by befriending UFO-X. However, the Three Dark Sisters and Sabimaru with the Dreadriver appear before them! Equip yourself with the Number 10 Chemy and Change to Super Gotchard now, Houtarou Ichinose!

title: Open Wide Rex! Dangerous X!
overview:
"There's something I'd like to ask of you, Ichinose."

Houtaro is asked by Rinne, who has a thoughtful look on her face, to confide in him about a certain problem of hers. Just what exactly is on her mind?

Then the two are dispatched to the appearance of a new Level 10, X-Rex. Houtaro and Rinne attempt to tame it but encounter a little girl instead...

title: Seize Happiness! Shine Gotchalibur!
overview:
The raw power of Super Gotchard overwhelms Dread and gains an upper-hand, but Dread is capable of executing counterattacks, resulting in a back-and-forth battle.

Meanwhile, Lachesis approaches the daughter-father duo Sawa and Manabe. Rinne attempts to protect them but Atropos intervenes with her magical abilities.

"So you are powerless after all."

Rinne is robbed of her bodily freedom by the triumphant Atropos...?!

title: Crisis Xmas! Serpent Incident
overview:
Supana returns to his master Kyoka Edami to have her repair his Valvarusher, which was heavily damaged during his battles with the Three Dark Sisters. As he arrives in her laboratory, he becomes intrigued by the blueprints of a new weapon she is developing.

A giant snake suddenly appears from the sky and attacks people with its petrification rays. Houtaro transforms into Gotchard and confronts the snake, who speaks in an eerie voice.

"Are you Kamen Rider...?"

What is the true identity of the giant snake?

title: Moonbreak Messenger
overview:
While Houtarou is serving New Years Food to Rinne and the others, he's wondering who is the Orange Gotchard that appeared during Christmas, and the sudden strengthening of the Malgam...

Suddenly, a Malgam appeared before Houtarou! Houtarou transformed into Gotchard, but he struggled against the empowered Malgam. As the Orange Gotchard appeared, he tells the shaken young man "As you are right now, you'll never defeat that Malgam."

A suprising development awaits Houtarou and co. as a person starts to move after Geryon's revival...

title: Sweep Through! The Evolutionary Firelord!
overview:
Houtaro and Rinne are disappointed in a world where not only the Alchemy Academy, but also their teacher Minato does not exist. The Moon Malgam then appears in front of the two and mocks Rinne where it takes her into the shadows.

"What should I do to become stronger and defeat the Moon Malgam?", asks a worried Houtaro.

Gotchard Daybreak then replies. "I will transport you to the past."

Just what is in Houtaro's past? What should he do there?

title: The Dawn of Rinne! Transform, Majade!
overview:
Houtaro and his friends are in high spirits once they formed the Kitchen Ichinose Alliance. However, Rinne is still dispirited as she wonder if this is the 'rules' she had to follow as an alchemist.

While Rinne is elated to know that Fuga is in fact not a traitor at all, Minato suddenly comes to her and invited her back into the academy! While this might be the right thing to do as an alchemist, Rinne is shaken by her former teacher's invitation. Meanwhile, Atropos arrives with a new Malgam and ordered the Malgam to exclusively attack Rinne. With Gotchard struggling, Rinne is cornered!

What did she see in Atropos? Now, the sleeping power inside of Rinne will be awakened! Now transform into Majade, Rinne Kudo!

title: Smiling Angel, Unfunny Joke
overview:
Kyoka arrives to see Houtaro and the others. Kyoka, who claims to be Supana's teacher, begins to talk about Supana's past, which even Houtarou and the others did not know. "It all started 10 years ago..."

At that time, Supana's parents appear before him, worried that he will never be as strong as Houtaro and Rinne. Supana is happy to see his parents again after a long time, but...!?

title: Mad Warrior! The Black Flame, Valvarad!
overview:
Houtaro drives the runaway Wheel Malgam into de-transformation with the power of Fire Gotchard. However, Supana stubbornly shuts his mind, saying to Houtaro and the others, "This is my battle," and remains engulfed in black flames.

Houtaro and the others support Kyoka in making a new driver for Supana. They continue working on it through the night, but now Geryon's evil hand is closing in on Kyoka..!

title: Love Is a Saber! A Sudden Chemy Story
overview:
Renge has fallen under the spell of Zukyumpire. Zukyumpire attracts many men and women, but when Houtaro and his friends investigate, they discover that Renge and the others are in danger...!?

Meanwhile, Geryon, who has failed to dye Supana with malice, begins a new course of action using Clotho!

title: Always Hit Right in the Heart
overview:
Houtaro and Rinne try to stop Zukyumpire, who steals energy from people. Then, Renge and others bring one of the Zukyumpire worshippers, Yui, to the scene.

Houtaro and the others, after hearing from Yui about the circumstances surrounding Zukyumpire, desperately try to persuade him. When Zukyumpire learns that he has been tormenting people, he is devastated, and at the same time, something strange happens around him. At the same time, strange happenings occur around them, and Clotho shows up to take advantage of them..!

title: A Sudden Twist! The Forbidden Steel Rider!
overview:
Houtaro and the others are overjoyed to receive a letter from Minato saying that he will take down Geryon. They immediately rush to the location Minato has designated, but suddenly a new Malgam appears. Houtaro is deprived of all his cards except for Steamliner.

He is unable to transform into Gotchard. Houtaro still wants his cards back, so he consults with Kyoka and learns that there is only one way to transform, though it is a forbidden technique...

title: The Faults of a Young Sensei
overview:
Houtaro transforms into Iron Gotchard, but his physical strength is depleted and the transformation is canceled. He is saved by Fuga, the father of Rinne, who suddenly appears and escapes from the battle with Dread Type One.

Fuga explains about "an incident" that occurred 10 years ago, which is the reason why Minato abandoned Houtaro and the others to follow Geryon. Houtaro and the others, who understand Minato's true intentions, confront him once again...!

title: Thwarting Evil. The Jet Black Winds
overview:
Geryon has unleashed the deadliest Malgam to open the door to darkness. Rinne and Supana transform into Riders to face him, but they are cornered by his powerful force.

Houtaro transforms into Iron Gotchard to save them. They go head-to-head, but gradually his strength is depleted and he is unable to transform. Just when all seemed to be lost, Fuga appears.

"I will light the way for these youth." And then Fuga...!

title: Gotcha! X Hopper!
overview:
Houtaro, Rinne, and Supana transform into Riders in front of Geryon, who tries to open the dark door! Geryon also transforms into Dread and tries to steal the Gotchardriver.

However, Iron Gotchard soon reaches the limit of his strength and is attacked by Dread, causing him to untransform. Geryon gets the Gotchardriver and finally opens the door to darkness...!?

title: It's Licking Bizarre! Renge Visits Home!
overview:
Renge, who was visiting her grandmother's village, informs Houtaro and the others that a yokai has appeared and she wants them to come immediately. In that village, a man named Starshine Hoshino, who calls himself a specialist in exterminating yokai, appears, and his apprentice is Kajiki!?

Houtaro and Rinne arrive in the village and immediately discover the yokai! Houtaro transforms into Gotchard...!

title: This Town Is Weeping
overview:
The village chief is found in a grisly state, and the villagers assume it is the work of Starshine Hoshino and make a big fuss. They lock Hoshino and his apprentice Kajiki in a warehouse.

Kajiki would never attack anyone. As Houtaro and the others begin their search for the real culprit, a new Malgam appears. Houtarou transforms into Gotchard, but he feels something strange about the Malgam's behavior. What is this discomfort? And what is the truth behind the incident...!?

title: A Rival Appears?! Gotcha and Juliet
overview:
In order to save the drama club, Houtaro and his friends decide to help put on a performance of "Romeo and Juliet". Mikuriya, the head of the club, selects Houtaro to play Romeo, while Seina, a transfer student and childhood friend of Houtaro, runs for the role of Juliet, while Rinne is put off by the fact that she is not a member of the club.

Rinne is bothered by Houtaro and Seina's sudden closeness. Atropos appears, sees through Rinne's emotional turmoil, and unleashes a Malgam. Rinne desperately defends Seina who is nearby...!

title: The Darkness Pair, Believe in Each Other
overview:
"Kudo! Fight like you are!"

With the advice of Minato, Houtaro and Rinne manage to escape their predicament, but Rinne's feelings and the future of the "Romeo and Juliet" production become uncertain.

Furthermore, Atropos appears with a new Malgam. Houtaro and Rinne transform into Riders, but Majade strikes them with a powerful blow...!

title: A Great King Is Here! A Puppet's Dilemma
overview:
Houtaro, who defeated the Malgam and got a new Chemy, was attacked by an angry Clotho!

With Geryon gone, what is the point of fighting? Houtaro fights back and pleads desperately, but Clotho refuses to listen to him. Then, suddenly something unusual happens and a new enemy appears to attack Houtaro and the others...!?

title: Legend Rider? 100 Years Too Early!
overview:
Saigetsu, Mimei, and Tasogare of a mysterious organization appear before Houtaro and the others. The three, who say they are looking for a super weapon in this world, call in the Kasshine army to attack the people.

We will stop them! In front of Houtaro and the others, who are furious, Saigetsu and the others transform into Kamen Riders such as Dark Kiva! Houtaro, Rinne, and Supana also transform into Riders and stand up to them...!

title: Only One! All Roads Lead to Gorgeous
overview:
Kaguya, who is reunited with Houtaro, comes to Furasu High School and charms the students with his "gorgeousness." Houtaro is taken aback by the notoriety that even a fan club has been formed.

Houtaro and Kaguya are again faced with the appearance of the Hundred's Kasshine army. Houtaro and the others transform into Riders and defeat them, but Kaguya utters ominous words about the leaders still being nearby...?!

title: Gorgeous Time! Legendary Is Never Ending
overview:
Kaguya transforms into Legend and attacks Houtaro. Houtaro also transforms into Gotchard and fights back, but Kaguya shuts him down and says, "Gorgeous time is over," and leaves him alone.

They are supposed to have made up, but why? Houtaro and the others are puzzled by Kaguya's sudden change, but then a giant clock appears in the sky above them. What does the ticking of the clock mean? Moreover, the Dark King Gigist begins to act in secret...!?

title: Origin of the Chemy! I Understand
overview:
The Dark King Gigist appeared at the Union headquarters. Supana, angered by Gigist's defeat of one of the Union leaders, transforms into Kamen Rider Valvarad. He boldly attacks Gigist, but...

Gigist appeared in front of Houtaro, took away Skebows' card, and turned it into a Malgam. Houtaro transforms into Gotchard and challenges the Malgam to save Skebows, but he feels something strange in the battle...!?

title: Hopper-1 and Treasure
overview:
Houtaro and others show Kyoka the completely white Skebows. They want to somehow regenerate Skebows! Houtaro and the others look at it as if praying, and Kyoka...!?

Hopper1 sets off alone on a journey to find "something" to cheer up Houtaro. Meanwhile, Gigist has taken Antrooper from Houtaro and turned it into a Malgam. The Malgam attacks people, and Houtaro and the others...!?

title: On the Other Side of the Rainbow
overview:
Houtaro, who was spirited away from Rinne and the others by a giant egg, finds himself in a black space with a floating blue egg. "What is this place? Who are you?" Houtaro asks the egg.

Gigist stands before Supana, who was on his way to rescue Houtaro. Supana transforms into Kamen Rider Valvarad, only for Gigist to unleash the mighty Malgam, which he had created by rallying his Chemies, on Kamen Rider Valvarad!

title: Gotcha Complete! Climax 101!
overview:
Renge proposes a competition to retrieve the two remaining Chemies, with Nijigon at stake. Despite a stunned Houtaro, Rinne, Sabimaru, and even Nijigon get involved...!

Gigist appears before Houtaro. Gigist tries to dye the Chemies in darkness, but Houtaro uses the power of Nijigon to prevent him from doing so. He transforms into Rainbow Gotchard and clashes with Gigist!

title: A Wicked Arrival! The Triply Great Dark King
overview:
It was the Underworld King Germain and Gaelya who descended to earth from the Ouroboros world. Their target is Fuga, the father of Rinne, the most powerful alchemist. The Three Dark Kings, including Gigist, are closing in on Fuga.

Houtaro, Rinne, and Supana rush to the scene and transform into Riders! They confront the Dark Kings to protect Fuga, but they are cornered by the unprecedentedly vicious power used by Germain and the others...!

title: Trace of God, Grace of Rainbow!
overview:
While Houtaro and the others continue their search, Nijigon is wandering the streets, refusing to return until he finds something he can do to help. Nijigon meets a woman practicing dance.

Germain appears before Houtarou and the others again. Together with Rinne and Supana, they transform into Riders and face Germain with a strong determination to defeat him!

title: Let's Search! 102 Bodies and a Brother's Feelings
overview:
Houtaro and his team receive information that the 102nd Chemy has unexpectedly appeared. Houtaro, Supana, and Sabimaru begin a search based on this information, and arrive at a certain research institute where Sabi's brother, Ken'ichi, works.

A new Malgam appears at the institute. Is the 102nd Chemy real after all? And behind it all is the resurrected Geryon!? Houtarou and Supana transform into Riders...!

title: Love, Sorrow, or AI? The Power to Erase Hate
overview:
Mami, the director of Kongo Laboratory, begs Houtaro and the others to protect the laboratory from Geryon. Protect it from Geryon? What is the relationship between Mami and Geryon...?

Houtaro, suspicious of the Chemy's behavior, asks Sabimaru if it was really Kenichi who created the Chemy. For a moment, Sabimaru is perplexed, but then he reveals the truth behind the Tsuruhara brothers and Chemies. What is that unexpected truth!?

title: When Deep Memories Are Unsealed
overview:
Kajiki is depressed after being cold-shouldered by Hijiri, but is beginning to remember the memories that have been erased by Minato. Houtaro suggests to Minato that he revive all of Kajiki's memories for Kajiki and Hijiri's sake, but...

Meanwhile, the Dark King Gaelijah had begun a new course of action using Clotho. And that Malgam is in front of Houtaro and Rinne!?

title: Meeting of Fate, Crossroads of Love and Hate!
overview:
When Hijiri is brought to Gaelijah, she is shocked to discover that she has been transformed into a Malgam herself. Gaelijah tries to release her despair and transform her back into a Malgam.

Houtaro and Kajiki arrive on the scene. Houtaro transformed into Gotchard and entrusted Kajiki with rescuing Hijiri, but for some reason Hijiri shuns Kajiki, saying, "Don't come!" And Kajiki shuns her...!?

title: Black Astrology, Kurogane Oath
overview:
People's memories come back and information spreads that Chemies are terrifying entities that turn humans into monsters. The town is in a state of panic, filled with people who fear Chemies and Malgams, and those who want to obtain Chemies and use them for evil purposes.

Then, Golem Gouriki appears before Houtaro and transforms into the Gorilla Malgam. The alchemists are accused of being the masterminds behind the series of disturbances. If nothing is done, the world will be in chaos... Supana makes a decision and takes action!

title: A Great Clash! Houtaro VS Spana
overview:
Supana summons Houtaro and the others, erases the Chemy Cards so that they cannot be re-sealed again, and takes all the Chemy Cards from Houtaro and the others. However, Kyoka and Lachesis appear and reveal Supana's true intentions in front of Houtaro and the others.

When Houtaro learns the horrifying truth about Supana, he approaches Supana with fury. "Why are you always like this?" Houtaro and Supana finally clash!

title: Farewell to Twilight
overview:
Rinne, who is suffering, disappears from the presence of Houtaro and the others, and is kidnapped by Gaelijah along with Atropos.

Rinne's life will be in danger if nothing is done. Fuga and Glion, who has called for help, head for the rescue of Rinne and the others, only to find Gaelijah's evil trap awaiting them...!

And what about Houtaro, who arrives late to the scene!?

title: Metal Warrior! Silver Valvarad
overview:
Gotchard defeats the Malgam, who threatens the people, but the people of the city still fiercely condemn Chemies and the alchemists. A world where people and Chemies can live together.... Houtaro has no end to his worries.

Supana has lost his driver, and Gigist calls on him to fight with him. Supana refuses, and fights as Valvarad, but is engulfed by the black flames that Gigist unleashes. Supana foresees his own demise... but then!?

title: The CHEMY×STORY of You and I
overview:
Glion, transformed into Kamen Rider Eld by the power of the Philosopher's Stone, summons an army of Dreatroopers. The city and its people are transformed into gold, and El Dorado is steadily approaching completion.

Houtaro tells his mother, Tamami, that as a Kamen Rider he will create a future where humans and Chemies can live together, and that he doesn't want to run away from his Gotcha! He then joins Rinne, Supana, and the other Chemies in a final battle to defeat Glion!

title: Pilot
overview: A family struggles to reunite in an American landscape void of electricity: a world of empty cities, local militias and heroic freedom fighters, where every single piece of technology -- computers, planes, cars, phones, even lights -- has mysteriously blacked out forever.

title: Chained Heat
overview: In order to rescue Danny, Miles knows he and the gang will need help. Thus, the search begins for Nora, a rebel fighter battling against the Militia. Meanwhile, Aaron confides in Maggie and Danny lays witness to what Captain Neville is capable of.

title: No Quarter
overview: On the run from Militia, Nora leads Miles and Charlie back to the Rebel camp. Meanwhile, Aaron and Maggie search for Grace and Danny stands up to one of Captain Neville’s men.

title: The Plague Dogs
overview: After Charlie and Nora rescue Miles from Militia, they set off to meet Aaron and Maggie. Tracking Miles and Charlie at every turn is Nate. As the gang reunites and continues on their journey, unforeseeable challenges await.

title: Soul Train
overview: As the gang nears Neville and his men, their hopes of finding Danny grow until a shocking discovery threatens to impede their efforts. Meanwhile, orders from Monroe have upped the value of Danny's life and Nora connects with a fellow Rebel.

title: Sex and Drugs
overview: In order to save Nora from her injury, Miles leads the gang on a detour to visit an old acquaintance of his for medical support, but they quickly find themselves in unfriendly territory. Aaron recalls his meek history as he looks back at his pre/post-blackout life, and Neville delivers Danny to Monroe.

title: The Children's Crusade
overview: When Charlie meets a boy who's suffered a plight similar to her own, she relates and longs to help him and his young friends. First, she must convince Miles. Meanwhile, Rachel grows weary of General Monroe as she meets someone from her past.

title: Ties That Bind
overview: When Nora encounters a close relative, she must make a difficult choice between family and a promise. Meanwhile, one of the most ruthless members of the Militia is tracking Miles, Charlie and the gang and General Monroe hands Captain Neville a stern warning.

title: Kashmir
overview: Miles and the gang are bound for Monroe’s lair – Independence Hall, but their efforts are impeded when they begin to have difficulty separating fantasy from reality. Meanwhile, Monroe starts to grow suspicious of Rachel.

title: Nobody's Fault But Mine
overview: In the gang's quest to rescue Danny, the time has come for Miles and Monroe to meet face to face. Meanwhile, on the verge of reuniting with her brother, Charlie is conflicted by a shocking discovery and Rachel tests Monroe's patience.

title: The Stand
overview: Miles leads the rebel squad out of Philadelphia and away from Monroe’s helicopters and machine guns. Meanwhile, a guilt-ridden Rachel tries to redeem herself by providing power to the rebels, but once again must leave her children, Charlie and Danny, behind. As if there wasn’t enough heat, romantic sparks ignite between Miles and Nora.

title: Ghosts
overview: A final act of heroism by one of their own saves the lives of Charlie and the gang, but the loss devastates everyone and they must carry on with heavy hearts but increased resolve. Miles sets out on a mission with Nora to recruit his former Militia comrade, Jim Hudson and enlist his savage killing skills. Meanwhile, Rachel looks for a power source and a way back into the heart of her daughter Charlie. Rachel also attempts to elude the grip of Randall Flynn, her ruthless former boss and ally of Monroe.

title: The Song Remains the Same
overview: Neville faces danger and hard choices as Monroe doubts his loyalty, he disowns his son Jason and gets captured by Miles. Rachel and Charlie begin slowly patching their relationship only to be pulled apart again as Rachel suddenly embarks on a quest to restore the power and her self-respect. She must make a dangerous journey to the mysterious Tower as it holds her only chance at redemption.

title: The Night the Lights Went Out in Georgia
overview: Paranoia strikes Monroe deeply as Neville disappears and Neville’s son Jason makes a big decision. Meanwhile, the familial bond between Miles and Charlie grows stronger. Elsewhere, Miles experiences romantic attraction with both Rachel and Nora. Rachel sets off on her dangerous quest to infiltrate the Tower and restore power to the world before Monroe can ignite a nuclear device.

title: Home
overview: When the past catches up with Miles and Monroe in the form of mutual heartthrob, Emma all hell breaks loose for them physically and emotionally. Charlie and Nora are the ones who rescue Miles this time. Meanwhile Aaron’s life is turned inside out while accompanying Rachel on her tenacious trek to the mysterious Tower where she plans to restore the power.

title: The Love Boat
overview: Miles and Tom Neville find themselves fighting for the same cause but Miles still doesn’t trust him. Charlie, Jason and Nora attempt to pull off a daring river rescue of Dr. Stephen Camp to keep deadly anthrax out of the hands of Monroe. Meanwhile Rachel and Aaron are captured and threatened by Militia forces.

title: The Longest Day
overview: Romantic connections heat up between two couples -- Miles and Nora and Charlie and Jason -- but disastrous drone strikes from the Militia threaten them all. An assassination attempt on Monroe heightens his paranoia and Georgia Federation President Foster contemplates surrender. Meanwhile, Rachel and Aaron push through the Plains Nation into Colorado.

title: Clue
overview: A captive Nora is tortured and left for dead. Monroe learns of Rachael’s attempt to reach the Tower but is unaware of her deadly plan for him. Meanwhile, Miles is desperate to find out how so many of his close associates are being brutally murdered. Later, Miles, Charlie, Neville, Jason, Hudson and Sanborn struggle to make it out of the Plains Nation to join Rachel and save her from what they believe to be certain death.

title: Children of Men
overview: Rachel and Monroe battle with more than wits. Meanwhile, Miles, Charlie, Nora and Aaron get inside the Tower but Tom Neville and son Jason get shut out. Miles and Monroe once again face-off, this time even more lethally.

title: The Dark Tower
overview: Life-threatening dangers abound on all sides as the Rebels infiltrate the Tower. Miles' leadership abilities and character are sorely tested as well as his feelings for Rachel and Nora. Aaron's genius comes in handy while Tom Neville and Randall Flynn bring new meaning to the dark side.

title: Born in the U.S.A.
overview: Miles, Aaron and Rachel have found themselves in a mysterious small town, in the great nation of Texas where Rachel unexpectedly encounters an important figure from her past. Charlie finds herself on a mission in the Plains Nation while Neville and Jason search a refugee camp for a lost loved one. Meanwhile, Monroe has discovered a gritty role in his new environment.

title: There Will Be Blood
overview: Miles's life is in grave danger as he finds himself in the clutches of Titus Andover. Charlie is determined to find Monroe, as Rachel and her father, Dr. Porter desperately attempt to revive Aaron. Meanwhile, Neville hatches a plan to infiltrate the Patriots.

title: Love Story
overview: Rachel makes a valiant attempt to rescue Miles and to escape with an ailing Tribesman's wife, while Neville and Jason are caught off-guard, assaulted by violent refugees. Charlie and Adam are at odds over what to do with Monroe. Legions of Tribesmen threaten all of Willoughby but with questionable leadership and Aaron faces death, yet again.

title: Patriot Games
overview: Monroe and Charlie's dynamic begin to evolve. Meanwhile, wounds of Miles and Rachel begin to heal, yet her curiosity and heightened awareness could be her undoing. Neville's manipulation of Patriot power brokers makes Machiavelli look like a cherub and Aaron's mind works overtime awake or asleep with mind-blowing effectiveness. Rachel and Miles begin planning a resistance to what they believe might be the Patriot occupation.

title: One Riot, One Ranger
overview: Aaron and Rachel speculate on the extreme effects of Nano technology, while he also confides in Cynthia. Meanwhile a figure from Miles's rugged past, Texas Ranger John Fry reemerges. Fry could be Miles' chance to bring down the Patriots in a big way, however Fry will need convincing. Charlie has a surprise for Miles and her mother, while Secretary Allenford holds a secret important to Neville.

title: Dead Man Walking
overview: As Charlie, Rachel and Gene question Monroe's true allegiance, Miles himself is weary of his former friend's intentions. Meanwhile, Aaron continues to have visions that lead to endless questions.

title: The Patriot Act
overview: When Rachel discovers some unsettling truths, Miles does what he does best to overcome obstacles before him and those he cares about. Meanwhile, Charlie shares a moment with her mom as Neville and Jason continue with their struggles between father and son.

title: Come Blow Your Horn
overview: As Miles and the gang try to escape the perils of their current situation, Rachel and Gene continue to struggle with their relationship, which affects Charlie. Meanwhile, Neville takes a gamble with the Patriots.

title: Everyone Says I Love You
overview: The relationship between Rachel and Gene remains strained as Charlie shows her mom how much she's grown. Meanwhile, Neville gives Jason a determined proclamation.

title: Three Amigos
overview: When Miles leads Monroe and Rachel south of the border; they're met with much more than they bargained for as Neville and Julia dance a delicate dance. Meanwhile, Charlie and Gene continue their search for Aaron.

title: Mis Dos Padres
overview: Monroe finds himself in unfamiliar territory and must make a choice about his son Conner, while Neville and Julia continue to tango at Jason's dismay. Meanwhile, Gene leads Charlie to an uneasy discovery.

title: Captain Trips
overview: When Gene decides to assist the town of Willoughby, Rachel and Charlie feel compelled to help too as Miles and Monroe continue to join forces in order to survive.

title: Happy Endings
overview: Monroe leads Connor and Charlie on a risky mission, as Miles and Rachel keep an eye on things in Willoughby. Meanwhile, Neville gets a new assignment and Aaron reunites with an old friend.

title: Fear and Loathing
overview: With their lives in danger in New Vegas, Monroe and Connor face a difficult decision in order to survive. Back in Willoughby, Miles questions whether he can trust Neville and Jason to help take down the Patriots. Meanwhile, Aaron and Priscilla find themselves at odds over the nano code.

title: Dreamcatcher
overview: Aaron awakes to find himself in a world with power, married to Priscilla and running his company. As he gets the feeling that something isn't quite right, familiar faces begin to appear.

title: Exposition Boulevard
overview: Monroe, Charlie and Connor make their way back to Willoughby, where they find that the Patriots' reeducation center is up and running. An encounter with two of the center's young cadets leaves Rachel and Miles divided on the lengths they are willing to go in order to take down the Patriots. As Neville and Jason find a new ally for their mission, more about the history of the Patriots is revealed.

title: Why We Fight
overview: While Dr. Porter and Miles venture into Willoughby in search of allies within the town, Monroe seizes an opportunity to surprise the Patriots. Neville’s political maneuverings put him and Jason in serious danger, as Aaron and Priscilla continue on their journey.

title: Austin City Limits
overview: Frustrated with Neville, Jason turns to Miles with crucial information about the Patriots’ next steps for Texas. Determined to derail the Patriots’ plans, Miles and Monroe rush to Austin with Jason, Charlie and Connor in tow. Meanwhile, Aaron grows suspicious of Priscilla’s increasingly unusual behavior.

title: S#!& Happens
overview: As Miles, Monroe, Charlie and Connor rush to escape Austin, a confrontation with Texas Rangers separates Miles from the group. While out searching for Miles, Charlie is confronted by Neville who demands information on Jason's whereabouts. As a wounded Miles faces increasingly hopeless circumstances, Aaron learns that the nanotech has been busy.

title: Tomorrowland
overview: Truman, empowered with new authority from the President, launches a mustard gas attack designed to kill Miles and Monroe. To Rachel's disappointment, Miles agrees to join Monroe in a ruthless plot to beat the Patriots at their own game. As Neville faces his own challenge from the Patriots, Aaron grows increasingly alarmed by the power of the nanotech.

title: Memorial Day
overview: United by their desire to take the Patriots down, Neville and Monroe form an uneasy alliance. As Rachel comes face-to-face with the nano-tech while searching for Aaron, things don't go according to plan for Miles, Charlie and Gene when they try to steal the Patriots' supply of mustard gas.

title: Declaration of Independence
overview: Miles, Charlie and Monroe launch an attack on the Patriots, but must improvise a risky new plan in order to halt the oncoming war between California and Texas. Out for revenge, Neville sets his sights on President Davis. Meanwhile, Aaron and Rachel’s efforts to save Priscilla from the nano-tech has unexpected consequences.

title: On a Mission from M78 (Baltan)
overview: A mysterious spacecraft enters orbit just beyond Earth's moon and launches three pods toward the planet's surface. One of the pods is intercepted by the WINR team who determine its extraterrestrial composition is similar to certain Earth insects.

title: Catch a Kemura by the Tail (Kemura)
overview: While WINR tries to ascertain the implications of the recent Baltan attack and the appearance of the silver and red giant, farmers in a rural community begin reporting that their cattle have been disappearing. WINR launches the Mobile Transport Carrier (MTC), their large roving command center and discovers that the animal disappearances are being caused by a creature burrowing under the ground.

title: A Quartet of Creatures (Red King & Pigmon)
overview: A documentary film crew working in South America has discovered a place where gigantic, prehistoric monsters freely roam the land as they did millions of years ago. When the crew's gear mysteriously disappears along with their only method of calling for aid, WINR comes to the rescue.

title: The Dark Past (Teresdon)
overview: A pair of seismologists working in a remote cavern have detected unusual underground activity. Theresa Beck & Kenichi Kai are sent to investigate and Kai disappears when another tremor rocks the cavern. While Beck tries to console herself for losing Kai, the rest of the WINR team has determined that the seismic activity is being caused by a strange object moving underground toward the city.

title: Monstrous Meltdown (Gabora)
overview: An energy company has been tracking what they believe to be a moving underground uranium mine. Mr. Keins, the head of the company comes to WINR after one of his drivers is seemingly swallowed by the ground itself. WINR arrives at the site where the company plans to blast open the uranium mine with dynamite. However, instead of a mine, they end up bringing a giant monster called Gabora (who isn't referred by the name) to the surface.

title: The DaDa Effect (DaDa)
overview: On one night at an apartment, while a man named Mark Mitchell was checking his email, he received a message from someone known as “DaDa” only to be sucked right into his computer from merely touching the screen.

title: Devils from the Crypts (Aboras & Banilla)
overview: A pair of college students, spelunking in a cave discover a mysterious capsule at the bottom of a pit. Meanwhile, the Department of Water and Power calls in WINR when they discover a similar object that has washed up in a drainage ditch after a flood.

title: A Father's Love (Jamra)
overview: Julie Young's niece becomes the focus of a government investigation when she begins making claims that her father, the astronaut Jamra Miller has suddenly returned to Earth after being lost in space.

title: Fires Below (Zambora)
overview: Several mysterious brushfires have been spontaneously igniting near where a logging crew has been working. Frustrated by the lack of work being carried out, and unable to go to the regular authorities, the head of the logging company calls in WINR to investigate the cause of the fires.

title: Deadly Starfish (Pestar)
overview: When a storage tank at an oil refinery collapses under mysterious circumstances, the oil company calls in WINR to investigate. In discovering the cause of the refinery disasters, Kai is reunited with Arturo Mendez, a pilot with whom he had trained and who didn't make the cut to join WINR.

title: Dino Might (Gomora)
overview: A noted scientist, Dr. Nagana, returns from Tibet with what could be the greatest scientific discovery of the twentieth century a perfectly preserved Gomorasaurus.

title: Falling Stars Spell Trouble (Dorako)
overview: The Baltan ship, thought to have been driven off in episode 1, returns and launches three more pods to Earth. This time, however, the Baltans have decided to completely obliterate WINR and Ultraman Powered by sending a regenerated Red King and the bladed monster Dorako to do their dirty work for them.

title: The Final Showdown? (Zeton)
overview: Another Baltan pod is launched towards Earth and crashes into WINR headquarters, totally obliterating the base. From the pod emerges Zetton, the Baltans ultimate weapon, ready to do battle with WINR and Ultraman Powered.

title: Nanny Will Do
overview: A mysterious British nanny with psychic powers arrives at the Everett home to take care of the widwed professor's three children.

title: The Wiblet Will Get You If You Don't Watch Out
overview: Everyone pooh-poohs the imaginary beastie that's giving Prudence nightmares. But Nanny, true pixie that she is, maps inventive strategems to trap the thing.

title: The New Butch
overview: Prudence wants to learn to read, and Butch is feeling rejected. Nanny's solution: a typewriter that leaves messages for Prudence--and a scheme with a message for Dad.

title: The Scientific Approach
overview: Everett invites a lady psychologist home to dinner, unmindful of how she might react to his children's--and Nanny's--flights of fancy.

title: The Astronomers
overview: With his dad's beat-up old telescope, some amazing beginner's luck and Nanny's mysterious touch, Butch makes an astronomical discovery that creates a hubbub in the scientific world.

title: Spring, Sweet Spring
overview: It's positively weird. A series of mishaps stops the Everetts as they go their separate ways on a Saturday. Nanny, it seems, was thinking of a family picnic....

title: Nanny on Wheels
overview: The professor stands bemused and amazed at Nanny's solution to the second car problem: a 1930 Model A that will require a miracle to be run--even by Nanny.

title: Strictly for the Birds
overview: A grumpy zoologist has Nanny arrested for spiriting three ducklings out of a public park. Neither the grump nor the presiding judge is prepared for Nanny's defense ploy.

title: The Tyrannosaurus Tibia
overview: Waldo finds a dinosaur bone and buries it in Nanny's garden.

title: I Think That I Shall Never See a Tree
overview: The city's street widening project requires that the tree containing the children's tree house be cut down.

title: The Games Families Play
overview: The family is upset when the professor admits that his potential new job will require moving to a new house.

title: An Element of Risk
overview: The professor is afraid of seeing an old girlfriend, and Prudence is afraid of blowing up a balloon.

title: The Philosopher's Stone
overview: Nanny says that the stone she gives Hal will grant him three wishes.

title: A Fowl Episode
overview: The entire neighborhood is waking up to the noise of Prudence's pet rooster.

title: Nanny and the Smoke-Filled Room
overview: When Butch decides to run for homeroom president, Nanny decides to give him a little help.

title: The Human Element
overview:
Professor is working on a computer program.

Nanny takes the children in ""Arabella"", her car named after her Aunt.  3 boys laugh at Nanny and the children because of Nanny's car, calling it Yellow Arabella.  The 3 boys hassle Butch and Hal about Arabella and they propose a race.

Nanny laughs at the prospect of racing Arabella but says there is no race because old cars aren't to be raced, but to be loved for.

After Nanny turns the boys challenge of a race down they ask their father who also says he agrees with Nanny.  He suggests another way to have a race...using the computer program he has been working on.

The bully boys father says his Buckingham will beat Arabella even through the computer race.  The boys read all of their car information to the Professor who inputs the data into his computer.

The Buckingham wins the computer data race and the Everett boys are disappointed.  The family goes for a trip in Arabella and meet up with the Buckingham (magically of course!) along the way.

overview: This episode begins with the children coming home from school to find Nanny in bed with the ""dreaded lergys"".  The children are preparing to attend Francine's costume party.  When Butch goes into Nanny's trunk to get out some make-up he sees a passport with Nanny's photo giving he date of birth as April 18, 1864, making her 106 years old.  Since the 18th is the following day the children prepare to throw her  party.  The professor keeps trying to get Nanny to reveal her real age. title: Oh, What a Tangled Web
overview:
Hal falls madly for Bunny, a swinging chick who comes on to him during a Sadie Hawkins dance.  ""You look just like Robert Redford!"" exclaims Bunny. Hal is smitten by Bunny's feminine wiles.

After Bunny imparts that she is fifteen years old, thirteen year old Hal tries to impress her by claiming to be sixteen.  Complications ensue the next day, when the assertive Bunny calls Hal and asks him to pick her up for the movies.  Flustered Hal blurts out that he will be right over, in spite of the fact that he is too young to drive.

Nanny decides to bail out Hal, and she gives him a ride to pick up Bunny.  Bunny is confused, and perhaps suspicious as to why Hal isn't driving, but Nanny explains she is driving because that ""she loves to drive - even in Los Angeles.""

While at the movies, Francine, Hal's thirteen year old next door neighbor sits down in front of Bunny and Hal.  Francine, who has a crush on Hal, expresses surprise to see Hal with a high school girl.  Bunny reacts icily to Francine

title: The Magic Monkey of Kubla Khan
overview: Norman's fortunes take a turn when he purchases a monkey from an elderly man in the park and immediately begins amassing a fortune. However, fate is not inclined to let such good luck endure...

title: Public Enemy
overview: A severe thunderstorm forces Norman to seek refuge in an auction room. Inside, he experiences a series of strange accidents, including dodging an explosion, accidentally touching the Venus de Milo, and trying to evade a dangerous thug known as Mr. Big.

title: A Little Bit of Respect
overview: Are you a seven-stone weakling? Do you get sand kicked in your face? Even by women? Then follow Norman's example and get into uniform. Everybody respects a uniform - or so believes Norman. Yet he's too small to join the police force, nearly drowns as a lifeguard, and faints as a first-aid man! Finally, he goes for an interview as a night security officer...

title: I Gotta Hearse
overview: When you die, you die. However, there's no assurance you'll make it if Norman is behind the wheel of the hearse!

title: Who Was That Lady?
overview: Deirdre St. John Featherstone-Haugh is stunning, elegant, and cunning - and she has her sights set on Norman. Not out of attraction, but because she requires a partner in crime to secure a large sum of money. With amnesia, Norman is unwittingly drawn into her deceitful scheme. He is forced to masquerade as a prominent aristocrat and a former head-boy of Eton.

title: And I Mean That Most Sincerely
overview: Cheer up - you are smarter than you think. At least, that's what Norman discovers when he becomes the star performer on a TV quiz show.

title: The Angels Want Me For A Sunbeam
overview: When Norman is present, anything can happen - and it usually does. Who else on a construction site could mistakenly guide the operator of a wrecking ball machine to demolish the restroom while the foreman is inside? After such a memorable mistake, Norman questions if life is still meaningful - a mindset that will take him into uncharted territory.

title: Episode One
overview: Norman finds himself in tight holds, hindered by Kent Walton! He once again encounters a variety of unbelievable situations, including a dip in a freezing lake and a confrontation with three top wrestlers.

title: Episode Two
overview: Norman goes to donate blood to help society, but the hospital ends up receiving more than they expected.

title: Episode Three
overview: Norman has always believed in being honest, but when he tries to return a lost ring to its owner, he almost ends up in jail! Honesty is not always the best policy in this case.

title: Episode Four
overview: Most people dream of winning a prize one day. Norman is thrilled when he wins a supermarket competition. However, he soon discovers that not everything that shines is gold.

title: Episode Five
overview: Norman inadvertently overhears a scheme to duplicate confidential documents from a foreign embassy. Naturally, he is apprehended and subsequently experiences a sequence of close calls as his captors contemplate 'eliminating' him.

title: Episode Six
overview: A series of accidents propels Norman into the art world. His 'unique talents' astound art experts and critics alike, making him 'the master' to his devoted followers.

title: The Ladder
overview: Working as a clerk in a builder's office requires a quick brain and a pragmatic mind - something Norman lacks. However, he does possess a sense of duty. When his flatmate, Alec Potter, borrows a ladder without informing the boss, Norman tries to fix the situation but finds himself in a precarious position.

title: A Present for Linda
overview: Norman and the boss's daughter should both be happy as he searches for a birthday gift for her. However, Alec plays a trick, leaving Norman in a risky situation.

title: Double Trouble
overview: Norman is not the person you want around when the company transitions to double glazing.

title: To Catch a Thief
overview: For Norman, the solution to sharing a room with Alec is clear - partition. When Albert, the boss, discovers the decrease in timber stocks at the builders' yard, Norman is immediately suspected. Determined to prove his innocence, Norman sets out to catch the real culprit.

title: The Party's Over
overview: Alec's artfulness cannot even separate his new girlfriend from her chaperone.

title: Firebug
overview: Norman's curiosity about Alec's well-being leads to unexpected consequences.

title: Otherwise Engaged
overview: With the boss sick with flu, Norman acquires a liking for leadership. (final episode of the series).

title: Aqui se faz, aqui se paga
Ajuda se pede. Respeito se  ganha
O homem que todos queriam morto
Episode 1
overview: Consort LAU SAM-HO and Consort YIU KAM-LING, the two beloved concubines of Emperor SUEN CHUNG (personally named LEE YI) of the Tang Dynasty, keep picking on each other.  Seeing that LING, her once close friend, has changed significantly for the worse, HO expresses deep regret for failing to fulfill her mother KONG CHOI-KING’s dying wish.  The story dates back to 20 years ago…  After her husband is banished to the border areas, KING, accompanied by LING, enters the Palace as an imperial servant.  Head of the Imperial Household Bureau CHOI CHUNG-PING is impressed by KING’s extraordinary craft skills and sends her to the Department of Jewels, where KING is to work with Deputy Head YUEN TSUI-WAN on the final polishing of Empress KWOK’s jeweled phoenix hairpin.  Head of Attire CHUNG SUET-HA has been a bitter foe of WAN for decades.  With the help of Eunuch PO KAT-CHEUNG, HO can finally be reunited with KING.… ...

title: Episode 2
overview: After KING’s death, CHOI decides to destroy the phoenix hairpin as instructed by KWOK.  Unwilling to see KING’s efforts go to waste, WAN means to injure herself.  KWOK gives the phoenix hairpin to CHENG, and WAN begins to worry about the lady and her son.  HA purposely fights with WAN for the custody of HO as her apprentice.  As KWOK is about to start her plot against YI, the news that YI has fallen from a tree arrives.  YI suffers from head injury and seems to have developed some kind of mental problem.  KWOK allows YI to recuperate at the Taoist Temple, but not in the company of CHENG.  HA points out that CHENG and YI are separated by the phoenix hairpin and that it is WAN who has dragged them into trouble.  She ridicules WAN for being too selfish and making others suffer while WAN does not say a word to defend herself.  HO goes to see YI off, which touches him considerably.… ...

title: Episode 3
overview: KWOK needs HO to explain the design of the clothing, making HA and WAN believe that the Empress is going to punish the girl.  To everyone’s surprise and delight, KWOK appreciates HO’s design and holds it in high regard.  Chief General MA YUEN-CHI is no longer trusted by the Emperor after making a mistake.  CHEUNG who is deemed to be in the same league with him is also embroiled in the matter.  Except for HO, all the imperial servants have been avoiding CHEUNG.  CHENG’s health is deteriorating and YI is finally allowed to return to the Palace to see his mother.  LING and FEI-YIN pick a row over trivial matters, causing HO to accidentally damage Lady WONG’s new dress.  HO has no choice but to alter the dress design.  KWOK flies into a rage after knowing this.  To defend HO, HA shifts the blame onto WAN emphasizing that it is all a trap set by her.  LING and HO meet up at night but get caught by YIN midway through their gathering.… ...

title: Episode 4
overview: HO is greatly impressed by Chess Master HIN-YEUNG upon their first encounter.  Japanese chess player ONIZUKA KOJIRO has come to China.  As instructed, YEUNG’s father YIU-ON engages in a contest with the Japanese visitor but is defeated.  KOJIRO has set a chess puzzle for the Chinese.  Emperor MO CHUNG is so keen to solve the riddle that he keeps pushing his cabinet members for an answer.  LING is injured by YIN.  WING-FONG pretends to comfort LING and coaxes her into disclosing her design.  Knowing that SIU-YUNG, a skivvy from the Department of Jewels, is desperate to get out of the Palace to visit her dying mother, HA offers to intercede with CHOI for the girl in a bid to embarrass WAN.  Emperor MO CHUNG plans on attacking KOJIRO by making use of YI.  Luckily HO comes along in the nick of time and manages to get YI out of the jam.  FONG steals LING’s design and takes all the credit for it.… ...

title: Episode 5
overview: Knowing that YEUNG is not really confident in winning the contest, HO begins to worry about him.  Too desperate to recover his military power, CHI plans to kill HO and put the blame on KOJIRO, thinking that it may be a good way to please Emperor MO CHUNG.  Emperor MO CHUNG is very pleased about the victory in the chess competition, and agrees to put CHI back in charge of the military forces.  Mama TSU asks CHEUNG to buy cosmetics for her but refuses to pay the money.  HA upbraids TSU for what she did.  TSU gets irked and begins to harbor deep resentment towards HA as a result.  The Heads of Jewels, Attire, Food and Furnishings spot SIU-SHUN passing a golden necklace to LING.  LING gets a severe telling-off from WAN for this reason.  To vent her spleen and frustration, LING asks YI to cheer her up and to take her as his concubine.  TSU overhears their conversation and goes to inform KWOK at once.… ...

title: Episode 6
overview: HA and WAN both deny having anything to do with the account book.  For the sake of fairness, KWOK decides to lock up both of them as punishment.  TSU goes to question HA and WAN inside the prison.  Before long, CHOI arrives and suggests having a face-to-face conversation with KWOK and TSU about that.  TSU says that she has been instructed by WONG to question HA and WAN.  KWOK means to protect WONG and punishes CHOI instead based on a made-up allegation.  The Imperial Household Bureau has lost a leader overnight.  SHEUNG and YAN, together with other imperial servants from the four departments, ask to have a word with KWOK, who however refuses to see them.  To show their determination, the ladies decide to go down on their knees until their request is granted.  LING criticizes TSU when kneeling outside the Empress’s place, which infuriates the woman immensely.  To vent her anger, TSU threatens to sew LING’s lips up with thread.… ...

title: Episode 7
overview: YEUNG admonishes KWOK for being too unfair and manages to save all members of the Imperial Household Bureau, for which HO is very grateful.  Knowing that the Imperial Household Bureau has got itself out of trouble, CHI tries to approach CHOI again.  Having got so fed up with his hypocrisy, CHOI and the four department heads cannot help but pour scorn on him.  MO CHUNG goes hunting, during which he runs into YI and means to tease him for fun.  Luckily YEUNG is there and he offers to help YI out of the predicament.  HO TSAU-YEE asks WAN and HA to get her a nice dress and some accessories so that she can get MO CHUNG’s attention in a forthcoming party.  WAN asks LING to make a hairpin for YEE.  FONG gets so jealous that she is going to do LING an ill turn.  LING discovers her plot and manages to smash it somehow.  FONG begs for her forgiveness and LING graciously grants it.… ...

title: Episode 8
overview: HO is promoted to the post of Deputy Head of Jewels.  Not wanting to disappoint LING, HO would like to submit her resignation to WAN.  HA believes that it has been WAN’s life-long ambition to take away HO, so her hatred towards WAN is growing stronger and stronger.  YI tries to rescue HO when realizing that she has been injured by an animal trap.  HO is surprised by YI’s calmness and maturity.  CHOI urges the four departments to prepare for MO CHUNG’s birthday party.  HA notices that WAN has not yet submitted the accessory design, which makes her believe that WAN may have something to hide.  HA pretends to pay HO a visit in an attempt to get more information from the girl.  HA suggests using chrysanthemums as the theme of the Emperor’s birthday party, which gives WAN quite a shock.  Knowing that HO has already recovered from the injury, YI decides to reveal to her why he has been acting stupid all these days.… ...

title: Episode 9
overview: KWOK passes two bowls of so-called medicine to CHENG and YI and asks them to try it out.  KWOK finally allows CHENG and YI to get out of the Palace.  WAN pays CHENG a visit before she leaves.  To WAN’s great surprise, CHENG returns to her the lucky charm that she gave her earlier.  CHI claims that ON has been having an affair with WONG’s handmaiden SAU-LIN.  LIN cannot endure the harsh punishment and finally agrees to testify against ON.  HA is very fond of the perfume bag made by HO.  She asks HO to give it away to her and she means to show it to WAN later on.  Knowing that WAI has got MO CHUNG a few medical pills from the Taoist Temple, LING becomes worried about her and asks her to be careful not to be exploited.  MO CHUNG throws up blood and falls unconscious after finishing a bowl of soup.  All the maids and servants from the Department of Food are thrown to jail at once.… ...

title: Episode 10
overview: CHEUNG informs HO at once knowing that KWOK is planning to kill CHENG and YI.  HO reveals YI’s secret to YEUNG and YEUNG is willing to risk his life to rescue YI.  MO CHUNG’s assassination plot against YI is thwarted while YEUNG has suffered a serious injury and faints away in the bamboo grove.  HO stays with YEUNG all night to look after him.  LING discovers that HO is away from the Palace for the whole night.  Burning with curiosity, she keeps pestering HO for an explanation.
