overview: Chad confronts the men after not getting a rose. But soon the 11 remaining guys jet off to Uruguay with JoJo, where one man has to defend himself against unflattering gossip. Also, JoJo becomes the target of ugly tabloid reports that she's on the show for the wrong reasons and must argue her case to the men.

title: Week 5: Buenos Aires
overview: JoJo and the eight remaining bachelors visit Buenos Aires, where a second dreaded two-on-one date occurs. Also: five guys enjoy a day with JoJo in the La Boca neighborhood; and one lucky man goes on a sexy date at a performance art show. At the rose ceremony, JoJo stuns the men when she runs out.

title: Week 6: Argentina Countryside
overview: JoJo and the men visit the Argentinian countryside, where the first date gets off to a rocky start. Later, a private jet whisks JoJo and one lucky guy away to a vineyard. During dinner, the bachelor makes a shocking admission. A date with three suitors gets rained out, so JoJo spends the day with them ordering room service, pillow fighting and watching the Brazilian version of "The Bachelor." A one-on-one date allows one man to show off his horse-riding skills.

title: Week 7: Hometown Dates
overview: JoJo goes on hometown dates with the four remaining bachelors. First, she visits a family who has been affected by divorce.  Next, she visits a suitor's high school and learns he's not as confident as he seems.

title: Week 1
overview: In the first episode, even a self-confident Becca who knows what she wants can always use some support and advice. Three former Bachelorettes who all found true love – Rachel, JoJo and Kaitlyn – come to the mansion to help Becca prepare for her big first night. After some encouragement and sound guidance, Becca's three new friends toast to her bright future.

title: Week 2
overview: Twenty-one men – still reeling from the dramatic first rose ceremony – look to get their love story with Becca off to a good start as they move into the mansion. Fan-favorite Bachelorette couple Rachel and Bryan put eight of the bachelors through their paces in an obstacle course meant to test their abilities as a groom. Blake gets the first one-on-one date of the season planned by Chris Harrison with an assist from celebrity rapper Lil Jon. Ten lucky men arrive at a gym where they are challenged to show off their athletic skills while playing in a dodgeball tournament in front of a live audience. Iconic comedian Fred Willard joins Chris for color commentary. Some shocking news will be shared during the after-party which rocks Becca's world, and she must remain focused on her ultimate goal of finding a soul mate.

title: Week 3
overview: Two men's critical injuries and another explosive secret bring chaos to the house and Becca's dream of finding her soul mate.

title: Week 4
overview: Becca and the remaining men travel to Park City, Utah.

title: Week 5
overview: in Las Vegas, Colton and Becca explore the desert from an unusual vantage point; nine bachelors visit iconic entertainer Wayne Newton and his wife at their lavish estate, and are challenged to write new lyrics for his classic hit “Danke Schoen” and sing them in front of an audience; and the two-on-one date features David and Jordan in an intense showdown.

title: Week 6: Richmond, Virginia
overview: This week on The Bachelorette 2018, it was time to find out if Virginia really is for lovers as Bachelorette Becca Kufrin took the guys to picturesque Richmond, Virginia for some immersive history and a spirited debate as well as oyster shucking and something called an "Unhappy Hour." The feelings got real as Becca and Jason toured the city together and, as a surprise, several of Jason's best friends came to town. Leo also made the most of his one-on-one date, bringing Becca some feelings of security when she needed them most. But it was Chris R. who continued his downward spiral from last week in Las Vegas, starting arguments with Lincoln and just generally irking everyone else that made this trip to Virginia one that most fans won't forget.

title: Week 7
overview: Traveling to the tropical paradise of The Bahamas, Becca focuses on her most important decision to date: Which four of the remaining six men will receive hometown dates? Four roses will be handed out this week on three one-on-one dates and one group date. There will not be a rose ceremony. Those four lucky men will bring Becca home with them to meet their families.

title: Week 8
overview: Becca’s challenging journey to find love has not been an easy one: Emotions have run high, honesty has been called into question and hearts have been broken. After a tropical trip to The Bahamas, she returns to more uncharted territories: the four hometowns of Blake, Colton, Garrett and Jason. Are all of these men marriage material? Becca will try and find out from the people who know them best, as she moves closer to making her fairy tale come true.

title: Week 9
overview: Becca and the men travel to Thailand; the overnight dates give Becca the opportunity to spend intimate time with each of the men away from the cameras.

title: The Men Tell All
overview: The most memorable bachelors from this season – including Chris R., Christon, Colton, Connor, David, Jason, Jean Blanc, John, Jordan, Leo, Nick and Wills, as well as Christian, Jake, Joe and Kamil – return to confront each other and Becca one last time to dish the dirt, tell their side of the story and share their emotional departures. Finally, as the clock ticks down on Becca’s journey to find love, a special sneak peek of her dramatic final week with Blake and Garrett is highlighted.

title: Week 10: The Season Finale
overview: Becca makes her heart-wrenching final choice.

title: Week 1
overview: Hannah meets 30 hopeful bachelors, while Demi Burnett and Katie Morton gather intel on the men.

title: Week 2
overview: Hannah continues her journey with the remaining 22 men. Drag queens Alaska and Alyssa Edwards, and runway coach Miss J. Alexander host a pageant for eight hopeful bachelors. One bachelor races through the mud on a one-on-one date. Eight men gear up for a roller derby competition hosted by Fred Willard.

title: Week 3
overview: Actors Jason Biggs and Jenny Mollen take eight surprised bachelors to a birthing class. The bachelorette gets a real-life health scare and one man comes to her rescue. Lukas Graham performs "Love Someone."

title: Week 4
overview: Hannah and the remaining 15 men travel to the seaside city of Newport, Rhode Island. A one-on-one date in Boston leads to an unexpected revelation. At an explosive cocktail party, two rivals take turns throwing each other under the bus.

title: Week 5
overview: The amped-up emotions of last week continue as Hannah pulls two bitter rivals aside to try to get to the real truth behind the bad blood between them. A front-runner finally gets a one-on-one date with Hannah in the breathtaking scenery of Scotland. A group on 10 suitors, wearing Scottish kilts, compete in the first-ever "Bachelorette Highland Games."

title: Week 6
overview: Frustrated with the drama, a fresh start in Riga, Latvia, prompts Hannah to examine her relationships and decide whether she can continue.

title: Week 7
overview: Hannah takes her first one-on-one date bungee jumping. Two rivals face off in a wrist wrestling competition. Hannah and a date learn about a Latvian spa ritual.

title: Week 8
overview: Hannah and a date take a romantic boat trip along Amsterdam's canals. A bachelor puts his heart on the line, prompting Hannah to make an unexpected decision. The three-on-one date becomes explosive.

title: Week 9
overview: Hannah visits the hometowns and families of the final four bachelors.

title: Week 10
overview: Hannah and Peter enjoy time aboard a luxury yacht. After a day at the spa with Tyler, Hannah hopes to build her emotional relationship with him. Hanna discusses her other relationships with Jed. Luke shares his feelings about the fantasy suite.

title: The Men Tell All
overview: Hannah faces the men she rejected as 17 jilted bachelors confront her. Luke P.'s stunning final standoff in Greece is revealed.

title: Season Finale (1)
overview: Hannah's love story continues in Greece, where she feels torn between the three final men. Hannah talks to Chris Harrison about her experience. The men share the highs and lows of their stories.

title: Season Finale (2)
overview: The stunning conclusion of Hannah's journey to find love in an astonishing live, two-night finale event unlike any other in Bachelorette history.

title: Week 1
overview: Clare Crawley finally embarks on her journey to find her soul mate, with 31 men vying for her attention.

title: Week 2
overview: Clare goes on the first one-on-one date of the season. Ten of the men compete in a revealing game of dodgeball.

title: Week 3
overview: Yosef confronts Clare, who stands up to him. Former bachelorette DeAnna Pappas pays a surprise visit. Clare decides to have an extended after-party with eight of the bachelors.

title: Week 4
overview: Clare makes a stunning revelation to Chris, who shares the startling news with the men that the cocktail party and rose ceremony are canceled.

title: Week 5
overview: Tayshia Adams arrives to find the love of her life. More men are added to the 16 remaining bachelors. Clare and her fiancé, Dale, have a heart-to-heart chat with Chris Harrison.

title: Week 6
overview: Ashley Iaconetti and Jared Haibon set up a fun competition to challenge some of Tayshia's potential suitors. Eight men prepare for wrestling matches under the guidance of WWE and UFC fighters Amy Dumas and Tatiana Suarez.

title: Week 7
overview: Seven men compete for the only one-on-one date by writing and performing a love song for Tayshia. Becca Kufrin and Sydney Lotuaco help Tayshia plan an outrageous game of truth or dare for six of the men.

title: Week 8
overview: JoJo Fletcher arrives to help Tayshia navigate unsettling emotions. Tayshia and Zac C. dress up to capture some lovely wedding photos. 10 men attend an art class in order to reveal themselves through their creative talent.

title: Week 9
overview: Bennett and Noah continue to confront one another on the impromptu two-on-one date. JoJo Fletcher explains to the men that a rose this week will be their ticket to a hometown date with Tayshia. Adam Hambrick performs.

title: Week 10: The Men Tell All
overview: Tayshia agonizes over which of the men's families to meet for hometown dates. Some of the men look back at the season's romance, drama, and heartbreak.

title: Week 11
overview: Tayshia now has four bachelors she cares about. Since she can't travel to their hometowns, they need to be creative to show her what life would be like with them and their families.

title: Week 12
overview: Tayshia takes her relationships with Brendan, Ivan, and Zac to the next level in the fantasy suites. JoJo Fletcher and Rachel Lindsay lend Tayshia their support and advice.

title: Week 13
overview: When Tayshia introduces the remaining bachelors to her family, her father voices concerns that she might make a big mistake. On proposal day, Tayshia is overcome with emotion.

title: Week 1
overview: Twenty-nine charming men and one mystery box hope to get lucky in love with new bachelorette Katie Thurston. Kaitlyn Bristow and Tayshia Adams offer advice. Katie selects 23 lucky bachelors to continue to get to know.

title: Week 2
overview: The suitors receive a literal wake-up call. Katie and one lucky man go on a charmingly special camping date. Katie is forced to question who is truly here for the right reasons.

title: Week 3
overview: Former Bachelor Nick Viall helps the men share some of their personal stories. Drama begins to boil over in the house.

title: Week 4
overview: A group date of Truth or Dare is all fun and games until the night takes a serious turn. The men contemplate telling Katie a secret they've uncovered. Tayshia surprises Katie with a revelations about someone from her past.

title: Week 5
overview: Katie and Andrew S. have an important conversation about their future. One guy gets greedy with Katie's time. A rose ceremony brings Katie one step closer to hopefully finding her match.

title: Week 6
overview: One suitor opens up to Katie with vows of his own in a ceremonious one-on-one date. Katie then enlists Shea Coulee and Monet X Change to help find her a king in a group date debate. A one-on-one date becomes a two-on-two.

title: Week 7
overview: Four men join Katie on an artistic exploration inspired by New Mexico's own Georgia O'Keefe. Katie is faced with the hardest rose ceremony thus far and finds herself second-guessing her decision.

title: The Men Tell All
overview: Katie's former suitors speak out. One of the men has an emotional realization about his journey to find love. The men reunite for the first time since New Mexico to hash out all the drama and laugh at their mistakes.

title: Week 9
overview: After an unexpected and heartbreaking departure before hometowns, Katie is nervous and excited about continuing the journey with her three remaining men in New Mexico. Katie has a tense fallout with one of the guys.

title: Week 10
overview: Kaitlyn Bristowe and Tayshia Adams join a studio audience to watch the final moments unravel. Katie and her final three try to make sense of what happened in New Mexico.

title: Week 1
overview: Fan favorites Rachel Recchia and Gabby Windey set out on a journey to find love.

title: Week 2
overview: Gabby and Rachel surprise the 29 men left at the mansion by daring them to compete in a swimsuit pageant to earn one of six spots at the group date after-party. Rachel and Gabby prove to the men that they're in control of their journey.

title: Week 3
overview: After a rollercoaster week, the Bachelorettes make a decision at the rose ceremony that will alter the course of their journeys for the rest of the season; but when not all goes as expected, Gabby and Rachel are left to question everything.

title: Week 4
overview: Gabby and Rachel's men travel across Europe on their journey to find love; two lucky men join the leading ladies on an unforgettable adventure in Paris; Gabby challenges her men to show their willingness to fight for her love.

title: Week 5
overview: Gabby, Rachel and their 14 remaining men continue their seaside journey across Europe; Logan decides to confess his feelings; Rachel makes a shocking choice that affects all her remaining men.

title: Week 6
overview: The bachelorettes select two lucky guys for their most important one-on-one dates yet; a "cheesy" weightlifting competition; Gabby and Rachel are tasked with making tough decisions at the rose ceremony with many uncertainties still in the air.

title: Week 7
overview: Gabby and Rachel simultaneously visit their beaus' hometowns; knowing a proposal may be right around the corner, each woman sets off on their cross-country adventure hoping that meeting the men's families will open the door to a confession of love.

title: The Men Tell All
overview: Rachel and Gabby reunite with 14 of the most unforgettable men from the season; Gabby and Rachel answer burning questions from their former flames and welcome actors Billy Eichner and Luke Macfarlane to the stage to join in on the action.

title: Week 9 (1)
overview: In part one of overnight dates week, Gabby takes a leap of faith with Erich, and sets sail with Johnny; Rachel takes the reins with Tino.

title: Week 10 (2)
overview: In part two of overnight dates week, Erich and Gabby find themselves at crossroads; James and Zach each confess to a shocking truth about their feelings.

title: Week 11 (1)
overview: The eagerly anticipated first part of the two-episode live finale.

title: Week 12 (2)
overview: Gabby and Rachel are each down to one man looking for lifelong love; both women join Jesse Palmer as they watch the shocking conclusions to their journeys play out; the new bachelor makes his debut.

title: Week 1
overview: Jenn Tran meets the 25 suitors vying for her affections.

title: Week 2
overview: Jenn and her suitors jet-set to Melbourne, Australia, and continue their journey to find love; Jenn and a group of the men explore Melbourne's culinary delicacies; Jenn and one lucky man embark on a skydiving adventure.

title: Week 3
overview: Jenn whisks one man away for a date that could lead to soaring connections, then invites a group of her suitors to a male dance revue; the men go for a high-speed race around the track.

title: Week 4
overview: Jenn and her men head to Auckland, New Zealand, as her journey to find love continues; while connections soar and the men tackle their competition for her heart, an unexpected visitor arrives, leaving Jenn more confused than ever.

title: Week 5
overview: Jenn has a big decision to make following an unexpected visit from her past; from dates in helicopters to a group date on a sheep farm, Jenn and the men explore New Zealand.

title: Week 6
overview: Jenn and the men arrive in Seattle; during the group date, the men go on-air at a local radio station to answer questions; Jenn prepares to meet the families.

title: Week 7
overview: The stakes are high as Jenn travels across the country to meet the families of her remaining men; with only three roses to hand out and much left unsaid, she's hopeful the visits will provide the clarity she needs.

title: Week 8
overview: Jenn and her final three men arrive in Hawaii for a week of dates across land, sea and sky; amid the pressure of looming overnight dates, some men grapple with fears of commitment and rejection, leading them to question their futures with Jenn.

title: The Men Tell All
overview: Jenn reunites with 14 of her memorable men to address the season's most unforgettable moments; Devin seeks clarity on Jenn's feelings as she faces the tough decision of sending one man home.

title: Finale and After the Final Rose
overview: It's a crucial final week in Hawaii as Jenn introduces two men to her family; a live studio audience watches along as Jesse Palmer sits down with Jenn and her final two men to watch the conclusion of her journey unfold.

title: Arrivals
overview: Taylor Frankie Paul is ready to trade fractured fairytales for a first impression rose as she begins making her mark on Bachelor Nation. With hope, heart, and a little faith, she welcomes a new group of bachelors, each vying for a lasting love.

title: Welcome to Bayview
overview:
Tom Ballard is put in Bayview retirement home by drunken daughter Marion and her weak husband Geoffrey. 

Many of the residents are very passive but not retired journalist Diana Trent, whose mission in life is to annoy 'the idiot Baines' - Harvey Baines, the home's manager. Initially she thinks Tom is rather dotty but when he tries to organize the residents into action against the home's poor food she knows she has found an ally.

title: A Trip to Brighton
overview:
Diana rows with chief carer Jane for calling her a senior citizen and Tom does his best to ignore Marion and Geoffrey. 

Diana's niece Sarah has left her Porsche at the home so Diana drives Tom to Brighton in it. 

Harvey Baines reports it missing and the couple are stopped by the police but explain that Diana has her niece's permission to use it and Harvey is threatened with arrest for wasting police time.

title: Cheering Up Tom
overview:
Tom really thinks that he won't have to wait for God much longer when he says he is dying and is rushed to hospital. He is discovered to have had a heart attack but he becomes very depressed and talks about suicide,writing 'die on Thursday' in his diary. 

In order to talk him out of what she believes to be his plan to end it all Diana threatens to join him.

title: The Christening
overview:
Tom is going to the christening of his nephew and wants Diana to accompany him but she is not keen because her arthritis is playing her up. Because she failed to declare it on her application form, Baines tries to get her evicted from the home. 

Tom doctors a 'naughty' photo of Baines to blackmail him into changing his mind but Diana uses her old press contacts to 'persuade' the committee to let her stay.

title: Fraulein Mueller
overview:
Jane wants to become a nun so Baines sacks her and brings in stern German matron Greta Mueller, who is a tyrant and tells Sarah where Diana hid the Porsche. 

Tom cons Baines into making him the head of the Residents' Association and gets up a petition, which Baines thinks is to get rid of Diana, so he signs it. Actually it's to get rid of Greta, so he is forced to fire her and reinstate Jane.

title: The Psychiatrist
overview: Baines decides that if Diana and Tom are seen to be mentally incompetent it will give him power of attorney over them and end all his troubles, particularly as the home is in financial difficulties. So he refers them to psychiatrist Dr.Darrow, for whom they act out a well-rehearsed pantomine of odd behaviour, leading the doctor to conclude that they are not mad, just a touch eccentric, with unexpected help coming from Sarah.

title: The Helicopter
overview: With upcoming by-elections Councillor Ferguson is courting the grey vote and comes to the home. At the same time Diana, once a photo-journalist, takes Tom up in a helicopter to take aerial shots of local houses to sell to their owners. Among her shots is one of Ferguson and the Swedish nanny being very naughty on the lawn. This comes in very handy at scuppering Ferguson's plan to support a Japanese spare parts factory being built next to Bayview.

title: Counselling for the Dying
overview:
Following the death,alone, of a resident, Tom puts himself forward as a counsellor to aid and comfort the terminally ill. 

A new female resident arrives and has afternoon delight with old Basil. Some time later Basil seems to be dying and Tom rushers to counsel him but he is merely suffering from exertion after sex with the lady. However, the lady dies and Tom organizes a splendid send-off for her.

title: The Partition
overview: Tom is depressed because he is missing his late wife but Marion and Geoffrey are not keen to have him home on respite. He turns his attentions to Diana and suggests that they shack up together, a proposition that offends her so much that she has a partition built between their two rooms. Her mood is not helped by the arrival of new resident Daisy, who has a strong personality like herself and with whom she soon clashes, though Tom gets on well with her.

title: Daisy Takes Charge
overview:
Baines threatens Diana with expulsion unless she removes the partition but they both have more pressing matters to consider as Daisy becomes completely domineering, taking over the home with her ideas and threatening to get current staff sacked. 

Finally, Tom organizes a revolt against her, causing her to leave . . . and Diana to remove the partition.

title: The Thief
overview:
Resident Betty claims that her sewing basket has gone missing and Tom and Diana decide to investigate. Not fully believing Betty's story they follow her and Tom intervenes when they see her apparently shop-lifting. Tom is arrested and conducts his own court case, being found not guilty of theft, but guilty of contempt of court. 

Later, Diana recalls that she had the sewing basket all along, having borrowed it from Betty and forgetting she still had it.

title: Tell the Truth
overview:
Tom 's belief that one should always tell the truth offends Jane, who has made herself look glamorous to appeal to Baines and Tom says she looks hideous. He also upsets Marion by telling her what he thinks of her, leading to a big row.

Sarah introduces her boy-friend Sam, who is looking for investors for his proposed beauty salon franchise, but Diana and Tom suspect he is a con-man and Tom - to make his peace with Marion - 'persuades' Sam to let his daughter run her own beauty salon for free.

title: The Hip Operation
overview:
Diana falls and breaks her hip whilst throwing a brick at the home's incompetent South American gardener. She is taken to hospital where she rows with the Welsh doctor over a hip replacement operation and Sarah, about to marry Sam, comes to visit. Sarah knows that Diana dislikes Sam and wonders if she will try to stop the wedding..or even attend. 

In the end Diana turns up for her niece's big day, using a Zimmer frame. 

Marion, meanwhile, is not making a success of the beauty shop and Tom suggests Sam take back the franchise.

title: Glamorous Grannies
overview:
Tom has a bet with Diana that she can't be nice to people for a work. Such untypical actions only lead to confusion. 

Baines wants to organize a glamorous grandmother contest for the old ladies in the home, the prize being a cruise for two.

Since Basil wants to marry Betty, Tom approaches his son-in-law Geoffrey, whose firm are sponsoring the contest to let Betty win, but when Betty gets cold feet and refuses to enter, Diana, having made sure a journalist friend is present to expose any 'fixing' the contest; replaces her and wins. She lets Betty and Basil have the prize.

title: Foreign Workers
overview:
In order to cut costs Baines decides to employ illegal immigrant workers at Bayview. 

To Diana one incompetent foreigner, the gardener, is enough and, after the residents have staged a protest, order is restored. 

Tom has been overdoing physical exercise in his efforts to get as fit as Linford Christie and his collapse leads Diana to persuade him to slow down.

title: Young People
overview: A group of students comes to Bayview and Baines bribes Bob, one of them, into being seen in a compromising situation with Diana. This will enable him, under an old church covenant from the 1600's which was bestowed upon the home, to have her thrown out for immoral actions. As it happens Bob much prefers Marion and goes off with her instead.

title: The Boring Son
overview:
In addition to her alcoholism, Marion's fling with Bob becomes the last straw for Geoffrey, who finally decides to leave her.

But where can he go? 

Answer, move in with his father at Bayview but Geoffrey is so boring that before long Diana and Tom are planning to get him back with Marion.

title: The Funeral
overview:
Depressed vicar Dennis Sparrow is conducting the funeral of ex-Bayview resident Jimmy, but is making heavy weather of the eulogy and later he tells Tom and Diana that he is losing his faith.

Geoffrey is back with Marion but their life is far from being a bed of roses and it's suggested Dennis tries to help them sort out their marriage. Not long afterwards Geoffrey announces that Marion and the vicar are now living together in Wales. 

Baines, meanwhile, is looking for a wife - a plan which involves Jane, though, sadly for her, not as a possible candidate, but as a helper.

title: Two Nasty Children
overview:
Blaming Tom for introducing Marion to Dennis Sparrow, Geoffrey asks him to baby-sit his two children Skye and Tarquin, but they are little monsters who run rings round them. 

Fortunately, Diana is on hand to put them in their place. 

Baines decides to try computer dating to find his wife but Jane decides to put her oar in.

title: Looking for Work
overview:
It's April and yet it's still very cold so the residents do not appreciate it when Baines turns off the central heating and suggest the residents go jogging to keep warm.

Tom and Diana decide to get jobs to get out of the icy-cold home. Tom gets a job working with Geoffrey, but he is such a pain that ,in order to get rid of him, Geoffrey pays Baines to put the heating back on.

title: Harvey's Fiancee
overview:
Baines meets a girl-friend, Lucy Maitland, at the hunt ball. 

His mother is coming to visit before going to stay with his sister so Jane poses as Lucy Maitland to put Mother off Harvey's new fiancee whilst Tom and Diana ham it up mercilessly pretending to be Baines' parents talking to Lucy. The result is that Lucy does not stay around and Jane has got her Baines back all to herself.

title: The Estate Agent
overview:
After she has been accused of selfishness,  Diana goes to work as a volunteer at a charity for elderly people and takes up the cause of an old lady about to be evicted by unscrupulous estate agent Janet Follett. 

Diana learns that Ms. Follett is Baines' new girl-friend and she has plans for Bayview which will not go down well with the residents. With a little help from Tom and her media background Diana sets out to expose Ms. Follett.

title: Scandal
overview:
Resident Dave Cartwright has died and at the wake the drink flows freely amongst the inhabitants of Bayview. 

Tom and Diana certainly have knocked it back and next morning wake up in bed together. Jane is shocked but Tom suddenly becomes very popular with the ladies in the home's bowling team.

title: Sabotage
overview:
Whilst Baines is ecstatic about his new car Tom and Diana plan a little holiday and start a vacation fund. 

Unfortunately, Geoffrey decides to invest the money in the new intensive care wing that Baines is having built for Bayview. When Tom finds out he and Basil show how creative they can be when somebody conveniently leaves a bulldozer lying around and the holiday is on.

title: Politics
overview:
Diana decides that she would like to enter politics and stands as an independent candidate for the Residents' Party. Baines has been asked to stand for the Tories so Tom decides he will have some fun and join in the race too.

Diana is forced to stand down when Baines threatens to sack care worker Jenny but Diana makes sure that this is used against him too and his political career is a non-starter.

title: Sleeping Pills
overview:
Diana collapses and is rushed to hospital where Baines tries, unsuccessfully to cop off with the lady doctor. 

Diana, wrongly, gets it into her head that she is dying of cancer and asks Tom to get her some sleeping pills so that she can end it all quickly. For Tom, however, there are limits as to what he will do for his best friend.

title: Great Aunt Diana
overview:
The residents are getting wet waiting for a bus but when it arrives the driver claims that they cannot get on for free for another four minutes as they are too early, so Diana hauls him off the bus and Tom hi-jacks it on behalf of the residents. 

Later this will come in handy when a very pregnant Sarah arrives, seeking Diana's reluctant help to deliver her baby. Ultimately a girl arrives, unsurprisingly, Sarah calls her Diana.

title: Financial Difficulties
overview:
Diana is horrified to find that she is unaccountably in the red and goes up to London to cause a fuss, only to discover that all her investments have gone into receivership.

Back in Bayview, Tom's room is suffering from severe rising damp so Tom comes up with a solution that will sort things out for them both. They will live together in one large room. Diana accepts this but draws the line at being carried over the threshold.

title: Living Together
overview:
To Jane's disapproval, Diana and Tom are now living in sin, or rather together, but already they start arguing, since they can't decide whose furniture they should be using. 

A new resident, Mrs. Kent from Gwent, arrives. She is withdrawn and nervous so Tom and Diana put on an act of being very happy together in order to bring her out of her shell. As it happens they do get a result - but only when she sees what they are really like.

title: Living In Miserable Sin
overview:
Living together is not the bed of roses that Tom and Diana were expecting. He criticizes her sloppiness and her funny little ways, such as feeding acorns to squirrels with a sling-shot. She decides to move out and goes to stay with Sarah to be a nanny to baby Diana but this is not her forte. 

Tom misses her, especially when Geoffrey decides to move in with him again.

title: Shelves
overview:
Geoffrey is getting on Tom's nerves with his obsession with shelves, which he keeps putting up all over the unit and it's a blessing when he gets a call from Marion, asking him to get back with her. 

Tom is not the only resident missing Diana as she is seen as a source of advice, but Diana herself, a thoroughly incompetent nanny, is missing Bayview and, after ruining a fashion show goes 'home' to Tom.

title: The Seance
overview:
Whilst Mr. Kwok demonstrates karate to the Bayview males, who vie with each other to impress Jane, Tom is introduced to Jane's psychic, Marjorie Evans, and asks to be put in touch with his dead wife. 

A seance is duly organized, but Marion has bribed the medium to give a fake message, saying that Tom's wife disapproves of his relationship with Diana. Diana,however, exposes the plot.

title: The Promotional Video
overview:
A promotional video is being made to extol the virtues of Bayview and several residents are to have speaking parts, including Basil, who sees himself as the new James Bond, Tom and Jenny. 

The excitement is such that few will heed Diana's view that it is just another money-making scam by the idiot Baines - except Tom, who joins her in sabotaging the project by substituting footage of Marion and Geoffrey giving a rather more realistic look at life.

title: Adult Education
overview:
When Tom and Diana's life drawing art classes at the local college are terminated and complaining yields no joy, they decide to instigate their own at Bayview. Baines is to be the model, posing as Julius Caesar, bare beneath his toga for authenticity (or so Diana tells him). 

When an inspector calls at Bayview, Diana undoes the knot holding the toga in place and leaving Baines publicly nude. As a result, he has to go to a clinic where Jane reports that he has had a breakdown.

title: Sent To Coventry
overview:
A strange reversal of fortune overtakes Bayview with the hospitalised Baines seen as the victim and Diana his tormentor. She is sent to Coventry and there are threats of staff strikes unless she goes.

Help comes from a most unexpected source - Marion, whose pharmaceutical knowledge leads her to see that Baines is faking his condition. Diana is vindicated though Tom has made her apologize to Baines in order for her to be allowed to stay. He knew Baines was faking it but thought the humility would do her good.

title: Waterworks
overview:
After drinking a lot at a reunion, Tom has trouble passing water and becomes very sensitive about it. He tries to keep it from Diana but his secretive behaviour initially leads her to believe that he is seeing another woman. 

Ultimately, he sees a doctor and goes to hospital and she is upset that he had not told her the truth.

title: The Conference
overview:
There is to be a conference on the needs of the elderly held, and Diana is asked to be the local representative. At the same time Tom is waiting on tests to see if he has prostrate cancer, and so Diana researches the subject for the conference. 

Although the results of the test are as yet undisclosed, Tom declares his love for Diana.

title: After The Operation
overview: Diana visits Tom in hospital. His operation to clear his prostrate cancer has been a success and he returns to Bayview with her. Unfortunately Geoffrey, who has had yet another falling-out with Marion, decides he wants to move in with them again. Baines is rejected by an exclusive golf club because he is unmarried.

title: The Bayview Conservation Society
overview: Baines is hiring Mr. Nakamura, a Japanese hotel consultant, to advise on the building of a new,space-saving wing to be built at Bayview - thereby enabling him to pack in more residents. Tom starts the Bayview Conservation Society, eventually enlisting Diana, to demonstrate that any such building would damage the wildlife and the natural environment, thus stopping the plan from going ahead.

title: A Royal Visit
overview: A letter from the mayor's office suggests that a royal personage will be gracing Bayview with a visit. Diana, already even more crotchety than ever, due to a painfully swollen foot, does not share Tom's monarchist views and holds forth on the pointlessness of the royals. Just as predictably the royal visit turns out to be very much less 'royal' than expected.

title: Diana's Diet
overview: Diana's foot shows no sign of healing and Tom is anxious for her to see a doctor. For all of her brash facade she is reluctant to seek medical advice in case she is given the worst possible scenario. However, she complies and is told that she has diabetes and must alter her diet. A relieved Tom proposes. Baines also proposes to Jane, in order to get his golf club membership, but she turns him down.

title: Trouble With Men
overview: Diana and Jane are both taken aback by the bizarre ways of men, following their respective marriage proposals. Tom's proposal to Diana has brought on a shock and she collapses and is taken to hospital. Jane's decision that she will become a nun after all has tempted Harvey to consider joining the priesthood.

title: Harvey The Priest
overview: A combination of genuine feelings for Jane, whom he is used to having around, plus the desire to still join the golf club, causes Baines to become a priest of the Order of the Flaming Sword of Las Vegas - by post.

title: Bungee Jumping
overview: Whilst planning his pre-nuptial agreement with an eager Jane, Baines is told that he is not a proper priest and that any attempts he makes to get money from his ordination will lead to fraud charges. Diana is of course delighted but she has more pressing matters - Tom's threatened bungee jump. She agrees to marry him if only to stop the jump from going ahead but insists on her own pre-nuptial conditions.

title: A Double Wedding?
overview: After confiding her doubts about marriage to Sarah, Diana has a raucous hen night with male strippers whilst Tom's stag night is a very staid affair. The befuddled Dennis Sparrow is to conduct the two wedding ceremonies separately but due to a double booking involving a funeral, a double wedding is on the cards after all - despite Marion's efforts to sabotage Tom's marrying Diana.

title: New cop at Bellahøj
overview:
Anna Pihl begins as a new cop on the station Bellahøj in Copenhagen and not many minutes passes before she becomes involved in a showdown between chef Rune Strandberg and his ex-wife who uses a restraining order to put pressure on Rune.

Anna and her colleague Mikala tries hard to get Rune to comply with the restraining order. Anna realises that the ex-wife's whereabouts, namely her jealousy, are the reason she and Rune are not together anymore.

All of a sudden, the police is notified about Rune going berserk, and when Anna and Mikala trying to arrest him Mikala gets stabbed and Rune takes off. Anna Pursues Rune to his restaurant, where Rune threatens to blow himself and the restaurant to pieces.

Anna, however, goes against orders to get him out and she manages to get him arrested.

title: A question of honour
overview:
After the stabbing of Mikala Anna needs a new colleague. Tthe experienced Kim becomes her new partner.

They are called out to an Arab family whose daughter, Jamil, sais she has been beaten on the way home. Kim acts disrespectfully and takes no action in the case because he believes it's a typical clash in the family. His handling of the case results in Anna no longer wanting to team up with Kim. After Kim helps her through a car accident she ponders about keeping him as a partner.

Anna, questioning the opinion of Kim regarding the Jamile case, begins her own investigation. She finds out that Jamile has lied to her family. t appears that Jamile was beaten up by Tanya for having slept with Tanya's boyfriend. After Anna is informed that Jamile, yet another time, is beaten by Tanya she alerts Kim and Tanya gets arrested.

Meanwhile, Anna's father, Henning, becomes introverted after his wife's death. Anna tries to get him back on track. His past attracts interest from a publisher who wants to publish his memoirs.

At the station Martin flirts with Anna. When visits Martin unannounced, she is met by a woman, Laura, who introduces herself as his girlfriend.

title: The fat lady
overview:
Anna and Kim are sent out to an apartment where they find a dead obese woman. Eva is called out to the apartment and agrees to Anna's suspicions regarding foul play. Anna starts a parallel investigation and a friend of the deceased woman becomes a suspect.

Mikala is back at the station again after the stabbing but has developed mental issues after the trauma.

title: Dog in the backseat
overview:
A dog has run into a bus and Anna manages to get it out again. When she and Kim bring it back to the owner suspicions of animal cruelty arise.

Eva believes, however, they have no case judicially. After a political dimension is added, Eva finds herself required to file a case against the owner of dog.

title: Indianeren
overview:
En voldtægtsmand skræmmer byen med sine brutale overfald, hvilket Martin kommer til at opleve, da han aflytter sin telefonsvarer, hvor eks-kæresten Laura forgæves råber på hjælp, mens hun overfaldes og dræbes. 

Samtidig er forholdet mellem Martin og Anna begyndt at fungere, men Anna har dog stadig svært ved at gøre noget seriøst ved forholdet, da hun ikke vil forvirre sønnen, Mikkel. 

Da Anna og Mikala er i byen sammen, opdager Anna, at Mikala går rundt med sin tjenestepistol i en dyr taske. Anna synes, det er meget mærkeligt, men Mikala er bange og tør ikke gå uden pistolen. De bliver uvenner, og Anna går, men pludselig er tasken med pistolen væk.

title: The decoy
overview:
Anna Pihl melder sig som lokkedue, så de kan få fat på voldtægtsmanden, der nu også har dræbt Martins ekskæreste, Laura. Anna skal gå rundt i gaderne tæt fulgt af politiet i håbet om at voldtægtsmanden viser sig, men der sker intet. 

Samtidig har Mikala været væk i 2 uger, og nu vil vagthavende gerne vide, hvor hun er henne. Anna ringer til hende, og pludselig dukker hun op på stationen, men da hun ingen pistol har, må hun låne Annas. Der går dog ikke lang tid, før hun kontaktes af en, der har hende pistol, men han vil kun give hende den, hvis han får noget til gengæld. 

Voldtægtsmanden har dog holdt øje med politiet, og da Anna skal besøge Martin, som nu officielt er hendes kæreste, overfaldes hun af voldtægtsmanden - Til sit held har hun en ulovlig peberspray med i tasken, som pacificerer ham, og samtidig kommer Martin hende til undsætning, så voldtægtsmanden kan anholdes.

title: Everyone has a secret
overview:
Kim anholder Annas bror, Mads, for spirituskørsel, men overlader sagen til Anna, der vælger at give ham kørekortet tilbage uden at skrive sagen. I mellemtiden finder Anna ud af, at Mads er blevet fyret fra sit arbejde, og at han har et alkohol- og pillemisbrug, og pludselig er han igen ude og køre spirituskørsel - denne gang rammer han en cyklist, som dør. 

Samtidig er Mikala blevet trukket ind i en ubehagelig sag. Stavro, som gav hende pistolen igen, vil have hende til at levere oplysninger til hans kriminelle netværk som tak for hjælpen, og Mikala har ikke anden mulighed end at gøre som han siger. 

Imens forsøger Annas udlejer, Jan, der er bøsse, at få et barn med en lesbisk mor, men han finder ud af, at det ikke er helt så let, som han regnede med.

title: In bed with the enemy
overview:
Mads er flyttet ind hos Anna efter ulykken, men han er ikke helt let at have med at gøre. Pludselig opsøges Anna af familien til den dræbte cyklist, der vil møde Mads, men det vil han ikke. Til sidst bliver det for meget for Anna, der sender ham ned til sin far. 

Samtidig opsøges Mikala af Stavro, der vil have oplysninger om, hvem der tipper politiet om narkohandel. I mellemtiden er Martin blevet flyttet til en civilgruppe, hvilket Mikala udnytter til at få oplysningerne til Stavro. Pludselig er meddeleren blevet dræbt, men det afholder ikke Mikala fra at indlede en affære med Stavro.

title: The fight in the park
overview:
Mikala vil ikke have noget med Stavro at gøre efter drabet på en politimeddeler, og det har han forståelse for, men så kan han ikke beskytte hende længere, og pludselig opsøges hendes børn i hjemmet. Det tør Mikala alligevel ikke, så hun genoptager sit hemmelige forhold til Stavro, hvilket sætter skår i hendes ægteskab med Thomas. 

Da Karen ankommer til stationen med en cykeltyv, som Anna og Kim tidligere har været i kontakt med, blomstrer romantikken. Kim synes, cykeltyven er meget sød, og ringer efterfølgende til hende for at få en date. 

Der skal være fodboldkamp i Parken, og Bellahøj stiller med mandskab til at sikre ro og orden. Martin har fået Mikala med i civilpatruljen, der skal holde ro på lægterne, mens Anna og Kim er del af beredskabet. I spisepausen mødes Anna og Martin på bænken, hvor Martin viser hende, hvad han har købt til Mikkel - En policeforce-helikopter, som er hans største ønske. Samtidig aftaler de at mødes om aftenen efter kampen. 

Pludselig sker der dog noget, som ændrer deres planer drastisk. Da Martin vil tale med en mand, som muligvis har noget med drabet på politimeddeleren at gøre, bliver han stukket ned for øjnene af Anna og Mikala. Gerningsmanden flygter derfra, mens Mikala bare ser til - Det er Stavros håndlanger.

title: The Hunt for Zoran
overview:
Anna og Mikala skal lave en fantom-tegning af den mand, som stak Martin ned i Parken, men Mikala er bange for at hendes forbindelse til Stavro vil blive afsløret, hvis hans håndlager, Zoran, fanges. Hun sørger derfor for, at tegningen overhovedet ikke kommer til at ligne Zoran. Hun ombestemmer sig dog, at hun kan se, hvor ked af det Anna er. 

Der går ikke lang tid fra den rigtige tegning er blevet udsendt, til Zoran bliver sporet ved havnen. Politiets Aktionsstyrke gennemsøger en båd, som han skulle befinde sig på, men han er der ikke. Pludselig ser Anna ham dog, og med Kims hjælp, får Zoran ikke lov at slippe. 

Da Zoran bliver bragt ind på stationen, lykkedes det ham at tage Mikala som gidsel og forskanse sig i våbenrummet. Anna snakker og forhandler med Zoran, mens aktionsstyrken er på vej, men da Zoran begynder at antyde, at han ved noget om Mikalas ulovligheder, griber hun et gevær og skyder ham. 

Mens Martin kommer til sig selv på hospitalet efter flere operationer, har Anna gjort det så godt som forhandler, at hun bliver tilbudt en plads i politiets forhandler-gruppe. Samtidig har Mads langt om længe besluttet sig for at tage ansvar i sin spiritus-sag. Også får Mikala at vide, at Stavro er rejst fra Danmark.

title: Manden i mosen
overview:
Anna er netop færdig på prøve hos kriminalpolitiet, da hun bliver sendt til Utterslev Mose, hvor en død mand er fundet. Manden har et falsk politiskilt på sig og viser sig at være den tidligere politibetjent, Varberg, afskediget for 10 år siden. Han levede for sit job – så meget at det tog overhånd. 

Kim og Karim bliver sendt ud ved søen for, at tale med folk i området. Da de ser en mand stå indenfor afspærringen, tager de kontakt til ham, men han overfalder dem, og under sin flygt vælter han en rude i hovedet på Kim, der må forbi skadestuen. Her møder han Karims søster, der er sygeplejerske, og som Kim hurtigt får et meget godt øje til. 

Mens Daniel frier til Anna, er Martin blevet opereret i Tyskland, og er nu rask. Han har derfor været til jobsamtale hos Eva - Han skal være Annas nye kollega. 

Ole viser sig at have en viden om Varberg. Det var ham, som lavede indberetningen, der fik ham fyret. Han kender også manden, som overfaldt Kim og Karim. Endnu en tidligere betjent, der fører kriminalpolitiet til en campingvogn. Her finder Anna og Eva blod og et skudhul. Udenfor finder Kim og Karim en brændt barne-BH. 

En undertøjsbutik genkender Varberg, der havde bildt dem ind, at han var ansat hos politiets gruppe mod butikstyveri. Hver gang de fangede en mindreårig butikstyv, kom han og hentede dem, men Anna finder ud af, at han misbrugte dem. Anna opsøger pigerne for at høre, hvad de har været igennem. Da hun ringer på hos en af dem, er kun hendes far, en major, hjemme. Han inviterer hende ind, men trækker pludselig en pistol og tilstår, at han dræbte Varberg, da han opdagede, hvad han havde gang i.

title: Sandt eller Falsk
overview:
Anna og hendes nye makker, Mik, bliver kaldt ud til et krydstogtskib, hvor et ældre ægtepar har fået stjålet to dyre designertasker. Senere bliver der betalt med en falsk euro-seddel og et andet sted med et falsk kreditkort. Selvom Eva ikke mener, de skal bruge tid på det, ser Anna alligevel en sammenhæng – Personerne er ens, og hun bliver mere og mere overbevist om, at det er to ansatte på skibet, David og Louise, der står bag svindlen. 

Kim synes godt om Karims søster, Samira, og pludselig tror han, hans sår, fra ruden han fik i hovedet, er betændt, så han må på skadestuen, hvor Samira fortæller ham, at der ikke er betændelse, men han kommer alligevel derfra med en sød besked. 

Therese skal til USA og mener, hun skal have barnet med derover, mens Jan vil passe barnet i Danmark, mens hun er væk. Anna giver Jan ret, også ender Therese med at give sig. 

Anna er sikker på, at David og Louise har svindlet, men hun har ingen beviser, hvilket især David bruger til at provokere hende. Pludselig kommer der dog et tip fra et auktionshus, hvor de to har fået vurderet et maleri. Anna finder maleriets ejer, som nu har en kopi hængende. Hun får hurtigt samlet en masse folk, og anholder David og Louise på skibet, hvor det ægte maleri ligger gemt i deres kahyt.

title: Hus forbi
overview:
En hjemløs mand, Lars, bliver fundet under en bro. Det ligner selvmord, men det viser sig, at han var i slagsmål, før han røg ud over broen. En prostitueret narkoman ringede til alarmcentralen og anmeldte tilskadekomsten. Hun angiver en ung mand, Ronnie, for at have skubbet Lars ud over broen. Ronnie erkender, at Lars skyldte ham penge, men han siger, han ikke har rørt Lars – og der er ingen beviser. 

Daniel har pludselig købt et hus til ham og Anna i Søllerød, men Anna er ikke meget for overraskelsen – og det er Jan absolut heller ikke. Imens overtaler Anna derimod Eva til at flytte sammen med sin far. 

Der skal bruges en til at sidde vagt ved Lars på hospitalet, men ingen melder sig. Da Ole afslører, at det er Samira, som er vagthavende sygeplejerske, tager Kim dog tjansen. Han bliver dog noget skuffet, da hun har byttet vagt og først kommer om eftermiddagen – Kim tager derfor dobbeltvagt. 

Imens vågner Lars, og han fortæller, at Ronnie stjal hans penge og skubbede ham ud over broen. Hans kone bliver hentet ind, så hun kan se ham, men Ronnie er fulgt efter, og mens de er alene derinde, går han ind og forsøger at kvæle Lars med en pude. Lars’s kone afværger dog angrebet, og Ronnie bliver overmandet, anholdt og sigtet.

title: Happy slapping
overview:
Da Anna og Daniel er på vej hjem en aften, bliver de overfaldet af 4 drenge, men Daniel går til den, og mens tre af dem flygter, ligger en, Sune, tilbage med en brækket næse. Han anmelder Daniel for vold, og efterforskningen peger i retning af, at Daniel gik langt over stregen. 

Anna erkender, at Daniel forsøgte at træde en mobiltelefon med bevismateriale i stykker, og han optrådte meget voldeligt med en særlig kampteknik, hvilket giver anklageren klare beviser for, at han overtrådte sin ret til lovligt nødværge. 

Imens kommer Samira på besøg hos Kim, der forgæves har forsøgt sig med madlavning. I stedet har han måtte nøjes med Sushi-take-away, som hverken han eller Samira i virkeligheden kan lide. Sin lidt kejtede anretning til trods, får han alligevel et kys af Samira. 

Sagen mod Daniel er klar, men ved den sidste afhøring, har Daniel pludselig nye argumenter klar. Sune deltog i en voldelige demonstration i Malmø og sårede en af Daniels kollegaer. Daniel har en psykologs ord for, at han kan have pådraget sig post-traumatisk-stress-syndrom, som er kommet op i ham, da han genkendte Sune under overfaldet. Det kan begrunde hans voldelige handlinger som nødværge, og efterforskningslederen vil derfor undersøge sagen igen. Anna er dog ikke helt sikker på, at Daniel nu også taler helt sandt – og Daniel kan ikke overbevise hende.

title: En gang skyldig
overview:
En dreng er forsvundet fra sine forældre i Zoologisk Have, og man finder hans ene sko ved en vej udenfor haven. Forældrene skal skilles, og var oppe og skændes, da han forsvandt, men hans mormor, som han var fortrolig med, har ikke set ham, mens Kim og Karim ingen spor finder af ham i hendes kolonihavehus. Man frygter derfor, at der er sket en forbrydelse 

Karim finder derimod ud af, at Kim og Samira er blevet kærester, hvilket han bliver meget skuffet over. Det skaber problemer mellem de to ellers faste makkere, men det lykkedes alligevel Samira, at få Karim til at acceptere forholdet. 

En psykisk syg mand med pædofile tendenser bliver anholdt, men han nægter sig skyldig. Eva, der tidligere har haft en sag med manden, går meget hårdt til ham, og får ham til at tilstå, at han har dræbt drengen og smidt liget i havnen. Mens dykkere leder havnen igennem, får politiet dog et tip om, hvor drengen er, og de finder ham i mormorens kolonihavehus, hvor han havde gemt sig efter forældrenes skænderi. 

Anklagemyndigheden har frafaldt tiltalen mod Daniel, og det vil han fejre, men Anna har haft travlt med sagen. Han bliver derfor meget oprørt, da han tager ud på stationen, hvor Anna, efter den lykkelige afslutning på sagen, sidder og drikker rødvin med Mik og Martin, som han i øvrigt tror, har noget kørende med hende. Han giver hende valget mellem at tage med ham eller slutte deres forhold, og Anna vælger det sidste.

title: Altanpigen del 1 - Springet
overview:
En ung pige med indvandrebaggrund Jamila springer ud fra tredje sal, men overlever mirakuløst. Eva tror, der kan være tale om forsøg på æresdrab, og at Jamila blev tvunget til enten at springe eller blive dræbt. Hun og familien afviser dog, men erkender, at hun er forlovet. 

Daniel undskylder overfor Anna, og hun går med til at de skal mødes med familierne. Under mødet bliver Anna dog overbevist om, at Daniel lyver overfor hende, og deres forhold bliver endeligt afbrudt. Imens vender Therese uventet hjem fra USA og henter Molly hos Jan på en noget ubarmhjertig måde. 

Jamila har forsøgt at ringe til en, som hedder Mahmood, og han afslører, at de er kærester, men at hun også er forlovet og skal giftes med en af Københavns mest magtfulde kriminelle. Jamila og Mahmood bliver derfor sat under beskyttelse på politistationen, og de bliver forbudt at have kontakt med familien, selvom Jamila fortæller, at de ikke er en trussel. 

Da Jamilas fars butik bliver brændt ned, forlader Jamila dog stationen og lidt efter også Mahmood. Næste morgen bliver der skudt mod Mahmood, mens han er på arbejde.

title: Altanpigen del 2 - Opgøret
overview:
Der bliver skudt mod Mahmood, mens han er på arbejde. Han ved, hvem der gjorde det, Niko, der har forbindelse til Abdul, som skal giftes med Jamila. Politiet kan dog ikke finde beviser, der kan fængsle Niko eller stoppe brylluppet. Mahmood vil derfor selv stoppe det. 

Mens Anna fortæller Mikkel, at hun ikke længere er kæreste med Daniel, får Kim et godt råd fra sin mor, som skaber problemer mellem ham og Samira. Alligevel ender hun i sengen hjemme i Kims lejlighed. 

Anna og Martin overvåger brylluppet mellem Abdul og Jamila, og midt under en tale springer Mahmood frem. Det skaber kaos, men det lykkedes alligevel Anna og Martin, at få Mahmood og Jamila væk derfra, men da hendes familie også flygter, skyder Niko hendes bror ned. 

Politiet får fat i Niko, men han vil ikke hive Abdul ind i det. Politiet forsøger derfor, at finde andre måder at ramme ham på. Jamilas far tipper dem om, at Abdul har ulovlige cigaretter liggende i en lagerhal, men det vil højst give et års fængsel. Mahmood, Jamila og hendes familie må derfor rejse til udlandet for at være i sikkerhed.

title: Mikala's valg
overview:
Det fængsel Mikala sidder i, flyder med stoffer, og kriminalpolitiet bliver sat på sagen. Anna får overtalt Mikala til, at observere for dem, mens hun selv går undercover som fængselsbetjent. Mikala finder hurtigt ud af, hvem der styrer stofferne – to kvinder - og hvem der smugler dem ind – En nervøs Pernille, der gennem sit barn får stofferne ind i besøgstiden. 

Pernille har det dog ikke godt med smugleriet, og de to kvinder tør derfor ikke arbejde med hende, så de skubber hende ud fra en etage, så hun må på sygehuset. I stedet får Mikala gjort indtryk, så hun får tjansen med at smugle stofferne ind. 

Mens Martin har søgt om at blive flyttet til Århus, er Samira flyttet ind hos Kim. Det giver dog visse problemer, fordi hans mor er i lejligheden i tide og utide. Da moren begynder at advare Samira om, hvad hun er gået ind til, bliver det også for meget for Kim, der beder hende gå. Therese har fået en kæreste, og Jan er straks bange for, at han nu kommer til at se endnu mindre til deres barn, men efter en snak med dem, får han faktisk mere tid med hende. 

En bamse bliver afleveret til Mikalas datter, der har den med i besøgstiden. Mikala afleverer stofferne videre til de to kvinder, som det lykkedes Anna at få anholdt, mens politiet slår til mod flere adresser udenfor fængslet, hvilket sprænger stofhandlen.

title: Under anklage del 1 - Skuddet
overview:
En mand er fundet død for foden af et syv etagers parkeringshus, og det tyder på, at han ikke er sprunget frivilligt. Martin og Anna tager ud for at finde to vidner, Bjørn og Bonnie. De går ind i nogle bygninger hver for sig, og pludselig ser Anna dem. Bjørn peger en pistol mod hende, men idet samme skyder hun ham. Mens Anna konstaterer, han er død, stikker Bonnie af. 

Sagen skal rutinemæssigt undersøges af statsadvokaten og rejseholdet. Imens har kriminalpolitiet svært ved at finde både Bonnie og Bjørns pistol. Det lykkedes dem at finde Bonnie - død af en overdosis, men uden pistol. 

Samiras far inviterer Kim med familien til Iran. Han vil meget gerne med, men hans mors fødselsdag ligger samtidig – og han har altid fejret den med hende. Presset af Karim får han rykket fødselsdagen, men hans mor giver ikke op så let. Hun lader sig indlægge på hospitalet i håbet om, at Kim vil blive hjemme. Kim lader sig dog ikke snyde, men lover hende i stedet et postkort fra Iran. 

Martin forsøger at støtte Anna, men da rejseholdet finder en video fra et overvågningskamera, hvor Bonnie flygter uden pistol, smuldrer Annas forklaring om selvforsvar, og hun bliver derfor suspenderet og sigtet for drabet på Bjørn.

title: Under anklage del 2 - Nedtælling
overview:
Anna får hjælp fra Martin til at undersøge gerningsstedet igen, og de finder ud af, at der må have været en person mere i rummet. Derudover finder de nogle nøgler, som passer til en autocamper, der holder udenfor bygningen. Idet samme kommer en mand for at hente camperen. Han fortæller, at han bare skulle sætte den på et aftalt sted, hvor en anden person skulle hente den. 

Martin og Mik sætter camperen på det aftalte sted, og giver sig til at vente. Efter noget tid bliver den hentet, og de følger efter, indtil de når til færgen. Her bliver manden, kendingen og Bjørn og Bonnies pusher Gekko, anholdt, men der er ingen beviser for, at han har forbindelse til drabet. 

Politiet har 24 timer til at finde beviser mod Gekko, ellers skal han løslades. Trods utallige forsøg lykkedes det dog ikke, så Gekko må løslades. I sidste øjeblik opdager Anna dog, at Gekko, med hjælp fra sin advokat, har skiftet sko. Martin gennemsøger advokatens bil, og finder Gekkos sko, hvor det stof, der dræbte Bonnie, er gemt. Presset af situationen afslører Gekko, at han smed pistolen i havnen. 

I havnen bliver pistolen fundet, og Anna kan glad fejre med kollegaerne, at hun nu ikke længere er under anklage. Der mangler dog en – Martin, der har fået nyt job i Århus. Hun cykler ud til ham, men idet samme kører hans flyttebil. Heldigvis er han ikke med – Han har valgt at blive i København sammen med Anna.

Sirens

title: Sweet and Sour Revenge
overview: A murder has been committed and Rockliffe has been given the name of a suspect.  The name revives old and bitter memories.  But is it fifteen years too late to do any good?

title: It's All Happening
overview: Rockliffe complains about the work load.  There are drug dealers, rapists, muggers, murderers, thieves and con-men around.  What can turn up next?  Joseph Maxwell, that's what.

title: A Bad Few Days
overview: ""This bloke's son is thirteen, has an assessed age of six, goes eleven stone on the scales and is a friend to every stranger he meets.  What do you want me to do?  Let him find his own way home in the cause of race relations?""

title: In the Bag
overview: Why has the habitually lazy Paul Georgiou activated himself and acquired an informant?

title: Ghetto-Blasters
overview: There's a tense situation in the black community.  A man has died in police custody as a result of using a deadly drug.  Rockliffe and Flight think they know who the dealer is, but if they act will there be worse trouble?

title: Up the Down Escalator
overview: What arises for Rockliffe and the crime squad as a result of hunger pains?

title: Extra-curricular
overview: Rockliffe is surprised to learn that some members of his squad find him unapproachable.  Doesn't he always come to their aid when they need him?  And that's just what he has to do when Adams goes out on a limb.

title: Go for It
overview: It's Dorset wedding bells for Keith Chitty and best man Gerry O'Dowd decides to enter into the swing of things.  Gerry's taking no chances and neither is Sgt. Rockliffe.  When their paths cross back in town they both get more than they bargained for.

title: A Trip to the Zoo
overview: Members of Rockliffe's crime squad make hasty character assessments.  Wayne is an animal, Chris is a charmer.  Both judgments have to be revised on closer inspection.

title: In Too Deep
overview: Why are the officers of Church Street police station tuning in to a local radio station?  And why does Rockliffe allow himself to be involved in a situation which causes so much disapproval from on high?

title: Looking After Your Own
overview: It is not a crime to photograph police activity, but when it happens during an investigation into serious assaults on women Sgt. Rockliffe is suspicious.  What he discovers puts him into the most disagreeable situation of his career.

title: Easy Meat
overview: Rockliffe's team is in hospital.  They are watching for someone who is frightening the nurses.  But when a nurse is hurt in their full view, they realise they have a different and more urgent situation on their hands.

title: A Very Diplomatic Incident
overview: It is a night of routine surveillance for the Crime Squad.  All is quiet, but not for long.  Sgt. Rockliffe and his team soon find themselves in areas of enquiry that are foreign to them and where there are choices to be made between public justice and private revenge.

title: Top Man
overview: Acting on information received seems more important to Rockliffe than taking notice of a memo from the Chief Superintendent.  Embarrassment results.  Except for Georgiou, who volunteers for a very risky adventure.

title: Black Arrow
overview: The two married members of Rockliffe's team have a dinner engagement, but the demands of duty put paid to their plans.  An entirely different night out on the town is arranged for them - spiced with an element of risk.

title: Hearts and Flowers
overview: Rockliffe thinks WPC Walsh is too preoccupied with the problems of a homeless family.  But he is not entirely impartial himself when it comes to associating with an attractive titled woman who seems to be unattached.

title: The One That Got Away
overview: Before Rockliffe and his team can start to look for three villains who got away they must find out who they were.  It's a challenge that exercises all their ingenuity and certain members of the team have other things on their minds: three of them have selection boards for the Detective Training School.

overview: Comedy series about the crazy adventures of a family of cats. The father of the family, Artur (Raivo E. Tamm), is convinced that there has never been a man smarter and more handsome than him. Artur's exuberantly ladylike wife Jane, daughter Cerily who has reached sexual maturity, son Tannu, wild by nature, and brother Robert, who suffers from chronic financial problems, disagree on this issue. In the first part, the cats' minds are excited by the gay theme. Screenwriter-director Arbo Tammiksaar, producer Teet Margna.

title: Funeral
overview: In the second part of the comedy series, family man Artur defies the fear of death. But he is even more afraid of an undignified funeral. Everything has to go exactly the way he wants it, and for that he has to practice this important event with the whole family!

title: Shopping freak
overview: In today's episode of the domestic comedy series, shopping-addicted family mother Jane undergoes painful rehab, while family man Artur prepares for the best lunch of his life.

title: Tax terminator
overview: Artur's home is attacked by the tax office and he has to keep this humiliation a secret from his family. Jane annoys the readers of her fashion magazine and suffers a bitter punishment for it. Robert faces imprisonment.

title: A big hunt
overview: In the latest episode of the domestic comedy series, the Cats family is on trial. There is also a merciless hunt and amnesty. At the request of the viewers, today's final show contains sex and violence!

overview: Grady says goodbye to Fred. Later, Fred pays Grady a visit, helping him out by bringing him his luggage.

title: Grady Learns to Drive
overview: Grady is tired of riding the bus and decides that he wants to learn to drive. His family, however, has concerns. After passing his test, he overhears his family talking. To make sure they don't worry, he tells them he didn't take the test and resolves not to drive.

overview: The Pink Panther wants to practice his music, much to the chagrin of a silence-seeking Big Nose.

overview: Aardvark purchases a "Super Duper Juicer" in hopes of beefing-up his body to catch Ant.

overview: The Pink Panther makes a pizza delivery to the home of a mad scientist who has bigger plans for him than just handing over a tip.

title: Pink Hi-Tops
overview: The Pink Panther thinks he wants a pair of high-tech hi-top sneakers until he puts them on.

overview: Aardvark falls into a prehistoric lost world where he tries to teach a cave aardvark a few things about catching ants.

overview: The Pink Panther must save his garden by infiltrating a pollutant-producing factory run by Big Nose and his robots.

overview: Big Nose is serious about his mini golf and will stop at nothing to keep The Pink Panther from making par.

overview: The Pink Panther is sent on a spy mission to retrieve a mysterious disc and keep it from getting into the wrong hands.

overview: When Pink orders a new remote control, he doesn't expect it to manipulate everything except the television.

title: I Didn't See That Coming
overview: Aardvark tries to go incognito with the use of invisibility spray.

title: Pink Party of One
overview: Maître d' Big Nose tries to keep a hungry Pink Panther from eating in his fancy five-star restaurant.

title: Pink Pool Fool
overview: Finding the skate park is closed, The Pink Panther tries to skate in a drained-swimming pool, but Big Nose won't let his plans to go swimming be ruined.

overview: A scheming sloth supplies Aardvark with some high-tech gadgets to capture Ant.
